Mishneh Torah, Sales 26:
Hammocher et hair machar battim uvorot shichin umearot umerchatzaot veshovachot uvet habbaddim uvet hashshelachin shebbah vehassemuchin lah. veet hachorashin hammukkafin lah veet hassadot hayeduot lah. veet habbevarin shel chayya veofot vedagim sheppenehem kenegdah af al pi shehen rechokim mimmenna. aval lo machar hammittaltelin shebbetochah. uvizman sheamar lo hi vechol ma shebbetochah ani mocher lecha hare kullan mechurin. uven kach uven kach lo machar lo et sheyareha velo et benoteha velo hachorashin hammuktzin mimmenna. velo et hachelek sheyyesh lah bayyam velo et hachelek sheyyesh lah bayyabbasha. velo et bevare chayya veofot vedagim sheen penehem kenegdah: 
Hammocher et hassade machar et haavanim hassedurot laggader veet haavanim shemmunnachot al hoomarim mippene shehen letzarkah. umachar et hakkanim hachalakim hammunnachin tachat haggefanim kede lehaamid et hakkerem mippene shehen letzarkah. umachar et hattevua hamechubberet lakkarka af al pi shehiggia lehikkatzer. umachar et mechitztzat hakkanim shehi pechuta mibbet rova af al pi shehakkanim shellah avim vachazakim. umachar et hashshomera haasuya betit af al pi sheenah kevua. umachar et hecharuv sheeno murkav veet betulat hashshikma af al pi shehen avim. umachar kol haddekalim shebbah. aval lo machar et haavanim sheenan sedurot laggader. velo et haavanim sheenan munnachot al gabbe hoomarin af al pi shehen muchanot lechach. velo et hakkanim shebbakkerem sheenan munnachin tachat haggefanim af al pi shehen meshuppin vachalakim umuchanim lechach. velo et hattevua haakura min hakkarka af al pi shehi tzericha lassade. uvizman sheamar lo hi vechol ma shebbetochah hare kullan mechurin: 
Ben kach uven kach lo machar mechitztzat hakkanim shehi bet rova af al pi shehakkanim shebbah dakkim uketannim. velo machar aruga ketanna shel besamim sheyyesh lah shem bifne atzmo kegon shekkorin lah be varda shel peloni. velo et hashshomera bizman sheenah asuya betit af al pi shehi kevua baaretz. velo machar et hecharuv hammurkav. velo saddan shel shikma vaafillu hen dakkim. velo machar et habbor shebbah velo et haggat velo et hashshovach ben charevim ben shelemim: 
Vetzarich hammocher liknot lo derech min hallokeach kede sheyyelech bah ad oto habbor o oto haddut o oto haggat o oto hashshovach shennisharu lo betoch hassade. veim peresh veamar chutz meellu eno tzarich likkach lo [derech]: 
Bamme devarim amurim bemocher, mippene shehaya lo lallokeach lefaresh velo peresh en lo et ellu. aval hannoten mattana kana et kullan ben bassade ben babbayit ben bechatzer ben bevet habbad. kelalo shel davar hannoten karka bemattana kana hamekabbel kol hamechubbar lah ad sheyyefaresh: 
Vechen haachin shechalku vezacha echad mehen bassade zacha bechullan. vehammachazik benichse hagger hechezik bassade zacha bechullan. vehammakdish et hassade hikdish kullan: 
Af bemocher velokeach en kol ellu haddevarim vechayyotze bahen meinyanim amurim ella bemakom sheen sham minhag velo shemot yeduim lechol davar vedavar bifne atzmo. aval bemakom shennahagu shehammocher kach machar kach hare ze machur vesomchin al hamminhag. vechen makom sheen korin ella bayit levayit levaddo o shekkorin bayit levayit vechol sevivotav ulechol sheal gabbav holchin achar leshon anshe hammakom. vechen haddin bemocher chatzer o sade o ir o mittaltelin bakkol holchin achar hashshemot haaruchot befi hakkol: 
Veze ikkar gadol bechol divre massa umattan holchin achar leshon bene adam beoto hammakom veachar hamminhag. aval makom sheen yadua bo minhag velo shemot meyuchadin ella yesh korin kach veyesh shekkorin kach osim kemo sheppershu chachamim bifrakim ellu:
Mishneh Torah, Sales 27: Hammocher et hassefina machar et hattoren veet hannes veet hooganim shellah veet kol hammeshotin hammanhigin otah. veet hakkevesh vehaaskala sheolin bahen lassefina veyordin aleha. veet bet hammayim shebbetochah. aval lo machar et habbitztzit vehi hassefina hakketanna sheholchim bah al hammayim hakkerovim layyabbasha. velo machar haddugit vehi hassefina hakketanna shetztzadin bah hammallachim et haddagim. velo machar et haavadim haosin bahen. velo et hammartzufin. velo et hassechora shebbetochah. uvizman sheamar lo hi vechol ma shebbetochah ani mocher hare kullan mechurin:

Hammocher et hakkaron lo machar et happeradot bizman sheenan keshurot immo. machar et happeradot lo machar et hakkaron. machar et hatztzemed lo machar et habbakar. machar et habbakar lo machar et hatztzemed. vaafillu bemakom shekkorin miktzatan letzemed bakar:

Hammocher et haol machar et happara. machar et happara lo machar et haol. machar et haagala machar et habbakar. machar et habbakar lo machar et haagala. veen haddamim reaya bechol ellu haddevarim vechayyotze bahen:
Vechen hammocher et hachamor machar et hammirdaat veet haukkaf af al pi sheenan alav. aval lo machar et hassak velo merkevet hannashim vaafillu hayu alav bishat hammecher:

Veen haddamim reaya sheim taa bichde shehaddaat toa yesh lo onaa o bittul mikkach kedin kol hammocher velokeach. veim taa bichde sheen haddaat toa lo batal hammikkach. shezze mattana natan lo veen lo ella hachamor belo sakkim. vechen kol kayyotze baze en meviin bo reaya min haddamim:

Hammocher et hashshifcha machar kelim shealeha afillu hem mea. aval lo machar hashsherim velo hannezamim velo hattabbaot velo et hakkatlaot shebbetzavvarah. veim amar lo shifcha vechol ma shealeha hare kullan mechurin af al pi sheyyesh aleha kelim shel mea mane:

Haomer lachavero shifcha meebberet ani mocher lecha. para meebberet ani mocher lecha. machar lo et havvalad. shifcha menika ani mocher lecha. para menika ani mocher lecha. lo machar lo et havvalad. chamora menika ani mocher lecha machar lo et hasseyach sheen adam kone chamora lachalavah:

Haomer lachavero rosh eved ze o rosh chamor ze ani mocher lecha hare ze machar chetzyo. vechen haddin bechol evar shehanneshama teluya bo. amar lo yad eved ze o yad chamor ze ani mocher lecha meshammenin benehem. vechen haddin bechol evar sheen hanneshama teluya bo. amar lo rosh para zo ani mocher lecha lo machar ella harosh bilvad shehare roshah nimkeret tamid bammitbachayim:

Machar et harosh bivhema gassa lo machar et haraglayim. machar et haraglayim lo machar et harosh. machar et hakkane lo machar et hakkaved. machar et hakkaved lo machar et hakkane. aval bivhema dakka machar et harosh machar et haraglayim. machar et haraglayim lo machar et harosh. machar et hakkane machar et hakkaved. machar et hakkaved lo machar et hakkane:
Hammocher et habbor lo machar et memav. machar et haashpa machar et zivlah. machar kavveret machar devorim. machar shovach machar et hayyonim:

Al yaloz meenecha haikkar haggadol bidvarim ellu shehu minhag hammedina vehashshemot hayeduim beyichud lechol davar vedavar. uvemakom sheen minhag velo shem shehakkol omrim lo beyichud velo shittuf holchin achar ellu hakkelalot shebbearu chachamim kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Sales 28: Haomer lachavero bet kor afar ani mocher lecha vehayu betoch hassadot geayot ketannim amukkim asara tefachim af al pi sheen bahen mayim o selaim gevohim asara tefachim en nimdadin bichlal habbet kor. sheen adam rotze litten meotav bemakom echad venirin kishnayim o shelosha mekomot. velokeach ellu haggeayot vehasselaim bichlal habbet kor belo damim. hayu pachot mikkan nimdadin immah:

Bamme devarim amurim keshello haya bahen ella bet arbaa kabbin vehayu haarbaa kabbin muvlain betoch chameshet kabbin umuvlain betoch rubbah shel sade. aval hayta yeter al arbaa kabbin o shehayu mefuzzarin harebe o enan muvlain. af al pi sheen bahen asara enan nimdadin immah. hayu nivlain rubban bemiutah o miutan berubbah. o shehayu muchlakin kemo chut shave o kemo iggul o kemo meshullash o shehayu batztzedadin o shehayu derech akallaton. kol ellu safek vehammotzi mechavero alav haraya. vechen im hayu afar millemala vesela millematta o sela millemala veafar millematta hare ze safek:
Haya bah sela yechidi afillu bet rova lechor en nimdad immah. veim haya samuch lammetzar afillu kol shehu en ze nimdad immah. hifsik afar ben sela lammetzar hare ze safek:
Amar lo kevet kor afar ani mocher lecha. afillu hayu bah geayot amukot asara tefachim o yoter o selaim gevohim asara tefachim o yoter hare ellu nimdadin immah:
Haomer lachavero bet kor afar ani mocher lecha midda bechevel. im pichet kol shehu menakke lo min haddamim veim hotir kol shehu yachzir lo:

Amar bet kor afar ani mocher lecha. hare ze kemi shepperesh veamar bet kor afar ben chaser ben yater. veim pichet min hammidda echad mearbaa veesrim shehu rova lechol sea o hotir kach rova lechol sea higgio. yeter al ken yachshov immo al kol harvaim kullan shechasru o hosifu. vechol sheppichet mibbet kor yenakke lo min haddamim vechol shehosif al bet kor yachzir lo:

Uma hu machzir lo. im hayta hattosefet pechuta mittisha kabbin machzir lo damim kishat hammechira leyappot koach hammocher. veim hayta hattosefet semucha lesade acheret shel mocher machzir lo otah hattosefet karka shehare somech otah lishar sedotav veeno mafsid kelum. hayta hattosefet yetera al tisha kabbin notnin rova lechol sea usea. vehannishar yeter al harvaim im yesh bo tisha kabbin noten lo kol harvaim kullan im hayyeter min hakkarka venotno lo keshaa shellekachah mimmennu:

Bamme devarim amurim keshehi bezol bishat mimkar vehokira bishat hachezarat hayyeter. aval im hayta beyoker vehuzela. omrin lallokeach im ratzita litten lo deme hattosefet kullah ten lo damim kefi hammimkar veim ratzita litten lo karka ten lo kemo sheshshave achshav:

Vedin chatzi kav beginna kedin tisha kabbin besade. sheim hotira beginna pachot mechatzi kav al harvaim eno machzir lo ella damim. hotir chatzi kav machzir lo et kol harvaim im hayyeter bedamim o karka kishat hazzol shel et hachazara:
Machar sade venaaset ginna beyad lokeach. o ginna venaaset sade. hare ze safek im mechashshev lo kedin shehayta beet hammecher o kedin shehi atta:

Haomer lachavero bet kor afar ani mocher lecha midda bechevel ben chaser ben yater. o sheamar bet kor ani mocher lecha ben chaser ben yater midda bechevel. hallech achar happachut shebballeshonot veen lo ella kaddin im chaser im yater:

Machar lo bet kor veamar lo bassimanin uvammetzarim. pichet shetut o hotir shetut higgio. pichet yeter al shetut yenakke lo min haddamim. hosif lo yeter al shetut yitten lo damim o karka hakkol lefi hashshiyyur. im hannishar bassade pachot mittisha kabbin uvagginna pachot mechatzi kav velo haya samuch lassade hammocher machzir lo haddamim:

Hammocher lachavero sade shehallokeach yodea otah veet metzareha uchevar hurgal bah. afillu amar lo yesh bimshichatah matayim venimtzet bah mea vachamishshim higgiato shehare yedaah vekibbel alav. veze shehizkir lo hachashivut, kelomar shehi yafa kemo sade acheret sheyyesh bimshichatah matayim:

Haomer lachavero bet kor peloni ani mocher lecha af al pi sheen bimshichato ella letech higgio. shello machar lo ella makom hannikra bet kor. lefichach tzarich hammocher lehavi reaya shehu nikra bet kor. vechen haomer lachavero kerem shelli bemakom peloni ani mocher lecha af al pi sheen bo gefanim higgio vehu sheyyihyu korin oto kerem. vechen haomer lachavero pardes ze ani mocher lecha. afillu en bo rimmonim higgio vehu sheyyikkare pardes. vechen kol kayyotze bahen:
Vechen kol haddevarim haellu bemakom sheen sham minhag kemo shebbearnu. aval bemakom sheyyesh minhag hallech achar hamminhag veachar leshon rov anshe hammakom hayeduim lahen:
Mishneh Torah, Sales 29: Shelosha en mikkachan mikkach veen mimkaran mimkar din tora. hacheresh hashshote vehakkatan. aval chachamim tikkenu sheyyihye hacheresh vehakkatan nose venoten umaasav kayyamin mishshum kede chayyav:

Hacheresh ketzad nose venoten. cheresh sheeno shomea velo medabber o medabber veeno shomea kelum. mocher velokeach hammittaltelin birmiza. aval lo bekarka. veaf bemittaltelin lo yitkayyemu maasav ad shebbodkin oto bedikot rabbot umityashshevin baddavar:

Illem sheshshomea veeno medabber o mi shennishtattek mikkacho mikkach umimkaro mimkar umattenotav kayyamot bakkol. ben bemittaltelin ben bekarka. vehu sheyyivdok kederech shebbodkin legittin o yichtov bichtav yado:
Hashshote en mikkacho mikkach veen mimkaro mimkar veen mattenotav kayyamot. uvet din maamidim appotroppos leshotim kederech shemmaamidin liktannim:

Mi shehu et shote veet shafuy kegon ellu hannichpin. beet shehu shafuy kol maasav kayyamin vezoche leatzmo velaacherim kechol ben daat. utzerichin haedim lachkor haddavar hetev shemma besof shetuto o bitchillat shetuto asa ma sheasa:

Katan ad shesh shanim en hakenayato laacherim kelum. umishshesh shanim ad sheyyagdil im yodea betiv massa umattan mikkacho mikkach umimkaro mimkar umattenato kayyemet. ben bedavar merubbe ben bedavar muat ben bemattenat bari ben bemattenat shechiv mera. vedavar ze middivre chachamim kemo shebbearnu kede shello yibbatel velo yimmatze mi sheyyimkor lo velo yikkach mimmennu. vehakkol bemittaltelin aval bakkarka eno mocher velo noten ad sheyyagdil:

Bamme devarim amurim bekatan sheen lo appotroppos. aval im haya lo appotroppos en maasav kelum afillu bemittaltelin ella middaat haappotroppos. sheim ratza lekayyem mikkacho umimkaro umattenato bemittaltelin kayyam:

Bodkin et hakkatan im yodea betiv massa umattan o eno yodea. lefi sheyyesh katan chacham venavon shehu yodea vehu ben sheva. veyesh acher sheafilu ben shelosh esre eno yodea betiv massa umattan. katan hayyodea betiv massa umattan sheen lo appotroppos shennasa venatan bemittaltelin vetaa dino kedin haggadol. pachot mishshetut mechila. shetut machzir hahonaya. yeter al shetut batel mikkach kemo shebbearnu. vaani omer sheen mikkach hakkatan umimkarav bemittaltelin kayyamin ella beshemmashach o himshich. aval im natan maot al hammikkach vechazar bo eno mekabbel mi sheppara vaacherim shechazru bo mekabbelin mi sheppara:

Vechen im kanu miyyad hakkatan o hiskir mekom hammittaltelin vechazar bo lo kana hallokeach sheen motziin mide hakkatan bedin veen kinyan miyyad hakkatan kelum. shehakkinyan bishtar veen haedim chotmin ella al shetar shel adam gadol:

Vechen katan shekkana mittaltelin vekanu miyyado vesachar mehem hammakom lo kana ad sheyyimshoch. lefi sheeno zoche bidrachim shezzochin bahen haggedolim. reaya laddavar sheen chatzer shel katan velo arba ammot shello konin lo mippene shennitrabbu middin shelichut velo middin yado kemo sheyyitbaer velo yihye hakkinyan o sechirut hammakom gadol mechatzero. aval hakketanna shenitrabbeta chatzerah miyyadah tikne hammittaltelin meacherim im kanu miyyadah o bischirut makom:

Yerae li shekkatan shekkana karka venatan damim vehechezik bakkarka taamod beyado af al pi sheen mimkaro bakkarka kelum shehakkatan kemi sheeno befanenu hu vezachin leadam shello befanav veen chavin lo ella befanav:

Katan shehigdil vehevi hazzachar shete searot achar shelosh esre shana vehabbat achar shetem esre af al pi sheeno yodea betiv massa umattan mikkacho mikkach umimkaro mimkar umattenato mattana bemittaltelin. aval bekarka en maasav kayyamin ad sheyyihye yodea betiv massa umattan achar shehigdil:

Bamme devarim amurim bekarka shello. aval karka sheyyarash meavotav o mishshear morishav en mimkaro mimkar ad sheyyihye ben esrim shana af al pi shehevi shete searot veyodea betiv massa umattan. shemma yimkor bezol mippene sheddato nota achar hammaot vaadayin lo nityashsheva dato bedarche haolam:

Mattenato keshehu pachot mibben esrim ben mattenat bari ben mattenat shechiv mera hare zo kayyemet. sheillu lo higgia lo hanaya gedola lo natan. vehu davar sheeno matzuy tamid. veamru chachamim titkayyem mattenato kede sheyyihyu devarav nishmain:

Bamme devarim amurim shehu mocher karka aviv keshehu ben esrim keshehevi shete searot o keshennoldu lo simane saris. aval im lo hevi shete searot velo naasa saris. katan hu veen mimkaro bakkarka mimkar vaafillu binchasav ad sheyyagdil lerov shenotav:

Mi shemmachar ben binchasav ben benichse aviv umet uvau kerovav veiraru shehaya katan bishat hammecher uvikkeshu levadko en shomin lahem lenavvelo. veod shehassimanim mishtanin bemita. vachazaka hi sheen haedim chotmin al hashshetar ella im ken yadu bevadday shehammocher gadol:

Pachot mibben esrim shemmachar karka aviv chozer umotzi miyyad hallokeach ben kodem esrim ben achar esrim. umotzi min hallokeach kol happerot sheachal. veim hotzi hotzaot o shennata vezara shamin lo umachazir et hashshear. kaddin hazze horu rabbotay. vaani omer sheafillu katan shemmachar karka minnichse aviv ucheshennaasa ben esrim lo micha eno yachol lachzor. shekkevan shellakach hammaot venishtammesh hallokeach bekarka zo lefanav keshehu ben esrim velo micha nitkayyema bide hallokeach shehare ratza bemimkaro:

Hashshikkor mikkacho mikkach umimkaro mimkar umattenotav kayyamin. veim higgia leshichruto shel lot vehu hashshikkor sheose veeno yodea ma ose en maasav kelum vahare hu keshote o kekatan pachot mibben shesh:
Mishneh Torah, Sales 30: Hammocher shemmachar karka o mittaltelin vezacha bahen hallokeach shello middato yad hallokeach al haelyona. veim ratza lokeach en hammocher yachol lachzor bo veim lo ratza tachzor livaleha. lefichach kotvin shetar lammocher af al pi sheen hallokeach immo. uleolam hallokeach noten sechar hassofer vaafillu machar sadehu mippene raatah:

Vechen haeved shekkana o machar o natan mattana o netanah lo. yad haadon al haelyona. im ratza lekayyem maasav hare ellu kayyamin veim lo ratza batlu kol maasav. uvidvarim bilvad hu shemmekayyem haadon o mevattel veeno tzarich liknot mimmennu kelum:

Vechen haishsha shemmachra o natna mattana. ben benichse balah ben benichse tzon barzel shehichnisa lo. ben bidvarim sheyyiched lah bichtubbatah ben benichse melog. ben bekarkaot ben bemittaltelin. vechen im lakcha o nitna [lah mattana] yad habbaal al haelyona veim ratza lekayyem yekayyem im ratza levattel yevattel hakkol. aval habbaal shemmachar o natan ben karka shehichnisa lo ishto bichtubbatah o karka shehichnis lah shum mishshello. ben karka sheyyiched lah bichtubbatah. af al pi shekkanu miyyad haishsha achar shekkiyyema maasav hare kol ma sheasa batel mippene shehi omeret nachat ruach asiti levali:
Machar o natan nichse melog ben bekarkaot ben bemittaltelin yad haishsha al haelyona. ratzta levattel mevattelah veim kiyyema maaseha kanu hallakochot:

Baal shemmachar mittaltelin shel nichse tzon barzel o mittaltelin shennatna lo mishshello af al pi sheeno rashshay im avar umachar o natan kanu hallakochot veen haishsha yechola lehotzi miyyadam. vechen yesh lo labbaal limkor kol nechasav af al pi shehen tachat yad shibud hakketuva. veim tavo litrof torefet ella im ken katva lallokeach techilla vekanu miyyadah:

Haishsha shemmachra o natna nichse tzon barzel levalah lo kana. veyesh lah lachzor ulehotzi miyyado kemo shebbearnu behilchot ishut. bet din shemmachru o lakchu benichse yetomim ben bekarka ben bemittaltelin. vechen haappotropposin ben shemminnu otam bet din ben shemminna otan avi yetomim. mikkachan mikkach umimkaran mimkar aval mattenatam enah kelum sheen adam noten davar sheeno shello:

Hammocher o hannoten beshabbat veen tzarich lomar bayyom tov af al pi shemmakkin oto maasav kayyamin. vechen kol mi shekkanu miyyado beshabbat hakkinyan kayyam vechotvin leachar hashshabbat venotnin: seliku lehu hilchot mechira besad
Mishneh Torah, Ownerless Property and Gi:
Hahefker kol hammachazik bo zacha. vechen hammidbarot vehanneharot vehannechalim kol shebbahen hefker vechol hakkodem bahen zacha. kegon haasavim vehaetzim vehapperot shel ilanot shel yaar vechayyotze bahen: 
Hatztzad dagim min hayyamim umin hanneharot. o shetztzad ofot o mine chayyot. hoil veen lahem bealim zacha. uvilvad shello yatzud bisde chavero. veim tzad sham kana. veim hayu haddagim babbevarim shel bealim vechen chayya veof shebbabbevarim. af al pi shehu bevar gadol vehu mechussar tzida hare ze shel baal habbevarim vehatztzad mishsham hare ze gazlan: 
Aval hallokeach dagim mittoch metzudato shel chavero keshehu betoch hayyam. o shellakach chayya mimmetzudato keshehi perusa bammidbar hare ze asur middivre sofrim. veim haya hammetzuda keli velakach mittoch hammetzuda hare ze gazlan: 
Happores metzuda bisde chavero vetzad bah chayya o of af al pi sheen lo reshut laasot davar ze kana. veim haya omed baal hassade betoch sadehu veamar zachta li sadi kana baal hassade. veen levaal hammetzuda kelum: 
Dagim shekkaftzu letoch hassefina kana baal hassefina. shezzo kechatzer hammishtammeret hi veenah chatzer hamehallechet. shehammayim hen shemmolichin otah veenah holechet mechamat atzmah: 
Ger shemmet velo holid yisrael achar shennitgayyer en lo yorshin ella kol hakkodem vehechezik binchasav zacha. veen baal hammetzar yachol lesalleko bedamim shezzo kemattana hi: 
Shete sadot benichse hagger umetzar echad benehen. hechezik beachat mehen liknotah kenaah. hechezik bah liknot otah veet chavertah. zo shehechzik bah kana aval chavertah lo kana. hechezik bah kede liknot et chavertah lo kana achat mehen. chavertah mippene shello hechezik bah. veotah mippene shello hechezik bah kede liknotah. hechezik bah kede liknotah veliknot et chavertah veet hammetzar shebbenehen. o shehechzik bammetzar liknot shetehen hare ze safek. veim ba echad vehechezik bah kede liknotah zacha haacharon: 
Vechen shene battim ze lefanim mizze shehechzik beechad mehen liknoto veliknot et hashsheni lo kana ella ze shehechzik bo bilvad. hechezik beechad mehen kede liknot et hashsheni af ze shehechzik bo lo kana: 
Hammachazik bishtar minnichse hagger kede liknot et hakkarka hakketuva beoto shetar lo kana ella hashshetar bilvad latzur al pi tzelochito vechayyotze baze: 
Sade hametzuyyenet bimtzareha kevan shehikkish bah makkosh echad kana et kullah. veim enah metzuyyenet bimtzareha kone mimmenna beoto makkosh kede sheyyelech hatztzemed bishat charisha veyachzor. hammetzar vehechatzav shemmetachamin bo techumin mafsikin benichse hagger. vechol hammachazik besade lo kana ella ad hammetzar o ad hechatzav: 
Kol hammafsik lefea mafsik benichse hagger. ketzad. haya sham nachal o ammat hammayim vechayyotze bahen lo kana ella ad hannachal o ad haamma. vechol hammafsik birshut shabbat mafsik benichse hagger kegon shehaya ben shete hassadot reshut hayyachid o karmelit afillu haya benehem reshut shecholeket legittin: 
Kol davar hammafsik letuma mafsik benichse hagger. ketzad. kegon shennichnas adam levika zo vetuma babbika betziddah acheret veeno yodea im higgia limkom hattuma im lav. kol makom shemmachazikin oto letuma hare hu kemakom acher, muchlak bifne atzmo: 
Bika gedola sheyyesh bah sadot rabbot vechullan shel ger echad velo haya benehen lo metzar velo chatzav velo davar middevarim hammafsikin. uva echad vehechezik bemiktzat habbika liknot et kullah. kol hannikra al shem oto hagger kone oto: 
Akkum shemmachar mittaltelin leyisrael o kana mittaltelin miyyisrael. kone bimshicha umakne bimshicha o bedamim. aval hakkarka eno kone oto miyyisrael ella bishtar veeno makne oto leyisrael ella bishtar sheen dato somechet ella al hashshetar. lefichach yisrael shellakach sade min haakkum venatan haddamim. vekodem sheyyachzik bah ba yisrael acher vehechezik bah kederech shemmachazikin benichse hagger zacha acharon venoten larishon et haddamim. mippene shehaakkum meet shellakach haddamim sillek reshuto veyisrael lo kana ad sheyyaggia hashshetar leyado. venimtzeu nechasim ellu kenichse midbar shekkol hammachazik bahen zacha: 
Bamme devarim amurim bemakom sheen mishpat yadua lammelech. aval im din oto hammelech umishpato shello yizke bakkarka ella mi shekkotev bishtar o hannoten damim vechayyotze bidvarim ellu. osin kefi mishpat hammelech. shekkol dine hammelech bemamon al pihen danin:

Nichse ger sheen lo yorshim. venichse hahefker vesade shemmecharah haakkum leyisrael vaadayin lo hechezik bah. kullam dinam shave. kol hammachazik bahem bederech middarche hachazaka kemo shebbearnu behilchot mechira kana chutz meachilat happerot:

Ketzad. hallokeach karka mechavero vehechezik bah baachilat peroteha kana kemo shebbearnu. aval benichse hefker o nichse hagger afillu achal perot hailan kamma shanim lo kana guf hailan velo guf hakkarka ad sheyyaase maase beguf haaretz o yaavod avoda bailan. umaase beishsha achat sheachla perot dekel shelosh esre shana uva echad vehechezik bailan baavoda sheavad beguf hailan uva maase lifne chachamim veamru ze haacharon kana:

Yesh devarim rabbim sheim hechezik bahen hallokeach lo kana adayin. veim hechezik beechad mehen benichse hagger o benichse hefker kana. ketzad. hammotze palterim gedolim benuyin benichse hagger o benichse hefker vesiyyed bahen siyyud echad o kiyyer bahen kiyyur echad kegon amma o yoter keneged happetach kana:

Hatztzar tzura benichse hagger kana. vehammatztzia matztzaot benichse hagger kana. hannar et hassade benichse hagger kana. hamefatztzel zemorot haggefen o sarige ilanot vechappot temarim benichse hagger. im dato laavod hailan kana. veim dato lehaachil haetzim livhema lo kana:

Ketzad. haya koret mikkan umikkan hare chezkato shennitkavven laavodat hailan. haya koret meruach achat eno mitkavven ella laetzim. vechen hamelakket etzim vaasavim vaavanim min hassade. im dato letakken haaretz kana. veim laetzim lo kana:

Ketzad. likket haggas vehaddak hare zo bechezkat shennitkavven letakken et haaretz. likket haggas velo haddak hare ze bechezkat shennitkavven laetzim. vechen hammashve pene haaretz. im dato letakken haaretz kana. veim dato lehashevot makom sheyyaamid bo goren lo kana:

Ketzad. haya lokeach afar mimmakom gavoah venotno lammakom hannamuch hare ze metakken haaretz. reinuhu sheeno makpid al ze ella mashlich heafar vehatztzerorot bechol makom belo hakepada hare ze bechezkat sheeno mitkavven ella lehashevot makom ledayish. vechen happoteach mayim letoch haaretz. im letakken haaretz kana. veim latzud haddagim lo kana:
Ketzad. asa makom sheyyikkansu bo hammayim bilvad hare ze mitkavven letakken haaretz. asa shene petachim echad lehachenis veechad lehotzi hare ze mitkavven latzud dagim:

Habbone palterin gedolim benichse hagger uva acher veheemid lahem delatot kana haacharon. sheharishon lo asa beguf haaretz kelum. vahare hu kemi sheasa gal avanim al haaretz sheeno kone. shehare lo hoil begader ze mippene shehu rachav beyoter umefullash. veen tzurat oto habbinyan moelet lo ad sheyyaamid delatot:
Hammefitz hazzera letoch hattelamim lo kana. shebbeet shehishlich hazzera lo hishbiach kelum uveet shetztzamach vehishbiach shevach habba meelav hu veeno kone:

Hayta mechitztza benichse hagger uva ze veasa mechitztza acheret al gabbah lo kana. vaafillu nivlea mechitztza hattachtona vahare haelyona kayyemet. shebbeet shebbana lo hoil uveet shehoil meelav ba hammaase:
Hammachazik benichse hagger uvehefker vehu en dato liknot. af al pi shebbana vegadar lo kana:
Haoder benichse hagger vechassavur shehen shello lo kana. adar benichse ger ze uchesavur shel ger acher. hoil venitkavven bemaasav ellu lizkot min hahefker hare ze kana:
Haya mashkon yisrael beyad hagger ucheshemmet hagger ba yisrael acher vehechezik bemashkon ze. motziin oto miyyado. shekkevan shemmet hagger batel shibudo:
Haya mashkon hagger beyad yisrael uva yisrael acher vehechezik bo. lokeach mimmennu harishon keneged meotav vehaacharon kana et hashshear:
Bamme devarim amurim beshello haya hammashkon bachatzar harishon. aval im haya bachatzero chatzero kona lo shello middato kemo shebbearnu beinyan metzia. veen leze haacharon kelum:

Ger shemmet uvizbezu yisrael et nechasav vehayu bahen avadim gedolim. kanu atzman bene chorin. aval haavadim hakketannim hare hen kivhema vechol hammachazik bahen zacha bahem. uchevar bearnu darche hachazaka sheyyiknu bahem et haavadim:

Ger shemmet uvizbezu yisrael et nechasav. veshamu sheadayin lo met o sheyyesh lo ben o sheishto meubberet. kullan chayyavin lehachezir. hechziru kullan veachar kach shamu shemmet sheshshemua rishona emet hayta uvarishona met. o met beno mikkodem o hippila ishto. kol hammachazik bashsheniyya kana uvarishona lo kana:

Hannoten mattana lachavero en hamekabbel zoche bah ella beechad min hadderachim shehakkone zoche bahen bemikkacho. im mittaltelin rotze litten lo ad sheyyagbiah o sheyyimshoch davar sheen darko lehagebiah o yikne beechad mishshear haddevarim shehammittaltelin niknin bahen. veim karka o avadim natan lo ad sheyyachzik kederech shemmachzik hallokeach o ad sheyyaggia shetar mattana leyado. aval bidvarim lo zacha hamekabbel ella kol echad mehen adayin yachol lachzor bo: 
Machal lachavero chov sheyyesh lo alav. o natan lo happikkadon shehaya mufkad etzlo. hare zo mattana hanniknet bidvarim bilvad. veen tzarich davar acher kemo shebbearnu: 
Vechen haomer lachavero mane sheyyesh li beyadcha tenehu laze kana. veen echad mehen yachol lachzor bo. ben shennatan hammane bechov sheyyesh lo etzlo ben shennetano lo mattana ben shehaya chov etzlo ben shehaya pikkadon etzlo kemo shebbearnu: 
Keshem sheen tzerichim edim leinyan mikkach umimkar ella legallot haddavar bilvad im hayta sham taana uchefira. kach bimchilot umattanot en tzerichin edim ella mippene hameshakkerim: 
Keshem shemmocher tzarich lesayyem hammimkar kemo shebbearnu kach hannoten. ketzad. hakkotev lachavero karka minnechasay netuna lecha. o shekkatav lo kol nechasay kenuyin lecha chutz mimmiktzatan. hoil velo siyyem haddavar shennatan lo veeno yadua lo kana kelum. veeno yachol lomar lo ten li pachut shebbinchasecha ad shessiyyem lo hammakom shennatan lo. aval im amar lo chelek kach vechach besade pelonit hoil vesiyyem hassade af al pi shello siyyem hachelek notel oto chelek min happachut shebbeotah sade: 
Kol hannoten mattana al tenay. ben shehitna noten ben shehitna hamekabbel. vehechezik hamekabbel vezacha bah. im nitkayyem hattenay nitkayyem hammattana veim lo nitkayyem hattenay betela hammattana veyachzir perot sheachal. vehu sheyyihye hattenay karauy: 
Kevar bearnu shekkol tenain sheyyesh bemattanot o bemikkach umimkar tzarich sheyyihye tenay kaful. vehen kodem lelav. utenay kodem lemaase. veyihye tenay sheefshar lekayyemo. veim chaser echad meellu hattenain batel ucheillu en sham tenay: 
Vechol haomer al menat keomer meachshav dami veeno tzarich lichpol hattenay. kach horu miktzat haggeonim velaze dati nota. verabbotay horu sheen tzarich lichpol hattenay ulehakdim hen lelav ella begittin uvekiddushin bilvad. veen ledavar ze reaya: 
Hannoten mattana al menat lehachezir hare zo mattana. ben shehitna lehachezir miyyad ben shehitna lehachezirah lizman katzuv. o kol yeme chayyav shel echad mehem. o kol yeme chayyav shel peloni. hare zo mattana ben bemittaltelin ben bekarka. veochel perot kol zeman hammattana: 
Haomer lachavero shor ze ani noten lecha bemattana al menat shettachzirehu. hikdisho vehecheziro hare ze mukdash umuchzar. amar lo al menat shettachzirehu li eno kadosh. shello hitna alav ella sheyyachzir davar harauy lo. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Asur leyisrael litten leakkum mattenat chinnam. aval noten hu leger toshav. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 21)</small> "lagger asher bisharecha tittenenna vaachalah o machor lenachri", bimchira velo bemattana. aval leger toshav ben bimchira ben bintina mippene sheatta metzuvve lehacheyoto. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 la)</small> "ger vetoshav vachay immach": 
Hannoten mattana leeved o leishsha kana habbaal vehaadon. ella shehaadon kone lagguf vehabbaal kone otah leferot: 
Natan mattana leishsha al menat sheen levalah reshut bah. uleeved al menat sheen lerabbo reshut bo. kana haadon vekana habbaal. aval hannoten mattana leishsha o leeved vehitna immahen hannoten begufah shel mattana shettihye lechach vechach. lo kana haadon velo kana habbaal: 
Ketzad. hannoten mattana leishsha veamar lah hare hammaot haellu netunim lecha bemattana al menat shettilbeshi bahen o al menat shettishti bahem vetaasi ma shettirtzi belo reshut habbaal. lo kana habbaal. vechen im amar leeved al menat shettochal bahen vetishte bahen. al menat shettetze bahem lecherut. o al menat shettaase bahem kol ma shettirtze belo reshut adon shellecha. lo kana haadon. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hannoten kol nechasav leavdo kana atzmo veyatza ben chorin vekana shear hannechasim. veim shiyyer kol shehu afillu mittaltelin lo kana kelum sheen ze get cherut gamur shehare shiyyer bo beget umittoch shello nishtachrer lo kana kelum:

Hamekabbel et hammattana vezacha bah. veachar shebbaa leyado vehu shotek chazar bo veamar eni rotze bah. o eni mekabbelah. o hare hi betela. o sheamar mum ze nire li bah. lo amar kelum. ucheshem sheen hannoten yachol lachzor bo kach hamekabbel eno yachol lachzor bo achar shezzacha. mattana zo sheamar hamekabbel eni rotze bah achar shebbat leyado hare hi hefker vechol hakkodem bah zacha bah shehare hifkirah hamekabbel achar shezzacha bah. aval im haya tzoveach meikkaro lo kana hamekabbel vechozeret labbealim harishonim: 
Hamezakke lachavero bemattana al yede acher kevan shehechzik bah acher kegon shemmashach hammittaltelin o higgia shetar hakkarka leyado o hechezik bakkarka zacha chavero af al pi shello higgia hammattana leyado veen hannoten yachol lachzor bo. aval hamekabbel yado al haelyona im ratza mekabbel im lo ratza eno mekabbel shezzachin leadam shello befanav veen chavin lo ella befanav uzechut hu shettinnaten lo mattana im yirtze. aval im lo yirtze en notnin mattana leadam beal karcho: 
Zikka lo al yede acher uchesheshshama hamekabbel shatak veachar kach tzavach veamar eni mekabbelah. hare ze safek im ze sheshshatak kevar ratza veze shechazar vetzavach chazar bo. o sheshshatak mippene sheadayin lo higgia leyado kelum veze shetztzavach hochiach sofo al techillato. lefichach im kadam acher vezacha bah leatzmo en motziin miyyado. shemma hamekabbel zacha vechevan sheamar eni rotze bah hare hifkirah kemo shebbearnu. veze shekkadam ulekachah min hahefker zacha. veim chazru habbealim harishonim utefasuha miyyad ze shekkadam vezacha bah en motziin otah miyyadam. shemma hamekabbel lo zacha vechevan sheamar eni rotze hochiach sofo al techillato velo kana otah uvirshut bealim harishonim hi kayyemet adayin: 
Reuven sheratza litten mea dinarin leshimon veshalach lo hammea al yede levi. im amar lo zeche bemea zuz leshimon. o ten mea zuz leshimon. eno yachol lachzor bo. aval im amar lo holech mea zuz leshimon yachol lachzor bo ad sheyyaggia hammea leyad shimon: 
Halach levi bemea zuz shennishtallechu immo leholichan leshimon uvikkesh shimon velo metzaahu yachzir liruven. met shimon bechayye reuven yachzir liruven o leyorshav. met reuven bechayye shimon yitten hammea leshimon o leyorshav shemmitzva lekayyem divre hammet veaf al pi sheamar haddevarim vehu bari. shehare hammea beyado shel shaliach adayin: 
En adam zoche bemattana lachavero ad sheyyihye hazzoche gadol uven daat. veechad ish veechad ishsha vaafillu eshet ish veeved veshifcha. aval haakkum eno zoche hoil veen rauy lishlichut leolam kach eno zoche leyisrael. ucheshem sheen yisrael naase shaliach leakkum kach eno zoche leakkum: 
Katan shennotnin lo tzeror vezorko egoz venotlo zoche leatzmo veeno zoche laacherim. pachot mizze lo zacha leatzmo velo laacherim. vechen hashshote eno zoche lo lo velo laacherim. vehamezakke leshote al yede ben daat zacha. aval hacheresh zoche leatzmo kemo shebbearnu behilchot gezela: 
Zachin lekatan afillu ben yom echad. ulegadol ben befanav ben shello befanav. vachatzero shel adam kona lo shello middato af al pi sheeno omed sham kevan shehiggia hammattana lachatzero keillu zacha bah acher: 
Bamme devarim amurim bechatzer hammishtammeret. aval bechatzer sheenah mishtammeret kegon sadehu vechurbato ad sheyyihye omed betziddah veyomar zachta li sadi. vechen arba ammot shel adam shehu omed betziddan konin lo besimta o betzidde reshut harabbim o bechatzer sheen lah bealim. aval birshut harabbim o bisde chavero eno zoche ad sheyyaggia mattana leyado. uketanna tizke lah chatzerah vearba ammot shellah. aval hakkatan eno zoche ad shettaggia mattana leyado o ad sheyyizke lo acher: 
Hammattana keget, sheen adam yachol limsor devarim leshaliach. ketzad. amar lishlosha imru lifloni ufeloni sheyyichtevu veyachtemu bishtar mattana veyittenuha lifloni en ze kelum. veim amru leotan haedim vechatvu venatnu lamkabbel lo kana. vechen im amar lishnayim kitvu vechitmu bishtar mattana utenuhu lifloni enan yecholin lomar lassofer lichtov ella hen atzman kotvin kemo beget: 
Hakkotev bishtar natatti sade pelonit lifloni. o shekkatav netattiha lo o hare hi shello. hare zoche bah kesheyyaggia hashshetar leyado. aval im katav bashshetar ettenenna lo. af al pi sheheidu alav haedim. lo zacha hamekabbel ad sheyyomar laedim kitvu shetar mattana utenu lo vechotvin venotnin lo. sheen hamekabbel zoche ad sheyyaggia shetar hammattana leyado o ad sheyyizke lo bo al yede acherim kemo shebbearnu: 
Haomer natatti sade pelonit lifloni vehu omer lo natan li. choshshin shemma zikka lo al yede acher. aval im amar katavti venatatti lo vehu omer lo katav velo natan li. im hamekabbel mattana hu sheamar ken. hodaat baal din kemea edim hu vehannoten ochel perot sadehu. veim ben hamekabbel hu sheamar lo natatta leavi sade zo vehu omer katavti venatatti lo. mannichin et happerot al yede shalish ad sheyyivvada haddavar heach hu: 
Mekabbel mattana shettaan veamar zo shettachat yadi enah mattana beyadi ella shomer ani aleha vechayyotze bo. o sheamar betela hayta mittechillatah lefi shello kibbaltiha o beal karchi beones o betaut vechayyotze bidvarim ellu devarav kayyamin. venishba al ze shevuat hesset vetachzor livaleha: 
Taan hannoten veamar shomer atta aleha o sheamar shello middati netattiha o gezula hi beyadcha veze omer atta natatta li. nishba hamekabbel shevuat hesset veniftar:

Hannoten mattana ben bari ben chole tzarich shettihye geluya umefursemet. amar leedim kitvu basseter utenu lo enah kelum. shezze maarim kede leabbed mamon acherim sheyyachazor veyimkor achar sheyyitten: 
Lefichach kol shetar mattenat karka sheen katuv bo veamar lanu peloni hannoten shevu bashshevakim uvarchovot vechitvu lo mattana geluya umefursemet vechayyotze beinyanim ellu choshshin lah shemma mattana mesutteret hi velo zacha hamekabbel: 
Hakkotev shete mattanot al sade achat harishona mesutteret vehaacharona geluya umefursemet acharon kana vaafillu hayta harishona setam veen bah lo inyan setira velo inyan gilluy ella mattana setam haacharon kana: 
Kevar bearnu shehammoser modaa veachar kach natan hammattana betela af al pi sheen ze ones. sheen holchin bemattana ella achar daat hannoten. hoil vegilla dato sheeno rotze bah mattenato betela. lefichach mi shehayu haddevarim mochichin sheen dato litten mattana zo afillu shennetanah mattana geluya venimtzet shennittena mikkodem mattana mesutteret hare shete hammattanot betelot. harishona mippene shehi mesutteret. vehashsheniyya mippene shehaddavar mochiach sheeno rotze vahare kadma zo hammattana shennimtzea kemo modaa lah: 
Maase beechad sheratza lissa ishsha. amra lo eni nisset lecha ad shettichtov li kol nechasecha. shama beno haggadol vetzavach al shemmannicho rekan. amar laedim lechu vehechavu vechitvu lo kol nechasay bemattana. veachar kach katav lah kol nechasav unesaah. uva maase lifne chachamim veamru habben lo kana vehaishsha lo kanta. shehare lo birtzono katav lah ucheanus baddavar hu. shehare gilla dato bammattana harishona af al pi shehi betela mippene shehi mesutteret. vechen kol kayyotze beinyanim ellu: 
Shene shetarot shezzemannan beyom echad vehen ketuvin al sade achat ben bemecher ben bemattana. im derech anshe hammakom lichtov shaot kol hakkodem zacha. veim en derech hammakom lichtov shaot hare haddavar masur laddayyanim. kol sheddatam nota lehaamid sade zo beyado yaamidu: 
Bamme devarim amurim bishtar sheen bo kinyan ella kana sade zo bishtar ze. sheen anu yodin mi hu mishshenehem shehiggia shetaro leyado techilla. aval im haya bechol shetar mehen kinyan kol shekkadam lo hakkinyan zacha veyishalu haedim. vechen im hayu sham edim shezze higgia leyado shetar mattenato techilla kana harishon: 
Shene shetarot hayyotzim al sade achat beshem kone echad veen zemannam shave. im haya shetar echad mecher veechad mattana. im haya hashshetar harishon mattana vehashsheni sheacharav mecher lo bittel haacharon et harishon. sheyyesh lomar lehosif lo acharayut chazar vechatav beshem mecher af al pi shello haya kotev sham acharayut sheacharayut taut sofer hu. vechen im harishon mecher vehashsheni mattana kana hassade mizzeman rishon. shello katav lo shetar mattana ella leyappot kocho umishshum din ben hammetzar: 
Hayu shene hashshetarot bemecher o shenehem bemattana. im hosif bashsheni kelum hare harishon kayyam shello katav hashsheni ella mippene hattosefet. veim lo hosif bittel shetar sheni et harishon veen lo acharayut ella mizzeman hashsheni. lefichach kol happerot sheachal hallokeach mizzeman rishon ad zeman sheni machzir otam. veim haya al otah sade chok lammelech bechol shana. hannoten o hammocher noten oto hachok ad zeman hashshetar hashsheni:

Leolam omdin daat hannoten. im hayu haddevarim marin sof dato osin al pi haomed af al pi shello peresh. ketzad. mi shehalach beno limdinat hayyam veshama shemmet vechatav kol nechasav leacher mattana geluya gemura veachar kach ba beno en mattenato kayyemet. shehaddevarim mochichin sheillu yada shebbeno kayyam lo haya noten kol nechasav. lefichach im shiyyer minnechasav kol shehu ben karka ben bemittaltelin mattenato kayyemet: 
Vechen hakkotev kol nechasav mattana leechad mibbanav ben shehaya bari ben shehaya shechiv mera. afillu haya ben katan hammuttal baarisa lo asahu ella appotroppos. vahare hu bechol hannechasim keechad meechav. umdan daat hu shello nitkavven ella lihyot echav nishmain lo. veim shiyyer kol shehu ben karka ben bemittaltelin zacha habben bemattana: 
Bamme devarim amurim shekkatav leven ben habbanim. aval im katav kol nechasav leven ben habbanot o levat ben habbanot o leechad min hayyorshin ben shear hayyorshin. af al pi shello shiyyer kelum mattenato kayyemet: 
Vechen hakkotev kol nechasav leishto ben bari ben shechiv mera af al pi shekkanu miyyado lo asaah ella appotroppa al yorshav. ben shehayu yorshe banav mimmenna o meishsha acheret o echav o shear yorshav. veim shiyyer kol shehu ben karka ben mittaltelin kanta kol shekkatav lah: 
Bamme devarim amurim binsua. aval im katav kol nechasav leishto arusa o ligrusha af al pi shello shiyyer kelum hare hi kishar bene adam umattenato kayyemet: 
Hakkotev kol nechasav leechad mibbanav uleacher. ze haacher kana chatzi hannechasim bemattana. venishar hachetzi levanav. vehabben shennatnu lo appotroppos minnahu al shear echav: 
Vechen im katav kol nechasav leishto uleacher. ze haacher kana mechetza veishto appotroppa al mechetza: 
Kol ishsha shekkanta kol nichse balah bemattana. ibbeda ketubbatah vetikkara. lefichach im yatza shetar chov alav vehalchu kol hannechasim bechovo shekkadam hammattana tishshaer hi belo kelum velo tikkach bichtubbatah shekkadma hachov. sheumdan daat hu shebbahanaa shebbaa lah bishmua zo shekkatav lah kol nechasav ibbeda kol zechut sheyyesh lah bannechasim chutz mimmattana zo: 
Vechen hakkotev nechasav levanav ben zecharim ben nekevot ben bari ben shechiv mera vechatav leishto immahen karka kol shehu. hoil veasa otah shuttaf ben habbanim velo machata ibbeda ketubbatah veenah torefet minnechasim ellu kelum. aval minnechasav sheyyavou lo achar ellu notelet mehen ketubbatah: 
Katav lah immahen mittaltelin bilvad o sheshshiyyer leatzmo karka kol shehu. ketubbatah kayyemet. vetakkanat haggeonim hi sheafilu shiyyer mittaltelim kol shehu. shehare hi omeret mimma sheshshiyyer ani gova umittoch shettered lema sheshshiyyer tered lishar nechasim vetitrof: 
Hakkotev kol nechasav levanav vechatav leishto chelek immahen. umet echad min habbanim bechayye aviv. hare zo tigbe ketubbatah mechelek ze shemmet. shello ibbeda ketubbatah ella millitrof mehen: 
Harotza lehinnase vechatva kol nechaseha ben livnah ben leacher. veachar kach nisset venitgarsha o shemmet balah. mattenatah betela shezzo mavrachat hi velo katva kol nechaseha ella lehaveriach mibbalah shello yirashenna. ucheshettihye tzericha lahen yachzeru lah. lefichach im meta hi bechayye balah kana hamekabbel mattana et hakkol. veim shiyyera kelum afillu mittaltelin mattenatah kayyemet veaf al pi shennitgarsha enah chozeret: 
Kol hannotnin kol nichsehem. mishshettibbatel hammattana veyachzeru kol hannechasin labbealim harishonim en hamekabbel mattana machzir perot. sheafilu natan haadam mattana beferush al menat lehachezir kol yeme chayye peloni hare ze ochel perot kol zeman hammattana kemo shebbearnu: 
Mi sheshshalach kelim mimmedinat hayyam veamar yinnatnu ellu levanay. hare ellu yinnatnu labbanim velabbanot. harauy labbanim kegon sefarim uchele milchama labbanim. veharauy labbanot kegon kele meshi hatztzevuim vachali zahav yittelum habbanot. hayu reuyin lizcharim velinkevot yittelu otan hazzecharim. vechen hameshalleach kelim leveto setam vehayu bahen kelim haruyin levanot. yittelu otan benotav. umdan daat hu shellahen shalach. veim en lo banot o shehayu benotav nesuot. yittelu otan neshe banav. shehaddaat nota shellahen shalach: 
Hammassi beno gadol livtula babbayit kana habbayit. vehu sheyyihyu nissuin rishonim leze habben. velo hissi haav ben acher kodem lo velo shiyyer haav beze habbayit sheyyiched lo kelum. udevarim ellu kahalacha sheen lahem taam hem. venagu chachamim baddavar hazze meumdan haddaat. shemmerov simchato veahavato gamar vehiknahu habbayit. shehare lo shiyyer bah leatzmo kelum. lefichach im shiyyer sham afillu pach echad lo kana habbayit. yiched lo bayit uchele bayit af al pi sheshshiyyer babbayit keli echad leatzmo o haya lo sham otzar vechayyotze bo. kana kele habbayit aval habbayit lo kana: 
Yiched lo bayit vaaliyya. bayit kana aliyya lo kana. vechen im yiched lo bayit veachsadra bayit kana achsadra lo kana. shene battim ze lefanim mizze lo kana ella haechad shennasa bo: 
Kevar bearnu benissuin sheshshenayim shehaya benehem shidduchin ufasak ze al yede beno veze al yede bitto. veamru kamma atta noten levincha. kach vechach. vechamma atta noten levittecha. kach vechach. veamdu vekiddeshu. kanu baamira. veen konin baamira zo ad sheat nissuin shekkol happosek dato lichnos. utzerichin sheyyihyu haddevarim shehen poskin metzuyin birshuto. sheen adam makne davar shello ba laolam kemo shebbearnu. udevarim ellu lo nittenu lehikkatev. lefichach enan kishtar ad sheyyitrof bahen: 
Hamekaddesh et haishsha. afillu kiddeshah beelef dinar. ben shechazra hi ben shechazar hu. ben shemmet hu ben shemmeta hi. en hakkiddushin chozrin leolam. ella hare hen mattana gemura sheen lahem chazara: 
Veim hayu kiddushe taut chozrin hammaot: 
Vhamekaddesh achoto hammaot mattana. adam yodea sheen kiddushin tofsin baarayot veen ze toe ella gamar venatan leshem mattana: 
Hashsholeach sivlonot levet chamiv ben merubbin ben muatin. ben sheachal sham seudat erusin ben shello achal. ben shemmet hu ben shemmeta hi. o shechazar bo haish. yachzeru hassivlonot kullan chutz min hammaachol vehammashke: 
Vechen kelim muatim sheshshalach lah lehishtammesh sham bevet aviha. im nishtammesha bahen uvalu o avdu enan mishtallemin. aval im hayu kayyamin chozer hakkol vegove otam bevet din. shehaddavar yadua shello shelacham ella derech noy bilvad: 
Chazra hi bah chozer hakkol. vaafillu hammaachol vehammashke notenet damav bezol. uchevar hiskimu haggeonim sheim hayu deme maachol umashke [shave] shishsha mishtallemet arbaa im chazra bah. shello natan lah mattana zo ella ledaat shello tachzor bah: 
Horu rabbotay sheim haya minhag hammedina sheyyaase kol adam seuda veyaachil lereav o yechallek maot lashshammashin velachazzanin vechayyotze bahen veasa kederech sheosin kol haam vechazra bah meshallemet hakkol. shehare garma lo leabbed mamon vechol haggorem leabbed mamon chavero meshallem. vehu sheyyihyu lo edim kamma hotzi. sheen ze nishba venotel:

Minnehag pashut berov hammedinot shebbizman sheyyissa adam ishsha meshallechin lo reav umeyuddaav maot kede sheyyitchazzek bahen al hahotzaa shemmotzi beishto. uvaim otan hareim vehameyuddaim sheshshalchu lo veochlin veshotin im hechatan beshivat yeme hammishte o bemiktzatan. hakkol keminhag hammedina. veellu hammaot shemmeshallechin nikrain shoshvinut. veotam sheshshalchu hammaot veochlin veshotin im hechatan nikraim shoshvinin:

Hashshoshvinut enah mattana gemura. haddevarim yeduim shello shalach ze asara dinarin bishvil sheyyochal veyishte baze velo shalach ella mippene shebbedato haya sheim yissa hu ishsha yachzor veyishlach lo kemo sheshshalach lo. lefichach im nasa ze ishsha velo hechzir lo hashshoshvinut hare ze tovo bedin umotzi mimmennu:

Veen yachol letavo ad sheyyissa kederech shennasa hu. ketzad. reuven shennasa betula veshshalach lo shimon shoshvinut veachar kach nasa shimon almana. eno yachol litboa lehachezir lo hashshoshvinut shehare omer lo eni machzir lecha ella bivtula kemo shennatatta li. vechen im shalach lo benissue almana eno yachol letavo lehachezir lo benissue betula:
Asa reuven mishte begaluy uvefarhesya veasa shimon betzina. o sheasa reuven betzina veshimon befarhesya eno yachol letavo. shehare omer lo eni ose immecha ella kederech sheasita immi:

Reuven shennasa ishsha veshalach lo shimon shoshvinut veachal veshata immo veachar kach nasa shimon kenissue reuven atzman uva reuven veachal veshata immo. o shekkara lo shimon velo ratza lavo. o shehaya bammedina veshama kol tavla bemakom sheen darkan likrot echad echad ella kol hashshomea yavo. veshama velo ba. chayyav lehachezir lo hashshoshvinut kullah. shehare yada velo ba o kara lo bemakom sheddarkan likrot echad echad velo ba:

Lo haya reuven bammedina menakkin lo deme ma sheachal veshata shimon etzlo umachazir lo shear hashshoshvinut. vechen im haya bammedina velo keraahu o lo hodio menakkin lo veyesh lo alav taromet mippene shello hodio:

Vechamma menakkin. nahagu benikkuy im dinar echad shalach lo shimon eno machzir lo kelum shehare ze deme ma sheachal. veim yitter al haddinar ad sela menakke lo mechetza. missela ulemala omdin daat hameshalleach:
Veshiur hashshoshvinut im adam chashuv menakke lo mechetza. veim tzar ayin umedakdek behotzaato eno menakke lo ella shiur ma sheachal veshata umeshallem lo hashshear:
Met shimon kodem sheyyissa ishsha o shennasa umet betoch yeme hammishte en reuven chayyav lehachezir leyorshe shimon kelum shehare omer lahem tenu li shoshvini veesmach immo:

Lefichach im samach immo veachar kach met shimon. o kara lo velo ba o shello haya bammedina o shello hodio. hoil veshalmu yeme hammishte veachar kach met shimon. chayyav reuven lehachezir hashshoshvinut leyorshav o kullah o benikkuy im lo hodio o lo haya immo bammedina:

Met reuven veachar kach nasa shimon ishsha veshalmu yeme hammishte. makom shennahagu ligbot hashshoshvinut miyyorshin kofin yorshe reuven lehachezir benikkuy. umakom shello nahagu en hayyorshin meshallemin kelum:

Met reuven achar shennasa shimon ishsha veshalmu yeme hammishte. kofin et yorshav umeshallemin hashshoshvinut bechol makom. shehare nitchayyev avihen leshallem. veim kullah haya chayyav leshallem meshallemin kullah. veim benikkuy meshallemin benikkuy:

Chamishsha devarim neemru bashshoshvinut. nigbet bevet din sheenah ella kemo milve. veenah mishtallemet ella beonatah keen nissue rishon. shezze kemo tenay hu af al pi shello peresh sheal daat ze shelachah. veen bah mishshum ribbit. afillu shalach lo dinar vehechzir lo asara muttar shello al menat lehosif lo shalach. veen hashsheviit meshammattah sheeno yachol liggosho oto uletavo ad sheyyissa kederech shennasa hu. veen habbechor notel bah pi shenayim keshettachzor layyorshin mippene shehu rauy veen habbechor notel barauy kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo:

Hashsholeach teshura lachavero. o shennatan lo maot keshemmata yado vehu memaen likkach. veze nishba shei efshar shello tikkach vehiftzir bo ad shellakach. vechen kol kayyotze bahen. af al pi shello peresh hare ellu mattana. veeno yachol lachzor hu velitboa ad sheyyefaresh shehu milve:
Vechen hashsholeach lachavero kadde yayin vechadde shemen uferot beet hannissuin. en nigbin bevet din. mippene shehi gemilut chasadim. velo neemru dine shoshvinut ella bemaot bilvad:
Hasuma o happisseach. o haggiddem. o hachoshesh berosho. o beeno. o beyado o beraglo vechayyotze bahen hare hu kevari lechol devarav bemikkacho o bemimkaro umattenotav:

Aval hachole shettashash koach kol hagguf. vechashal kocho mechamat hacholi ad sheeno yachol lehallech al raglo bashshuk vahare hu nofel al hammitta. hu [hannikra] shechiv mera. umishpete mattenotav enam kemattenat bari. ketzad. shechiv mera shetztzivva veamar litten lifloni kach vechach ben bechol ben beshabbat. ben katav ben lo katav. zachu hakkol kesheyyamut bechol ma shennatan lahem veeno tzarich kinyan. sheddivre shechiv mera kichtuvin vechimsurin hen. vedavar ze middivre sofrim. veaf al pi sheeno ella middivrehem asu otah keshel tora. kede shello tittaref dato alav kesheyyeda sheen devarav kayyamim:
Lefichach im amar kenu mimmenni. afillu beshabbat konin mimmennu, shezze hakkinyan eno tzarich:
Veen shechiv mera tzarich lomar attem eday. ella kol hashshomea et devarav hare ze ed. sheen adam meshatte bishat mita:
Shechiv mera shetztzivva latet mattana leubbar shebbime immo. zacha haubbar mippene sheddato shel adam kerova etzel beno kemo shebbearnu:

Amar im yalda ishti zachar yittol mane veim nekeva matayim. veyalda zachar. notel mane. yalda nekeva notelet matayim. yalda zachar unekeva hazzachar notel mane vehannekeva matayim. yalda tumtum veanderoginus notel kappachut shebbishnehem:

Shechiv mera sheamru lo nechasav lemi. veamar lahem dome sheyyesh lo ben o sheishto meubberet. achshav sheen lo ben o sheen ishto meubberet nechasav lifloni. venoda sheyyesh lo ben o shehayta ishto meubberet af al pi shehippila o met habben achar kach. en mattenato mattana:
Mattenat shechiv mera enah kona ella leachar mita. veen acher zoche baddavar shetztzivva lo ben mekarkein ben mittaltelin ella leachar mita:

Lefichach motziin lichtubbat haishsha umezon haalmana vehabbanot miyyad ellu shetztzivva latet lahem. shehare bemitato nitchayyevu hannechasim bichtubba uvimzonot. veellu shennatan lahem lo yiknu ella leachar mita:

Mattenat shechiv mera shekkatuv bah kinyan. ben shehayta bemiktzat nechasav ben shehayta bechol nechasav. choshshin lah shemma lo gamar lehakenoto ella bishtar. vehoil umattana zo lo tikkane ella leachar mita. en shetar leachar mita vahare hammattana betela:
Veim kanu mimmennu kede leyappot koach hamekabbel. kegon shekkatuv vekaninu mimmennu mosif al mattana zo. hare hi kayyemet:
Shechiv mera sheamar kitvu utenu lifloni mane. umet kodem sheyyichtevu veyittenu lo. en kotvin veen notnin. shemma lo gamar lehakenoto ella bishtar veen shetar leachar mita:
Veim amar kitvu. kede leyappot koach hamekabbel. kegon sheamar tenu mane lifloni veamar veaf kitvu utenu lo. hare ellu kotvin vechotmin venotnin leachar mita:

Shechiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav mattana setam velo shiyyer kelum. im amad chozer. vaafillu kanu miyyado kede leyappot et kocho. ben shehikna kol nechasav leechad ben shekketavam lishnayim. sheomed daat hu shello natan ze hakkol ella shennitkavven shello yiknu kelum ella leachar moto:

Shiyyer kelum leatzmo ben karka ben mittaltelin. hare zo mattana bemiktzat usetamah kemattenat bari shekkone mizzeman hakketiva. lefichach eno chozer. vehu shekkanu miyyado. shemmattenat shechiv mera bemiktzat tzericha kinyan. ben amad ben lo amad:
Bamme devarim amurim beshennatan setam. shehare anu omdin dato veomrin hoil veshiyyer lo nitkavven ella lehakenot lo mechayyim bemattenat bari:

Aval im natan lo hammiktzat beferush bemattenat shechiv mera sheeno ella leachar mita eno tzarich kinyan. veim amad chozer. veim lo amad kana ze hammiktzat. veim haya bah kinyan lo kana ella im ken haya meyappe kocho kemo shebbearnu:

Al tite bishchiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav uferesh shennatan hakkol meachshav vehikna mechayyim. sheen ze mattenat shechiv mera ella kishar kol mattenot habberiim. sheim higgia hashshetar leyad hamekabbel o shekkanu miyyad hannoten kana hakkol veen yachol lachzor bo:

Hannoten mattana keshehu shechiv mera vechatav bah bachayyim uvammavet o mechayyim uvammavet. ben bakkol ben bemiktzat. hoil vechatuv bo uvammavet hare zo mattenat shechiv mera. shezzo shekkatuv bah uvammavet shello yikne ella leachar mita. veze shekkatuv bah mechayyim siman leyashshev et dato sheyyichye mecholi ze:

Shechiv mera shennatan hannechasim shehaddavar galuy shehen kol nechasim sheyyesh lo. hare ze kemattana bemiktzat veim kanu miyyado veamad eno chozer. choshshin anu shemma nisharu lo nechasim acherim bimdinat hayyam. ad sheyyomar kol nechasay shehen ellu o shehaya muchzak sheen lo nechasim ella ellu. veachar kach tihye hammattana bakkol:

Shechiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav laacherim. roin. im kimchallek ketavam. met kanu kullan. amad chozer bechullan. veim kenimlach achar sheshshiyyer chazar vechatav vekanu miyyado al kol echad veechad. met kanu kullan. amad eno chozer ella baacharon shehare natan lo kol hannechasim hannisharim:
Hakkotev kol nechasav leavdo veamad chozer bannechasim veeno chozer baeved. shehare yatza alav shem ben chorin:
Shechiv mera shetztzivva mechamat mita. kegon shehayta dato nota shehu met vadday. venikkar davar ze mikkelal devarav. af al pi shekkanu miyyado bemiktzat im amad chozer:

Vehamefaresh bayyam. vehayyotze beshayyara. vehayyotze bekolar. vehamesukkan vehu shekkafatz alav hacholi vehichbid alav chalyo. kol echad mearbatan kimtzavve mechamat mita. vahare devarav kichtuvin vechimsurin umekayyemin otan im met. veim nitztzal veamad afillu kanu miyyado bemiktzat chozer. kedin kol metzavve mechamat mita:
Shechiv mera shennittak mecholi lecholi. im lo amad velo halach al mishanto bashshuk mattenato mattana:

Amad ben hacholi shetztzivva bo uven hacholi shemmet mimmennu vehalach al mishanto. omdin oto al pi rofim. im mechamat choli harishon met mattenato kayyemet veim lav en mattenato kayyemet. veim halach bashshuk belo mishenet eno tzarich omed ella batlu mattenotav harishonot:

Mattenat shechiv mera sheen katuv bah shemmittoch hacholi hazze shetztzivva bo met veen haedim metzuyin lishl lahem. af al pi shehare ze hametzavve met. hare hammattana betela. sheen mitato reaya. shemma mecholi shennatan bo hammattana nirpa veachar kach chala choli acher umet. lefichach hannechasim bechezkat hayyorshin. ad sheyyavi reaya shemmittoch hacholi hazze shennatan bo mattana zo met:

Shechiv mera shetztzivva veamar lo tegallu mattana zo velo todiu bah adam ella leachar mita. hare zo mattana kayyemet veenah mattana mesutteret. shebbeet shehikna shehu achar moto hare amar gallu otah: 
Metzavve mechamat mita en tzarich lomar gallu et hammattana. ella af al pi shehi ketuva setam en choshshin lah shemma mesutteret hi: 
Shechiv mera shetztzivva veamar yittol peloni kol nechasay o mikketzat nechasay. o yachazik. o yizke. o yikne. kullan leshon mattana hi. vechen im amar yachsen o yirash al mi sherauy leyarsho hare ze kana: 
Amar yehane peloni bahen. yaamod bahen. yishshaen bahen. lo kana: 
Shechiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav leacher. im eno rauy leyarsho notlan mishshum mattana. veim rauy leyarsho notlan mishshum yerushsha. bamme devarim amurim beshehaya hayyoresh hazze achat mibbenotav o echad mikkelal bene banav o echad mikkelal echav vechayyotze bahen mishshear yorshin. aval im ketavahu leechad mibbanav lo asahu ella appotroppos kemo shebbearnu: 
Mi sheamru lo bishat mitato nechasecha lemi hen shemma lifloni veamar lahen ella lemi. roin im rauy leyarsho notlan mishshum yerushsha veim lav notlan mishshum mattana: 
Ger sheyyesh lo ben sheen horato bikdushsha. hoil veeno yorsho kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo. kach eno yachol litten lo kol nechasav bemattenat shechiv mera. lo kol nechasav velo miktzatan. shelleshon yerushsha umattana legabbe yoresh echad hen. veim tomar yikne nimtza ze yoresh et aviv: 
Lefichach im natan leger mishshear haggerim mattenato kayyemet: 
Shechiv mera shehoda sheyyesh lo lifloni etzli kach vechach tenuhu lo. o sheamar keli peloni pikkadon hu beyadi lifloni, tenuhu lo. chatzer pelonit shel peloni hu. chov sheyyesh li beyad peloni eno shelli shel peloni hu. bechol ellu haddevarim vechayyotze bahen hodaato hodaya. vaafillu hoda hagger livno sheen horato bikdushsha devarav kayyamin. afillu hoda shechiv mera leakkum notnin lo: 
Aval shechiv mera shetztzivva litten leakkum mattana en shomin lo. shezze kemi shetztzivva laavor avera minnechasav: 
Amar peloni avdi asu oto ben chorin. o sheamar asiti oto ben chorin. o hare hu ben chorin. kofin et hayyorshin umeshachrerin oto. sheeved yeshno bemiktzat mitzvot: 
Amar pelonit shifchati asu lah korat ruach. osin lah korat ruach veenah ovedet ella avoda shehi rotza bah mikkol haavodot hayeduot laavadim beoto makom: 
Shechiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav leechad. veamar halla eni rotze bahen lo kana: 
Shatak veachar kach tzavach kana. sheddivre shechiv mera kichtuvin vechimsurin hen. vechevan sheshshatak eno yachol lachzor bahen: 
Shechiv mera shekkatav laze vechazar vechatav leacher haacharon kana. sheyyesh lo lachzor ad sheyyamut. ben bakkol ben bemiktzat ben leatzmo ben leacher. vaafillu katav vezikka larishon vechatav vezikka laacharon, haacharon kana. sheshshechiv mera shezzikka adayin mattenat shechiv mera hi: 
Aval shechiv mera shekkatav vezikka vekanu miyyado en leachar kinyan kelum. veeno yachol lachzor bo lo leacher velo leatzmo. ben shennatan hakkol ben shennatan miktzat: 
Shechiv mera shechazar bemiktzat chazar bakkol. ketzad. natan kol nechasav larishon vekanu miyyado kede leyappot et kocho. vechazar venatan miktzatan leacher vekanu miyyado kede leyappot et kocho. hashsheni kana. aval harishon lo kana kelum ben sheamad ben shemmet: 
Natan miktzat nechasav vekanu miyyado. veachar kach natan kullan leacher vekanu miyyado kede leyappot et kocho. im met kana harishon hammiktzat vekana hashsheni et hashshear. veim amad. rishon kana sheni lo kana: 
Shechiv mera shehikdish kol nechasav velo shiyyer kelum o hifkir o chillekan laaniyyim. im amad chozer bakkol: 
Machar keshehu shechiv mera. mimkaro kayyam kevari: 
Machar kol nechasav. im hammaot atzman kayyamot im amad chozer. veim hotzi hammaot eno yachol lachzor: 
Mattana shehi setam velo nitparesh bah shehaya bari keshennatan o shehaya shechiv mera. hu omer shechiv mera hayiti vahare amadti veechezor bemattenati. umekabbel mattana omer bari haya veeno yachol lachzor. al hamekabbel lehavi reaya shebbari haya. lo matza reaya nishba hannoten shevuat hesset veyippater vetaamod hakkarka bechezkat hannoten: 
Aval im hayu mittaltelin beyad hamekabbel. mittoch sheyyachol lomar shelli hen yishshava hesset shebbari haya keshennatan lo mattana zo: 
Mi shemmet venimtzet mattana keshura al yerecho. af al pi shehi beedim vekanu miyyado leyappot koach ellu shennatan lahem hare zo enah kelum. sheani omer ketavah venimlach: 
Veim zikka bah leacher. ben min hayyorshin ben sheeno min hayyorshin. kol haddevarim shebbah kayyamin kechol mattenat shechiv mera: 
Vechen mi shekkatav shetar chov al atzmo beshem acher. o beshem echad mibbanav [o] min hayyorshin. venatan hashshetar [al] yad shalish veamar lo yihye ze etzlecha. velo peresh lo kelum. o sheamar lo hannach ad sheomar lecha ma taase umet. hare zo enah kelum:

Shechiv mera sheamar tenu mane lifloni umet. yittenu leachar mita. sheddivre shechiv mera kichtuvin vechimsurin damu. veen choshshin shemma al mane sheyyesh lo kavur hu omer: 
Vechen shechiv mera sheamar halevaa o pikkadon sheyyesh li beyad peloni tenu otah lifloni devarav kayyamin veen tzarich lemaamad shelashtan. vechen im amar tenu shetar peloni lifloni zacha bema sheyyesh bashshetar. ucheillu katav umasar af al pi shello mashach hashshetar. veen hayyoresh yachol limchol shetar ze shennatan bemattenat shechiv mera. umippene ma hammocher o noten shetar chov lachavero vechazar umechalo hayyoresh machul ushechiv mera shennatan shetar chov en hayyoresh yachol limchol. mippene shekkinyan haraya bishtar middivrehem lefichach hayyoresh adayin ze hashshetar shello hu min hattora umochalo. umattenat shechiv mera af al pi shehi middivrehem asu otah keshel tora. ucheillu kana mamon shebbashshetar min hattora vehiggia leyado velo nishar layyoresh bo kinyan. ulefichach eno mochel: 
Shechiv mera sheamar mane lifloni beyadi. im amar tenu notnin. lo amar tenu en notnin. shemma lo amar mane yesh lifloni beyadi ella kede shello yomru al yorshav sheyyesh lahen mamon: 
Lefichach im amar ze derech hodaa velo haya sham chashash haarama. notnin af al pi shello amar tenu: 
Kayyotze bo rau et avihem shehitmin maot beshidda teva umigdal veamar shel peloni hen. shel maaser sheni hen. im kemoser devarav kayyamin. im kemaarim lo amar kelum: 
Vechen im ba echad veamar lahem ani raiti et avichen shehitmin maot beshidda teva umigdal veamar shel peloni hem. shel maaser hen. im hayu temunin babbayit lo amar kelum. bassade devarav kayyamin. kelalo shel davar kol sheillu yachol littol devarav kayyamin veim lav lo amar kelum: 
Hare shehaya mitztaer al maot shehinniach lo aviv velo yada hechan hechbiam veamru lo bachalom kach vechach hem bemakom peloni hen veshel peloni hen veshel maaser sheni hen. umetzaan bemakom peloni shenneemar lo uvamminyan shenneemar lo. ze haya maase veamru chachamim divre chalomot lo maalin velo moridin: 
Shechiv mera shehoda sheyyesh lifloni beyado mane veamru yetomim chazar veamar lanu avinu perativ neemanin venishbain al ze shevuat hesset: 
Amar tenu veamru yetomim chazar veamar lanu avinu perativ en neemanin: 
Amar mane lifloni (beyadi) veamru yetomin natannu en neemanin. shehare lo amar tenu uminnayin yadu shechayyavin litten: 
Amar tenu veamru yetomim natannu neemanin venishbain shevuat hesset shennatnu: 
Shechiv mera shennatan mane leechad veamar lo holech mane zo lifloni vehalach umetzao shemmet. im kayyam haya beshaa shennatan lo hashshechiv mera. yinnatnu leyorshe mi shennishtallechu lo. sheddivre shechiv mera kichtuvin vechimsurin hen. veim lo haya kayyam yachzeru leyorshe meshalleach sheen kinyan lemet: 
Shechiv mera sheamar tenu matayim zuz lifloni ushelosh meot zuz lifloni vearba meot zuz lifloni. en omrin hakkodem bashshetar zacha. lefichach im lo hinniach tesha meot cholkin hannimtza lefi ma shekkatav lahen. veim yatza alav shetar chov gove mikkullan mikkol echad veechad kefi ma shekkatuv lahen. ketzad. haya hachov arba meot vachamishshim baal hammatayim noten mea uvaal hashshelosh meot mea vachamishshim uvaal haarba meot noten matayim: 
Aval im amar tenu matayim zuz lifloni veacharav shelosh meot lifloni veacharav arba meot lifloni. kol hakkodem bashshetar zacha. lefichach im yatza alav shetar chov gove min haacharon. en lo gove mishshellefanav. en lo gove mishshellifne fanav: 
Shechiv mera sheamar yadur peloni bevayit ze. yochal peloni perot dekel ze. lo amar kelum shello hikna lahem davar sheyyesh bo mammash. shehaddira vehaachila vechayyotze bahen hare hen kedibbur ucheshena sheen niknin. aval im amar tenu bayit ze lifloni kede sheyyadur bo ad zeman peloni. o tenu dekel ze lifloni kede sheyyochal perotav. devarav kayyamin. shehare hikna lahem hagguf leferot vehagguf davar sheyyesh bo mammash. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Shechiv mera sheamar nechasoym ellu levanay. en habbanot bichlalam. haya lo ben echad uvat. o ben uven habben. af al pi shehu amar levanay shehu leshon rabbim en notnin ella livno. shehabben haechad nikra banim: 
Shechiv mera sheamar nechasay letoviyya umet. uva echad sheshshemo toviyya veamar ani hu. notlan. veim huchzak shemo rav toviyya eno notlan. veim haya shechiv mera gas bo vekore oto bishmo notlan: 
Bau shenayim litboa vechol echad mehen muchzak shemo toviyya. im haya echad mehem talmid chacham. talmid chacham kodem. en bahen talmid chacham vehaya echad mehen shachen o karov hu kodem. haya echad shachen veechad karov shachen kodem. shenehem kerovim o shenehem shechenim o shenehem talmide chachamim. yaasu haddayyanin kemo sheyyerae lahem. kol mi sheddatan nota sheal ze amar notnin lo. vechen im hayu rabbim: 
Shechiv mera sheamar nechasay lifloni ufeloni ufeloni. cholkin beshave afillu hen mea: 
Amar nechasay lifloni ulevanay cholkin. peloni notel mechetza vechol banav mechetza. umaase beechad sheamar leishto nechasay lich ulevanayich. veamru chachamim tittol hi mechetza vechol habbanim mechetza: 
Amar lifloni ufeloni velivne peloni. notlin bene peloni mechetza vehashshenayim harishonim mechetza: 
Shechiv mera sheamar yachalok peloni binchasay. yittol mechetza. tenu chelek lifloni binchasay. yittol echad mishshishsha asar. veyesh mi shehora yittol revia hannechasim: 
Shechiv mera sheamar tenu chelek lifloni bevor hayyayin sheyyesh li. yittol revia hayyayin. amar tenu lo bo chelek lechavit. hare miut veyittol sheminit hayyayin. amar tenu lo bo chelek likdera notel chelek mishshenem asar min hayyayin. amar tenu lo bo chelek letafiach notel chelek mishshishsha asar min hayyayin shebbabbor. shehare gilla dato shellechelek muat nitkavven: 
Veen gomrin min hashshiurin haellu ledin acher: 
Shechiv mera sheamar tittol ishti keechad min habbanim. notelet keechad mibbanav. veim noldu lo banim achar hatztzavvaa mitztarfin im ellu shehayu bishat hatztzavvaa venotelet chelek im kullan. ketzad. hayu shelosha banim bishat hatztzavvaa uleachar zeman noldu lo shenayim. notelet keechad min hachamishsha shehu shetut kol hammamon: 
Veenah notelet immahem ella binchasim shehayu lo bishat hatztzavvaa. aval nechasim shebbau lo achar zeman hatztzavvaa en lah bahen chelek sheen adam makne davar shello ba birshuto: 
Shechiv mera sheamar mittaltelin sheyyesh li lifloni. notel kele tashmisho. aval lo chittim useorim vechayyotze bahen. amar kol mittaltelin shelli. notel hakkol: 
Vehaavadim bichlal hammittaltelin. aval lo rechayim hattachtona vechayyotze bah. shehare hi mechubberet laaretz: 
Amar kol hammittaltel. notel af rechayim hattachtona vechayyotze bahen: 
Shechiv mera sheamar nechasay lifloni. notel kol hammittaltelin vechol hakkarkaot vehabbegadim vehaavadim vehabbehema vehaofot. vehattefillin im shear sefarim hakkol bichlal hannechasim. aval sefer tora yesh bo safek im hu bichlal nechasim o eno lefichach im tefaso en motziin miyyado: 
Shechiv mera sheamar tenu matayim zuz lifloni bechori karauy lo. notlan venotel bechorato: 
Amar bivchorato yado al haelyona. ratza chelek bechora notel ratza matayim zuz notel: 
Vechen im amar tenu matayim zuz liflonit ishti karauy lah. notaltan venotelet ketubbatah. veim amar bichtubbatah yadah al haelyona: 
Amar tenu matayim zuz lifloni baal chovi karauy lo notlan venotel et chovo. amar bechovo en lo ella chovo: 
Shechiv mera sheamar tenu arba meot zuz lifloni veyissa bitti. hare ze kemi shennatan lo shete mattanot kol eze mehen sheyyirtze yikkach. lefichach im ratza likkach hammaot velo yissa habbat yikkach. aval im amar yikkach bitti utenu lo arba meot zuz. hare ze tenay velo yizke bammaot ad sheyyikkach habbat: 
Shechiv mera sheamar tenu arba meot zuz levitti bichtubbatah o lichtubbatah. im derech anshe hair lehosif beshumat hanneduneya velichtov sheve mane bematayim enah notelet ella matayim zuz. shehare lo amar arba meot zuz setam ella bichtubbatah. kelomar tenu lah ma shettihye shumato bichtubbatah arba meot zuz: 
Amar tenu neduneya levitti kach vechach begadim kach vechach kelim. huzelu habbegadim vehakkelim achar ken. harevach laytomim venotnin lah kashshaar hazzol. vechen im amar tenu arba meot zuz deme hayyayin levitti vehukar hayyayin harevach laytomim venotnin lah arba meot zuz. maase beechad shehaya yotze bekolar veamar tenu lifloni arba meot zuz mehayyayin shel makom peloni. veamru chachamim yittol arba meot zuz middeme oto hayyayin shello nitkavven ze litten lo min hayyayin mishkal arba meot zuz velo nitkavven ella ledamim veze sheyyichadan kede leyappot et kocho. veshuv maase beechad sheamar haddekel levitti vehinniach shene chatzae dekel amru chachamim tittol hashshene chatzaim shellaze nitkavven vehem shekkara dekel. veshuv maase beechad sheamar tenu lifloni bayit hammachazik mea korin venimtza habbayit sheyyesh leze hametzavve machazik mea veesrim. veamru chachamim zacha bevayit ze shehaddevarim marin shekkavvanato laze hayta shekkol hannoten beayin yafa noten. vechen kol kayyotze bidvarim ellu: 
Shechiv mera sheamar tenu livni shekel bechol shabbat. o sheamar al tittenu lahem ella shekel. venimtza sheeno maspik lahem ella sela bechol shabbat. notnim lahem kol tzarkan shello nitkavven ze lehareiv et banav ella lezarez otam. shemma yarvichu bahotzaa yoter midday: 
Shechiv mera shetztzivva veamar al tispeduhu. en sofdin oto. al tikberuhu minnechasav. en shomin lo sheyyachus al mamon banav veyappil atzmo al hatztzibbur. sheasur lehannicho belo kevura. ella kofin et hayyorshin lekavro minnechasav:

Shechiv mera sheamar beni peloni yirasheni. hare ze yoresh oto levaddo velo yirashuhu shear habbanim. vechen im amar al bat ben habbanot o ach ben haachin o shear yorshin devarav kayyamin: 
Aval habbari en devarav kayyamin: 
Shechiv mera sheamar nechasay lifloni veacharav lifloni. en lashsheni ella ma sheshshiyyer rishon: 
Veim haya harishon rauy leyarsho kegon shehaya ben mikkelal habbanim en lashsheni kelum. shekkol leshon mattana layyoresh hare hu kilshon yerushsha. virushsha en lah hefsek veaf al pi sheamar veacharav lifloni: 
Aval habbari shennatan mattenat bari al derech ze vechatav laze nechasay lecha veacharecha lifloni. en lashsheni ella ma sheshshiyyer rishon ben shehaya harishon rauy leyarsho ben shello haya rauy leyarsho: 
Shechiv mera sheamar nechasay lecha veacharecha lifloni vehaya rishon rauy leyarsho uferesh veamar lo mishshum yerushsha ani noten lecha sheen lah hefsek ella bemattana vahare hifsaktiha. hashsheni kone ma shemmeshayyer harishon. lefichach im natan hammaot al yad shalish o sheamar tenu levanay shekel bechol shabbat velo mishshum yerushsha ani notnam lahem. vehannishar min hannechasim achar motam yihye lifloni. en notnin lahem ella shekel af al pi sheeno maspik lahem: 
Nechasay lifloni veacharav lifloni. met rishon kana sheni. met sheni hare ellu shel yorshe hashsheni. met sheni bechayye rishon yihyu hannechasim shel yorshe rishon: 
Veaf al pi sheen lashsheni ella ma sheshshiyyer rishon asur larishon limkor velitten gufo ella ochel happerot ad sheyyamut veyizke hashsheni: 
Veim avar harishon umachar venatan bemattana. en hashsheni motzi miyyad hallakochot sheen lashsheni lo min hagguf velo min happerot ella hannishar. vechol hammassi etza larishon limkor nikra rasha. vaafillu haya bahen avadim vehotzian harishon lecherut o kelim vaasaan tachrichin lemet maasav kayyamin: 
Bamme devarim amurim beshemmachar harishon o natan mattana laacherim. aval im mecharan harishon o netanan livno mattana o leechad miyyorshav lo asa kelum. vechen im netanan bemattenat shechiv mera afillu laacherim lo asa kelum sheen mattenat shechiv mera kona ella leachar mita uchesheyyamut yikne hashsheni: 
Haya chov al harishon o ketubbat ishsha uvau levet din lehippara minnechasim ellu. af al pi sheharishon kayyam en bet din megabbin otam migguf hannechasim ella min happerot bilvad shamin lahem. met harishon uva baal chovo veishto ligbot minnechasim ellu en megabbin lahem kelum afillu asaan appoteke o sheyyichadan leishto bichtubbatah enan govin minnechasim ellu kelum ella hare hen shel sheni: 
Shechiv mera sheamar leishsha penuya nechasay lach veacharayich lifloni veamda venisset. baal lokeach hu veen hashsheni motzi miyyad habbaal. veim amar lah keshehi nesua nechasay lich veacharayich lifloni umeta. hashsheni motzi miyyad habbaal. shekkevan shezzachta bannechasim al tenay ze keshehi nesua nimtza keillu amar lah beferush acharayich yikne peloni lo habbaal. lefichach im machra nechasim ellu keshehi tachat balah umeta tachat balah yaamdu nechasim beyad hallokeach sheim yotzi habbaal miyyad hallokeach mippene shemmachra keshehi nesua hare hashsheni motzi miyyad habbaal vehallokeach chozer umotzi miyyad hashsheni. shehare machra lo veen lo ella ma sheshshiyyer rishon. veen bishlashtan mi shehotzi mamon ella hallokeach. ulefichach taamod beyado. maase beechad sheamar nechasay leimmi veachareha leyorshay vehayta lo bat nesua umeta habbat bechayye balah uvechayye em aviha veachar kach meta hazzekena. veamru chachamim en habbaal yoresh otan nechasim mippene shehen reuyin leishto velo zachta bahen haishsha ella achar shemmeta. aval im hinnicha habbat ben o bat hayu yorshin hannechasim. shemmashma yorshin vaafillu yorshe yorshin. veillu amar ucheshettamut hazzekena hare hen levitti meachshav. haya habbaal yoresh otan achar mitat ishto: 
Hakkotev nechasav livno uleachar moto. hare hagguf shel ben mizzeman hashshetar vehapperot laav ad sheyyamut. lefichach haav eno yachol limkor mippene shehen netunin labben. vehabben eno yachol limkor mippene shehen birshut haav. met haav vehinniach perot mechubbarin lakkarka hare hen shel ben. mippene sheddato shel adam kerova etzel beno. hayu telushin o shehiggiu lehibbatzer hare hen shel yorshin. avar haav umachar mechurin ad sheyyamut. uchesheyyamut haav motzi habben miyyad hallakochot. veim hayu sham perot mechubbarin shamin otam lallokeach venoten habben demehem. hayu telushin o shehiggiu lehibbatzer hare hen shel lokeach. avar habben umachar en lallokeach kelum ad sheyyamut haav. machar habben bechayye haav umet habben veachar kach met haav. kesheyyamut haav kana hallokeach. sheen laav ella perot vekinyan perot eno kekinyan hagguf: 
Mattenat bari shekkatuv bah mehayyom uleachar mita. hare hi kemattenat shechiv mera sheeno kone ella leachar mita. shemmashma devarim ellu sheaf al pi shekkana hagguf mehayyom eno zoche bo veochel perot ella leachar mita: 
Shetar mattana shekkatuv bo sheyyikne peloni sade pelonit leachar mita ben shehaya bashshetar kinyan ben shello haya bo kinyan. kevan shekkatuv bo zeman uvizman ze chay haya. hazzeman mochiach shemmechayyim hikna lo veeno zoche ella leachar mita. sheillu haya bedato lehakenot lo bishtar ze leachar mita lo haya kotev bo zeman. lefichach af al pi sheen katuv bo mehayyom uleachar mita kone leachar mita. veze shekkotvin bechol hammattanot vehammimkarot meachshav veaf al pi sheyyesh bashshetar hazzeman. lehareviach haddavar kotvin bo af al pi sheeno tzarich: 
Bari shennatan mattana vechatav bashshetar mechayyim uvammavet. hare zo mattana gemura mechayyim shehare katuv bo mechayyim. veze shekkatuv bo uvammavet kemi sheomer meatta vead olam uchemo noye hashshetar hu ze: 
Hatztzaddikim haggemurim veanshe maase lo yekabbelu mattana meadam. ella botchim baAdonai baruch shemo lo bindivim. vahare neemar <small>(Mishlei 15 27)</small> "vesone mattanot yichye": seliku lehu hilchot zechiyya umattana besad
Mishneh Torah, Neighbors 1:
Echad hakkone mechavero chatzi sadehu. o shenayim shekkanu meechad sade. o sheyyarshu. o shennittena lahen bemattana. o shehechziku bah min hahefker. o nichse ger. kelalo shel davar kol sheyyesh benehem shuttafut bakkarka uvikkesh echad min hashshuttafin lachalok velittol chelko levaddo. im yesh beotah karka din chaluka kofe et shear hashshuttafin vecholkin immo. veim en bah din chaluka en echad mehen yachol lachof et chavero lachalok. vechen haddin bemittaltelin. bamme devarim amurim besheen echad mehen makkir et chelko bammakom shehen shuttafin bo ella yad kullan mishtammesh bechol hammakom. aval im haya echad mehen makkir chelko af al pi sheen bah din chaluka kofe kol echad mehen et chavero lehavedil ben chelko lechelek chavero:
