Echad min hashshuttafin sheamar lachavero bemakom sheen bo din chaluka. o bedavar shei efshar sheyyachleku kegon shifcha o keli. mechor li chelkecha bechach vechach o kene mimmenni kashshaar hazze. haddin immo vechofin et hannitba limkor lachavero o liknot mimmennu. aval im en hattovea rotze liknot o lo yimtza bema yikne. eno yachol lachof et chavero liknot mimmennu afillu kashshaar hazzol. shehare chavero yachol lomar lo en retzoni sheekne ella sheemkor. lefichach shene achin echad ani veechad ashir shehinniach lahem avihem merchatz o bet habbad. im asaan haav lesachar hassachar laemtza kol zeman sheyyirtzu laamod beshuttafut. asaan haav leatzmo eno yachol lachof achiv lehasekir otam ella mishtammeshin bahem kederech shehishtammesh avihem. vahare ashir omer leani kach lecha zetim uvo vaase otam bevet habbad. kene lecha avadim veyavou veyirchatzu bammerchatz. veen heani kofe et heashir liknot chelko ella im ken amar lo kene mimmenni o mechor li vahareni love vekone o mocher laacherim vekonin haddin immo. amar kol echad mehen eni kone ella hareni mocher chelki mochrin otah laacherim. amar kol echad mehem eni mocher ella kol echad mehen rotze sheyyikne chelek chavero. o sheen echad mehen rotze lo liknot chelek chavero velo limkor chelko ella yishshaaru shuttafin bagguf. heach hen osin. im haya hammakom asuy lesachar maskirin oto vecholkin secharo. veim eno asuy lesachar im chatzer hu shochnin bah shana shana shei efshar sheyyishkenu shenehem keachat mippene hezzek reiyya shehare en bah din chaluka veen adam asuy litroach kol sheloshim yom lifnot mechatzer lechatzer ella mishshana leshana. veim merchatz hu nichnasin lah shenehem tamid bechol yom. vechen kol davar sherauy lehishtammesh bo tamid veeno asuy lesachar kegon merchatz o matztza o sefer tora eno yachol lomar lo hishtammesh atta yom vaani yom shehare omer lo bechol yom ani rotze lehishtammesh bo: 
Echad hassocher mechavero miktzat chatzer. o sade sheen bah din chaluka. o shenayim shessachru makom echad beshuttafut. kol echad mehen yachol lachof et chavero velomar lo o sechor mimmenni chelki o hasekir li chelkecha. veim yesh bah din chaluka cholkin: 
E zehu din chaluka. kol sheillu yechallek lefi hashshuttafin yaggia lappachut shebbahem chelek sheshshem hakkol karuy alav. aval im en shem hakkol nikra al hachelek en bah din chaluka. ketzad. kol chatzer sheen bah arba ammot al arba ammot enah keruya chatzer. vechol sade sheen bah kede zeriat tisha kabbin enah keruya sade. vechol ginna sheen bah kede zeriat chatzi kav enah keruya ginna. vechol pardes sheen bo kede zeriat shelosha kabbin eno karuy pardes. lefichach en cholkin et hechatzer ad sheyyihye arba ammot lechol echad veechad min hashshuttafin. velo et hassade ad sheyyihye bah kede zeriat tisha kabbin [lechol echad veechad]. velo et hagginna ad sheyyehe bah chatzi kav lechol echad veechad. velo et happardes ad sheyyehe bo bet shelosha kabbin lechol echad veechad. bamme devarim amurim beeretz yisrael vechayyotze bah. aval bevavel vechayyotze bah en cholkin et hassade ad sheyyihye bah kede charishat yom laze vacharishat yom laze. velo et happardes ad sheyyihye bo sheloshim veshishsha ilanot laze [usheloshim veshishsha ilanot laze] kede avodat adam echad bayyom echad. vesade shemmashkin otah bichli ad sheyyehe bah kede sheyyemalle happoel yom echad laze veyom echad laze: 
En cholkin et hatteraklin velo et hammoran velo et hashshovach velo et bet habbad velo et hammerchatz velo et hattallit ad sheyyehe bechol chelek mehen kede laze uchede laze. im merchatz chalku ad sheyyehe bechol chelek mehen kede merchatz. veim shovach ad sheyyehe kol chelek shovach bifne atzmo. vechen betallit uvishar kol haddevarim. en bahen kede laze uchede laze maalin oto bedamim veyesh [lo] lomar lachavero o mechor li o kene mimmenni. amar echad mehen chalok ze af al pi sheen hachalakin shavim ani ettol et happachut vetol atta et hayyeter en shomin lo shehare omer lo en retzoni likkach mattana. ella hoil veen bah din chaluka beshave hare anu maalin bedamim:
Mishneh Torah, Neighbors 2:
Chatzrot hakkefarim shekkol echad veechad bone lo bayit venimtzet hechatzer shebben shene habbattim meshuttefet lechol bene habbattim. hare yesh lechol petach ufetach arba ammot lefanav berochav kol happetach. vehannishar min hechatzer im yesh bo arba ammot al arba ammot lechol shuttaf veshuttaf cholkin otah veim lav en cholkin otah shekkol chatzer sheen lah arba ammot al arba ammot enah keruya chatzer kemo shebbearnu. ketzad. hayu shene shuttafin laze shene battim velaze bayit echad. ze sheyyesh lo shene battim moddin lo min hechatzer arba ammot lechol bayit uvayit al kol rochav happetach afillu haya eser ammot. veze sheyyesh lo bayit echad notnin lo arba ammot berochav pitcho lifne pitcho. vehannishar min hechatzer im yesh bah shemone ammot kede sheyyehe laze arba ammot al arba ammot velaze arba ammot al arba ammot chutz min happetachim yesh bah din chaluka vecholkin. pachot mizze en bah din chaluka: 
Bayit sheyyesh lo petachim rabbim mikkol ruchotav yesh lo arba ammot lechol ruach. veim yiched lo petach en lo ella arba ammot keneged pitcho: 
Achsadra im efshar lo lehikkanes letochah bemassao en lah arba ammot veim lav yesh lah arba ammot. shello amru sheyyesh lechol petach ufetach arba ammot ella lifrok sham massao: 
Bet shaar o mirpeset yesh lahem arba ammot. hayu chamishsha battim petuchim lemirpeset vehammirpeset petucha lechatzer en lah ella arba ammot: 
Lul shel tarnegolim en lo arba ammot: 
Bayit chetzyo mekore vechetzyo sheeno mekore ben shekkeruyo kelappe penim ben shekkeruyo kelappe chutz en lo arba ammot: 
Bayit satum yesh lo arba ammot. paratz et petzimav en lo arba ammot: 
Bayit sheen bo arba ammot al arba ammot en lo arba ammot bechatzer ella im yesh bechatzer arba ammot laze vearba ammot laze ad petach habbayit hazze cholkin. vehazzevel shel chatzer mitchallek lefi happetachim. aval achsanya shel melech lefi bene adam: 
Hashshuttafin sheratzu lachalok davar sheen bo din chaluka af al pi shehen mafsidin et shemo cholkin. uvechitve hakkodesh af al pi sheratzu lo yachaloku. bamme devarim amurim becherech echad. aval bishte kerichot cholkin: 
Makom sheen bo din chaluka sheratzu shuttafin lechalleko af al pi shekkanu miyyadam kol echad mehen yachol lachzor bo. shezze kinyan devarim hu kemo shebbearnu. aval im kanu miyyadam shezze ratza beruach peloni veze ratza beruach peloni enan yecholim lachzor bahem. vechen im halach ze beatzmo vehechezik bechelko veze beatzmo vehechezik bechelko af al pi shello kanu miyyadam en echad mehem yachol lachzor bachavero: 
Haachin shechalku veasu benehem goral kevan sheala goral leechad mehen kanu kullan. bahanaya shennaaset lahem sheshshamu ze mizze ledavar shehiskimu alav gamar kol echad mehen umakne lachavero: 
Haachin shechalku hare hen kelakochot ze mizze. veen lahem derech ze al ze. velo sullamot ze al ze. velo challonot ze al ze. velo ammat hammayim ze al ze. shekkevan shechalku lo nishar leechad mehen zechut bechelek chavero. lefichach yesh lomar laachin keshehayta hassade kullah leechad haya maavir bah ammat hammayim hazzot mimmakom lemakom aval atta shennaaset ze chelki yesh li lehasir ammat hammayim mealay. vechen sotem hachallon hammashkif al chelko uvone betzad hassullam af al pi shehu mevattel tashmisho. vehu haddin bishnayim shekkanu sade meechad vechalku lo nishar leechad mehem zechut bechelek chavero. umafsik ammat hammayim mechelko vesotem hachallonot: 
Aval shenayim shekkanu sade mishshene anashim o mishshene achin. en leechad mehen lehafesik ammat hammayim velo leshannot davar min hannezakim shehechziku bahen hammochrin: 
Chatzar hashshuttafin sheyyesh bah din chaluka. o shechillekuha birtzonam af al pi sheen bah din chaluka. yesh lechol echad mehen lachof et chavero livnot hakkotel baemtza kede shello yirehu chavero beshaa shemmishtammesh bechelko. shehezzek reiyya hezzek hu veen lo chazaka bechatzer. ella af al pi sheamdu kach shanim rabbot belo mechitztza kofehu laasot mechitztza bechol et sheyyirtze: 
Rochav mekom hakkotel mishshel shenehem. vechamma yihye rachbo. hakkol keminhag hammedina. vaafillu nahagu laasot mechitztza benehem bekanim uvehutzin. uvilvad shello yihye avir sheyyistakkel bo veyire et chavero: 
Kamma gova hakkotel en pachot mearba ammot. vechen beginna kofehu lehavedil ginnato migginnat chavero bimchitztza gevoha asara tefachim. aval bevika en tzarich lehavedil bikato mibbikat chavero ella bemakom shennahagu. ratza lehavedil bikato mibbikat chavero kones letoch shello uvone veose chazit kemo amma besid mibbachutz kede lehodia shehakkotel shello. lefichach im nafal hakkotel hammakom vehaavanim shello. veim asu middaat shenehem bonim hakkotel baemtza veosin chazit mikkan umikkan. lefichach im nafal hakkotel hammakom vehaavanim shel shenehen: 
Hammocher ginna lachavero setam vehayta meorevet im ginnot acherot. kofin et hallokeach livnot et hakkotel benehem. vaafillu bemakom shennahagu shello ligdor bagginnot. aval im machar bika setam en mechayyevim oto ligdor ella bemakom shennahagu: 
Makom shennahagu livnot ketalim hammavdilin bachatzerot o bagginnot baavanim sheenan gazit ze noten shelosha tefachim veze noten shelosha tefachim. begazit ze noten tefachayim umechetza veze noten tefachayim umechetza. bichfisin ze noten tefachayim veze noten tefachayim. bilvenim ze noten tefach umechetza veze noten tefach umechetza. vechol hashshiurin haellu ovi hakkotel im hassid. vehoil umekom hakkotel mishshel shenehem im nafal hakkotel hare hammakom vehaavanim shel shenehem. vaafillu nafal lirshut echad mehen o sheppinna echad mehen et kol haavanim lirshuto vetaan shemmachar lo chavero chelko o netano lo bemattana eno neeman. ella hare hen birshut shel shenehem ad sheyyavi reaya:
Mishneh Torah, Neighbors 3:
Kotel chatzer hammavdil ben shene shuttafin shennafal. yesh lechol echad mishshenehem lachof al chavero livnoto ad gova arba ammot kede shello yiru ze et ze. aval yeter al arba ammot en mechayyevin oto. ratza haechad vehigbiah hakkotel yoter al arba ammot. im ba chavero uvana kotel acher gavoah keneged hakkotel shebbenehen mechayyevin oto litten chelko baggova shekkeneged katlo. ketzad. bana echad kotel shebbenehen vehigbiho eser ammot uva chavero uvana kotel acher kenegdo o betziddo laasot lo bayit vehigbiah hakkotel haacher shesh ammot mechayyevin oto litten chelko bishte ammot shemmosif al arba ammot shehare nire mimmaasav shehu rotze bahen. vechen im chakak berosh hakkotel shebbenehen makom lehanniach bo hakkorot o shebbana alav kora gedola shehakkorot nishanin aleha mechayyevin oto litten chelko beshesh haammot kullan shehosif chavero al haarba ammot af al pi shello bana kol hakkotel shehare gilla dato shehu rotze bechol haggova hazze: 
Echad min hashshuttafin shebbana hakkotel shemmavdil beno uven chavero ad arba ammot vetava chavero litten chelko bahotzaa veamar natatti chelki. hare ze bechezkat shennatan venishba hesset shennatan veniftar ad sheyyavi reaya hattovea shello natan. aval im ba litboa oto litten chelko behotzaat shear haggova shehosif al arba ammot mippene shessamach lo o kenegdo veamar natatti eno neeman. ella chavero nishba binkitat chefetz shello natan lo venotel mimmennu kedin kol hannishbain venotlin. ad sheyyavi reaya ze shennatan lo: 
Mi shehaya lo churba ben churbot chavero veamad chavero vegadar ruach rishona usheniyya ushelishit ad shennimtzet churba zo mishshelosh ruchoteha gedura. en mechayyevin oto litten lo hahotzaa kelum shehare lo hoil lo vahare churbato petucha lirshut harabbim keshehayta. lefichach im gadar lo ruach reviit ad shennimtzet churbato mukkefet gader megalgelin alav et hakkol venoten chatzi hahotzaa shehotzi ze bearba ruchot ad arba ammot. uvilvad sheyyihye mekom hakkotel shel shenehem: 
Aval im haya hakkotel shel ze shebbana uvechelko bana yerae li sheen megalgelin alav ella davar muat kemo sheyyiru haddayyanin shehare eno yachol lehishtammesh bakketalim. vechen im hannikkaf atzmo hu sheggadar ruach reviit hare gilla dato venoten chatzi hahotzaa shel shalosh ruchot im hayu hakketalim shel shenehem. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Vechen shene battim ze betzad ze vehayu gaggehen asuyin ledira afillu hayu bishne tzidde reshut harabbim ze ose maake lachatzi gaggo shehu dar bo veze ose maake lachatzi gaggo. veze shello keneged ze umaadif kede shello yiru ze et ze. veaf al pi shebbene reshut harabbim roin oto yachol kol echad lomar lachavero ellu en roin oti ella bayyom beet sheeemod al gaggi veatta roe oti tamid: 
Gag hassamuch lachatzar chavero ose lo maake gavoah arba ammot. aval ben gag legag mishshear haggaggin eno zakuk learba ammot sheen bene adam darin baggaggot lefichach en baggaggot hezzek reiyya. aval tzarich laasot mechitztza ben shene haggaggin gevoha asara tefachim kede sheyyitpos oto kegannav im nichnas lirshuto: 
Shete chatzerot zo lemala mizzo lo yomar haelyon hareni bone mikkenegdi veole ella bonim shenehem millematta veole uvone haelyon levaddo mikkenegdo vamala. veim hayta chatzero lemala miggaggo shel chavero en haelyon zakuk lattachton kelal: 
Mi shehaya katlo samuch leginnat chavero venafal kofin oto lefannot avanav. amar lo higgiucha vahare hen shellecha en shomin lo. veim ratza bahen baal hagginna veamar lo hen im pinna otam kana veeno yachol lachzor bo vaafillu amar helach yetziotecha veettol avanay en shomin lo. aval im lo pinna lo kana shello amar lo ella lidchoto: 
Chamesh ginnot hamesappekot mayim mimmayan echad venitkalkel hammayan kullan metakkenot im haelyona. nimtzet hattachtona metakkenet im kullan umetakkenet leatzmah. veharishona enah metakkenet im hashsheniyya velo mehashsheniyya ulematta. vechen chamesh chatzerot sheshshofchin mayim leviv echad venitkalkel habbiv kullan metakkenot im hattachtona. nimtzet haelyona metakkenet im kullan umetakkenet leatzmah vehattachtona enah metakkenet im hashsheniyya velo mishsheniyya ulemala: 
Bene hannahar mashkin al hasseder. ratza echad mehen liskor kede sheyyachazor lo hammayim veyashke techilla veachar kach yiftach. veacher rotze lehashekot techilla. kol hammitgabber zacha. uvor hakkarov laamma mitmalle rishon mippene darche shalom:
Mishneh Torah, Neighbors 4:
Mi shehayta lo aliyya lemala mibbeto shel chavero venafal kotel mikkatle habbayit en baal haaliyya noten lo kelum bitziotav vechofe et baal habbayit livnoto keshehaya. aval en baal habbayit kofe levaal haaliyya livnot kotel aliyya shennafal. vehattikra shel bayit hare hi shel baal habbayit vehammaaziva sheal hattikra hare hi shel baal haaliyya: 
Naflu shenehem habbayit vehaaliyya hare shenehem cholkin baetzim uvaavanim uveafar. veim nishtabberu miktzat haavanim roin e zo reuya lehishtabber im avne habbayit o avne haaliyya. vedavar ze yadua midderech hannefila im nafal haelyon al hattachton vaharaso o nishmat hattachton venafal haelyon veneheras. veim enan yodin ketzad nafal cholkin haavanim hashshelemot vehashshevurot: 
Amar baal haaliyya levaal habbayit livnot kede sheyyivne aliyyato al gabbav vehu eno rotze hare baal haaliyya bone et habbayit keshehaya. veyoshev vedar betocho ad asher yitten kol yetziotav veachar kach yetze veyivne aliyyato im rotze: 
Veim en echad mehen yachol livnot baal haaliyya notel shelish hakkarka uvaal habbayit shene shelishim: 
Ratza baal habbayit livnot beto bone keshehaya. veim ba leshannot bakketalim im chizzek otan vehirba berachban yoter mimma shehayu shomin lo. ratza lemaet berachban o lifchot mechazkan kegon shehayu avanim uvikkesh lehachezir levenim vechayyotze bahen en shomin lo. ba leshannot et hattikra lekorot kevedin vachazakin shomin lo. lifchot berachban pachot mimma shehayu en shomin lo. hirba bechallonot o shehosif begova habbayit en shomin lo. miet bechallonot o shemmiet begova habbayit shomin lo. vechen baal haaliyya bone otah im ratza keshehayta. veim ba leshannot hakketalim leharechiv ulehachzik en shomin lo mippene shehu machbid al kotel hattachton. aval lemaet shomin lo. vechen bekorot tikra haelyona im shinna otam lekallim mimma shehayu shomin lo. lichvedim mehen en shomin lo. hirba bechallonot o shemmiet begova haaliyya shomin lo. aval im miet bechallonot o hirba begavhah en shomin lo: 
Nitdaldelu korot habbayit veyardu laavir habbayit im higgiu letoch asara tefachim soter uvone. veim lo higgiu yachol baal haaliyya leakkev alav. vaafillu amar lo baal habbayit ani eskor lecha makom kede shettadur bo ad sheatakken hattikra en shomin lo shehare omer lo eni rotze sheetrach mimmakom lemakom kede shettetakken et betcha: 
Hitnu benehem al davar ze. im nishar begova habbayit kede sheyyikkach adam chavila benonit al rosho veyikkanes bah tachat korot ellu shenneekmu eno soter. veim eno yachol lehikkanes bah ad sheyyachof et rosho soter umetakken uvone. veen baal haaliyya yachol leakkev shehare hitnu benehem techilla: 
Bet habbad shehu banuy boovi hahar veginna achat al gabbav. venifchatu sheme bet habbad kearbaa tefachim o yoter. hare baal hagginna yored vezorea lematta ad sheyyaase ze labbayit bado kefin. vitakken haelyon karka ginnato veyizra kol ginnato: 
Shete ginnot zo al gav zo vehayyarak bentayim begova ovi haaretz shebbenehem. kol shehaelyon yachol lifshot et yado velittol oto meikkaro hare hu shello uvilvad shello yeenos et atzmo vehashshear shel tachton. haya maggia lenofo veeno maggia leikkaro lo yittol haelyon veim natal en motziin oto miyyado. aval hailan haomed al hammetzar af al pi shehu note letoch sade achat mehen hare shenehem cholkin beferotav: 
Shataf nahar et zetav ushetalam betoch sede chavero veamar halla zetay ani notel en shomin lo mishshum yishshuv haaretz ella yaamdu bimkoman. veim akaran hannahar begushehen kesheshshetalan yachleku happerot baal hassade im baal hazzetim kol shalosh shanim uleachar shalosh hakkol levaal hassade. veim lo neekru begushehen hakkol levaal hakkarka miyyad: 
Kayyotze bo hammocher zetav leetzim im pasak immo lakotz miyyad kol happerot sheyyaasu hare hen levaal hakkarka. veim hitna immo lakotz kol zeman sheyyirtze kol happerot sheyyotziu levaal haetzim. machar setam im asu pachot merviit lisa chutz min hahotzaa hare ellu shel baal hazzetim. asu reviit lisa chutz min hahotzaa hare ellu yachaloku:
Mishneh Torah, Neighbors 5:
Chatzar hashshuttafin kol echad mehen kofe et chavero laasot bah bet shaar vedelet. vechen kol haddevarim shehechatzer tzericha lahem tzorech gadol. o devarim shennahagu bene hammedina laasotam. aval shear haddevarim kegon tziyyur vechiyyur vechayyotze bo eno kofehu. asa echad mehen meatzmo im gilla hashsheni dato shennoach lo bema sheasa chavero megalgelin alav et hakkol venoten chelko bahotzaa: 
Mi sheyyesh lo bayit bechatzer acheret bene hechatzer meshabedin oto laasot immahem delet veneger umanul. aval bishar haddevarim en meshabedin oto. veim haya sharuy immahem beotah chatzer meshabedin oto al hakkol: 
Echad min hashshuttafin bechatzer shebbikkesh lehaamid bah behema o rechayim o legaddel bah tarnegolin chavero meakkev alav. vechen shear haddevarim sheen derech anshe hammakom laasotan bechatzrotehen bechullan hashshuttafin meakkevin ze al ze. chutz min hakkevisa lefi sheen darkan shel benot yisrael lehitbazzot al gav hannahar: 
Echad chatzar hashshuttafin veechad mavoy sheeno mefullash kol bene hammavoy meakkevin ze al ze shello lehishtammesh bammavoy ella bidvarim shedderech bene hammedina lehishtammesh bahen bammevoot: 
Echad min hashshuttafin bechatzer sheheemid behema o rechayim vechayyotze bahen bechatzer velo micha bo shuttafo hare ze meakkev alav kol zeman sheyyirtze. veim heemid bifne behema zo vechayyotze bah mechitztza gevoha asara tefachim hechezik. shehashshuttafin makpidin al hammechitztza vehoil vehinnicho machal. bamme devarim amurim bachatzar hashshuttafin. aval bachatzar chavero afillu heemid behemto veasa lo mechitztza lo hechezik shehaddavar yadua sheen ze ella derech sheela. vehu haddin lechol maamid tannur vechirayim umigdal tarnegolin vechayyotze bahen. sheim tomar hechezik en lecha adam shemmashil makom lachavero: 
Echad min hashshuttafin shebbikkesh liftoach lo challon betoch beto lachatzar chavero meakkev alav mippene shemmistakkel bo mimmennu. veim patach yistom. vechen lo yiftechu hashshuttafim bechatzer petach bayit keneged petach bayit o challon keneged challon. aval poteach adam lirshut harabbim petach keneged petach vechallon keneged challon. mippene sheomer lo hareni keechad mibbene reshut harabbim sheroin otcha: 
Veaf al pi chen lo yiftach adam chanut keneged petach chatzar chavero shezze hezzek kavua tamid. shehare bene reshut harabbim ovrim veshavim veze yoshev bachanuto kol hayyom umabbit befetach chavero: 
Echad min hashshuttafin bechatzer shellakach bayit bechatzer acheret eno yachol liftoach pitcho lachatzar hashshuttafin shello. afillu bana aliyya al gabbe beto lo yaase lah petach letoch hechatzer lefi shemmarbe alehen et hadderech naasa kemi shehaya laze shachen echad venaasu lo shechenim harebe. aval poteach hu petach aliyya letoch beto. veim ratza lachlok chadro lishnayim cholek: 
Mikkan atta lamed sheechad min hashshuttafin shehevi etzlo leveto anshe bayit acheret yesh lachavero leakkev alav mippene shemmarbe alav et hadderech. vechen hammaskir beto levaal bayit echad veachar kach hevi immo kerovav o meyuddaav lishkon immo keechad bevayit ze hare hammaskir meakkev alav: 
Haya petach shel echad min hashshuttafin katan eno yachol leharechivo shehare shuttafo omer lo befetach katan ani yachol lehissater mimmecha bishat tashmish veeni yachol lehissater mimmecha befetach gadol. veim haya happetach gadol lo yaasennu shenayim shehare omer lo befetach echad ani yachol lehissater bishnayim eni yachol: 
Aval mi shehaya lo petach katan lirshut harabbim veratza leharechivo. o haya rachav veratza laasoto shenayim. en chavero shekkenegdo meakkev alav. veen tzarich lomar bene reshut harabbim sheenan yecholin leakkev alav: 
Kofin bene mavoy ze et ze laasot lahen lechi o kora lammavoy: 
Mi sheyyesh lo petach lammavoy en bene mavoy kofin oto laasot delet lammavoy sheyyachol lomar retzoni sheekkanes bachavilati ad pitchi. umavoy hamefullash lirshut harabbim uvikkeshu bene hammavoy lehaamid lahem delatot bene reshut harabbim meakkevin alehem mippene sheppeamim dochakin harabbim venichnasin bo: 
Mi shebbikkesh liftoach petach bemavoy sheeno mefullash bene mavoy meakkevin alav mippene shemmarbe alehem et hadderech. veim haya mavoy mefullash poteach kol petach sheyyirtze lechattechilla: 
Haya lo petach satum bemavoy sheeno mefullash hare ze potcho bechol et sheyyirtze. veim paratz et petzimav bene mavoy meakkevin alav. vechen echad mibbene mavoy shebbikkesh listom pitcho ulehachziro lemavoy acher bene mavoy meakkevin alav shemma yavo alehem mas umitmaet mechelkan min hammas hakkatzuv al bene hammavoy. lefichach makom sheen hammas katzuv al bene hammavoy hare ze sotem pitcho bechol et sheyyirtze: 
Chamesh chatzerot happetuchot lemavoy sheeno mefullash kullan mishtammeshot im hachitzona vehachitzona mishtammeshet leatzmah. vechen hashsheniyya mishtammeshet leatzmah umishtammeshet im hachitzona veenah mishtammeshet im hashshear. nimtzet happenimit mishtammeshet im kullan umishtammeshet leatzmah. lefichach im baal hashsheniyya bana itztabba keneged pitcho usetamo en hachitzona yechola leakkev alav. aval kol happenimiyyot meakkevin alav mippene shemmarbe alehen et hadderech baorech shehare makkifin haitztabba. vechen baal hashsheniyya sheppatach lachatzero petach sheni beno uven hachitzona en hachitzona meakkevet alav sheen lo lehishtammesh ella mippitcho velachutz. aval im patach happetach hashsheni beno uven hashshelishi happenimit meakkevet alav sheen lo lehishtammesh bammavoy ella mippetach chatzero harishon velachutz. vechen haddin bechullan:
Mishneh Torah, Neighbors 6:
Kofin bene hair ze et ze laasot choma delatayim uvariach lair velivnot lahen bet hakkeneset veliknot sefer tora uneviim uchetuvim kede sheyyikra bahen kol mi sheyyirtze likrot min hatztzibbur: 
Mi shellakach ir beeretz yisrael kofin oto bet din likkach lo derech mearba ruchoteha mishshum yishshuv eretz yisrael. vechofin bene bika ze et ze laasot benehem charitz uven charitz: 
Mi sheyyesh lo chatzer beir acheret bene hair meshabedin oto lachpor immahem borot shichin umearot veammat hammayim. aval bishar kol haddevarim en meshabedin oto. veim haya sharuy immahem beotah hair meshabedin oto al hakkol: 
Keshehen govin meanshe hair livnot hachoma govin lefi kerivat habbattim min hachoma kol hassamuch lachoma noten yoter: 
Vechol haddar beir shenem asar chodesh o shekkana bah bet dira noten im bene hair bechol haddevarim hatztzerichin letikkun hachoma vehaddelatot usechar happarashin hashshomrin et hammedina. vechol kayyotze bidvarim ellu sheshshomrin et hair: 
Kol haddevarim shetztzerichin lishmirat hair lokchin mikkol anshe hair vaafillu min hayetomim chutz mittalmide chachamim. sheen talmide chachamim tzerichin shemira shehattora shomartan. aval letikkun hadderachim veharchovot afillu min hachachamim. veim kol haam yotzin umetakkenin beatzman lo yetzu talmide chachamim immahen sheen derech talmide chachamim lehizdalzel lifne am haaretz: 
Hayu chofrin nahar lehavi bo mayim lammedina govin af min hayetomim shezzo zechut lahem kede sheyyashku mimmennu sedotehem vecharmehem. lefichach im era lahem davar shello bau hammayim hoil velo nehenu mehen hayetomim machazirin lahem kol ma shennilkach mehen. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Kofin bene mavoy ze et ze shello lehoshiv benehen lo chayyat velo buresi velo echad mibbaale ummanuyyot. haya sham bammavoy echad mibbene mavoy umman velo michu bo. o shehayta sham merchatz o chanut o rechayim uva chavero veasa merchatz acheret kenegdo o tachon acheret. eno yachol lemano velomar lo atta posek chayyay. vaafillu haya mibbene mavoy acher enan yecholin lemano shehare yesh benehem otah ummanut. aval ger mimmedina acheret shebba laasot chanut betzad chanuto shel ze. o merchatz mitztzad merchatz shel ze. yesh lahen lemano. veim haya noten immahem menat hammelech eno yachol lemano: 
Rochlin hammachzirin baayarot en bene hammedina yecholin leakkevan shettakkanat ezra hi sheyyihyu machazirin kede sheyyihyu habbesamim metzuyin livnot yisrael. aval enan kovin makom veyoshvin bo ella middaat bene hair. veim talmid chacham hu kovea makom bechol makom sheyyirtze: 
Hassocharim shemmeviin sechoratam limkor betoch haayarot bene hair meakkevin alehem. veim machru beyom hashshuk bilvad en monin otam. vehu sheyyimkeru bashshuk aval lo yechazzeru al happetachim afillu beyom hashshuk. veim yesh lahen milve bair mochrin kede parnasatam afillu belo yom hashshuk ad sheyyifreu chovan veyelchu lahen: 
Echad mibbene mavoy sheeno mefullash shebbikkesh leheasot rofe umman o gardi o melammed tinokot shel akkum bene mavoy meakkevin alav mippene shemmarbe alehem hannichnasin vehayyotzin. vechen mi sheyyesh lo bayit bachatzar hashshuttafin lo yaskirennu lo lerofe velo leumman velo legardi velo lesofer yehudi shekkotev hashshetarot velo limlammede tinokot shel akkum: 
Chanut shebbechatzer yecholin hashshechenim limchot beyado velomar lo en anu yecholin lishon mikkol hannichnasim vehayyotzin ella ose melachto bachanuto umocher bashshuk. aval enan yecholin limchot beyado velomar lo en anu yecholin lishon mikkol happattish o mikkol harechayim shehare hechezik laasot ken. vechen yesh lo lelammed tinokot shel yisrael tora betoch beto veen hashshuttafin yecholin limchot beyado velomar lo en anu yecholin lishon mikkol hattinokot shel bet rabban: 
Mi sheyyesh lo bor lefanim mibbeto shel chavero nichnas beshaa shedderech bene adam nichnasin veyotze beshaa shedderech bene adam yotzin. veeno machnis behemto umashke mibboro ella memalle umashke mibbachutz. ushenehem osin potachat al habbor. baal habbor kede lishmor et memav. uvaal chatzer mishshum chashad ishto shello tikkanes lesham ella middato: 
Mi sheyyesh lo ginna lefanim migginnato shel chavero nichnas beshaa shedderech bene adam nichnasin veyotze beshaa shedderech bene adam yotzin. veen machnis letochah taggarim velo yikkanes mittochah lesade acheret. vehachitzon zorea et hadderech. hechziru et hadderech min hatztzad middaat shenehem hare ze nichnas veyotze beshaa shehu rotze. umachnis letochah taggarim. velo yikkanes mittochah lesade acheret. vechol echad mehen yesh lo leakkev al chavero bizriat hadderech shennatnu min hatztzad:
Mishneh Torah, Neighbors 7: Mi shehayta lo challon bechatlo uva chavero veasa chatzer betziddo eno yachol lomar levaal hachallon setom challon ze kede shello tabbit bi shehare hechezik behezzek ze. veim ba chavero livnot katlo keneged hachallon kede sheyyasur hezzek reiyyato tzarich leharechik et katlo mikkeneged hachallon arba ammot kede shello yaafil alav:
Hayta hachallon lematta bakkotel kofe et chavero livnot kenegdah berichuk arba ammot ulehagbiah habbinyan arba ammot kede shello yabbit bo min hachallon:

Hayta hachallon lemala bakkotel uvana chavero kotel keneged hachallon millematta im haya merosh hakkotel shebbana ad hachallon gova arba ammot o yoter eno yachol lemano af al pi shello hirchik mikkotel hachallon kelum shehare lo heefil alav veeno mazziko biriyya. aval im nishar gova merosh hakkotel ad hachallon pachot mearba ammot kofehu lemaet hakkotel kede shello yaamod al rosh hakkotel veyashkif min hachallon. o yagbiah hakkotel al hachallon arba ammot veyihye hakkotel rachok min hachallon arba ammot kede shello yaafil velo yatzitz veyire:
Bana kotel echad betzad hachallon tzarich leharechik min hachallon tefach umagbiah hakkotel arba ammot al hachallon o kones rosh hakkotel kede shello yeshev alav veyatzitz veyire:

Bana shene ketalin mishshene tzidde hachallon. tzarich lihyot benehen rochav arba ammot vehachallon beemtza haarba. velo yesakkech al gabbehen ella im ken hirchik hassikkuch min hakkotel sheyyesh bo hachallon arba ammot kede shello yaafil alav. lefichach mi shebba liftoach challon lachatzar chavero ben challon gedola ben challon ketanna ben lemala ben lematta baal hechatzer meakkev alav. shehare omer lo tazzik li biriyya veaf al pi shehi gevoha taale bassullam vetire:

Hare sheppatach challon lachatzar chavero umachal lo baal hechatzer o sheggilla dato shehinnicho kegon shebba vesiyyea immo. o sheyyada hannezek velo irer. hare ze hechezik bachallon veeno yachol achar kach lachzor ulearer alav listom. vechetzad dinah shel challon ze shehinnichah lefatchah. im rosho shel adam yachol likkanes mimmenna o shehayta lematta mearba ammot af al pi sheen rosho nichnas mimmenna en baal hechatzer yachol livnot kenegdah o mitztziddeha ella im ken harechik arba ammot kemo shebbearnu:

Hayta challon ketanna sheen rosho shel adam nichnas mimmenna vehayta lemala mearba ammot baal hechatzer yachol livnot kenegdah uvitzdedeha shehare toen veomer lo hinnachticha liftoach ella mippene shehi ketanna ugevoha. aval shettachzik alay ad shearchik habbinyan lo hinnachti. bamme devarim amurim besheppetachah letashmish o kede sheyyikkanes bah haruach. aval im petachah leora afillu hayta ketanna beyoter ugevoha beyoter hoil velo irer hechezik veen baal hechatzer yachol livnot kenegdah o mitztzedadeha ad sheyyarchik arba ammot kede shello yaafil alav shehare machal lo al haora. vechen mi shehayta lo challon muchzeket uva chavero uvana kenegdah o mitztzedadeha belo harechaka o setamah veshatak baal hachallon eno yachol lachzor ulearer liftoach hachallon o leharechik habbinyan. shekkevan sheshshatak machal sheen adam asuy shessotmin oro befanav veshotek ella im ken machal:

Mi shehayu lo challonot lematta bechatlo uva chavero livnot bifnehen veamar lo ani eftach lecha challonot acherot bechotel ze atzmo lemala meellu hare ze meakkev alav veomer lo beet shettiftach hachallonot tarid et hakkotel utekalkel oto. vaafillu amar ani estor kol hakkotel veevne oto lecha chadash veeese bo challonot lemala veeskor lecha bayit shettadur bo ad sheevne yachol leakkev alav veomer lo en retzoni sheetrach mimmakom lemakom. lefichach im lo haya sham torach kelal veen tzarich lefanot eno yachol leakkev alav. vechofin oto sheyyihye chavero sotem challon ze shellematta mimmennu veose lo challon millemala shezzo middat sedom. vechen kol davar shezze nehene bo veen chavero mafsid veen chaser kelum kofin alav:

Aval baal hachallonot sheratza leshannot mekom challono ben lemala ben lematta afillu hayta gedola veamar eftach acheret ketanna veestom zo baal hechatzer meakkev alav. vechen eno yachol leharechiv bachallon kol shehu:

Shene achin shechalku chatzer middatan veshamu habbinyan vehaetzim ze keneged ze velo hishgichu al shumat haavir. vehiggia leechad mehen bechelko tarbatz hechatzer velashsheni haachsadra. im ratza baal hechatzer livnot kotel besof chelko bone bifne haachsadra veaf al pi shemmaafil alav shehare lo shamu haavir:
Mishneh Torah, Neighbors 8:
Hamevakesh lehotzi ziz mikkatlo al avir chatzar chavero kol shehu baal hechatzer meakkev alav shehare mazziko biriyya beet shettole bo umishtammesh bo. hotzi et hazziz velo micha bo lealtar baal hechatzer hare hechezik baal hazziz: 
Haya hazziz tefach hechezik baavir hechatzer kenegdo. veim ratza baal hechatzer livnot tachat hazziz ulevattel tashmisho baal hazziz meakkev alav. veim en bazziz tefach lo hechezik baavir hechatzer vechol et sheyyirtze baal hechatzer livnot tachtav ulevattel tashmisho shel ziz en baal hazziz yachol leakkev alav: 
Haya hazziz shehotzi rachbo tefach umashuch baavir chatzero shel chavero arbaa tefachim velo micha bo hechezik bo bearbaa al arbaa veim ratza leharechiv et hazziz ad sheyyaase arbaa al arbaa hare ze marchiv veen baal hechatzer yachol livnot baavir chatzero tachat hazziz kelum ella im ken hinniach lo tachtav gova avir asara tefachim kede sheyyishtammesh bazziz: 
Hammaamid sullam katan sheen lo arbaa chavvakin betzad katlo betoch chatzer shel chavero o betoch sadehu lo hechezik benezek ze vechol zeman sheyyirtze baal hechatzer bone betzad sullam umevattel tashmisho. veim haya sullam gadol sheyyesh lo arbaa chavvakin o yater hechezik veim ba livnot ulevattelo baal hassullam meakkev alav ad sheyyarchik kashshiur shehare machal lo lehaamid sullam gadol. lefichach kesheyyavo baal haggag lehaamid sullam gadol baal hechatzer yachol limchot kede shello yachazik alav. aval im heemid sullam katan eno yachol lemano shehare omrin lo en alecha hefsed baze kol zeman shettirtze tittelennu: 
Harotze lehotzi tzinnor al chatzar chavero kede sheyyekalleach sham hammayim. o sheasa mazchela al katlo kede sheyyihyu hammayim nizchalin veyordin lachatzar chavero. baal hechatzer meakkev alav. veim lo micha bo hechezik ze batztzinnor. ratza achar kach listom hatztzinnor baal hechatzer meakkev alav. shekkeshem shehechzik baal haggag lishpoch memav lachatzar chavero kach hechezik baal hechatzer sheyyihyu meme gaggo shel chavero bain etzlo lirshuto. ratza baal haggag laakor hatztzinnor mitztzad ze ulehachziro betzad acher o shehaya aroch veratza lekatztzero en baal hechatzer yachol leakkev alav shello hechezik ella bememe haggag vahare hem baim etzlo mikkol makom. vechen im ratza baal hechatzer livnot tachat hatztzinnor en baal haggag yachol leakkev alav sheen hatztzinnor asuy letashmish keziz kede sheyyachzik baavir hechatzer. sheeno asuy ella lekilluach hammayim: 
Mi shehorid me gaggo al chatzar chavero velo micha bo vehechezik bedavar ze. im hammayim menattefin veratza lekabbetzam lemakom echad velaasotam tzinnor ose. vechen im hayu bain derech tzinnor mimmakom acher vechillekan al rochav hakkotel vehecheziran notfin ose. vaafillu livnot al gaggo kemin tzerif ad sheyyerdu hammayim bimhera lachatzar chavero bone shehare huchzeku memav shel ze lered lachatzar chavero: 
Kotel shebben reuven veshimon im hayu shuttafin bo shenehem mishtammeshin bo ze chofer mitztzad ze umachnis korotav kol shehen. veze chofer mitztzad ze umachnis korotav. haya hakkotel shel reuven levaddo en shimon yachol lehishtammesh bo. chafar shimon bechotel ze vehichnis bah kora achat veshatak reuven velo micha bo hechezik bimkom hakkora. afillu hayta ketanna veratza shimon lehachelifah bekora gedola veava machlif. hayta hakkora sukkat aray kol sheloshim yom lo hechezik bah setam shehare reuven omer lo machalti vehinnachticha ella mippene shehu aray. leachar sheloshim yom hechezik sheen ze aray. veim sukkat yeme hechag hi kol shivat yeme hechag lo hechezik leachar shiva hechezik. veim chibber rosh hakkora bakkotel betit miyyad hechezik vehu sheyyavi reaya sheruven siyyea immo o raa velo micha: 
Mi shehechzik bechotel ze bekora achat eno yachol lehachazik bekora sheniyya shehare lo machal lo ella al haachat. bamme devarim amurim keshehoda sheen hakkotel ze shello ella chavero machal lo al hachenasat kora zo. aval im taan shekkotel ze shuttaf ani bo hoil vehishtammesh bah bekora achat neeman umishtammesh bechullan achar sheyyishshava shevuat hesset shehu shuttaf bechol hakkotel: 
Hayu korotav shel reuven betoch hakkotel uvetzad shimon mekomot chafurin lehachenis bahen rashe hakkorot lo hechezik bahen shimon lehachenis bah korot veeno yachol liton shehu shuttaf bo shehare en lo bo tashmish veyachol reuven liton sheani chafarti mekomot ellu betziddecha kede sheyyihyu muchanim ad shettikne mimmenni o shettevakkesh mimmenni veemchol lecha vetachnis hakkorot belo chafira bakkotel kede shello yitmatmet katli beet chafira:
Mishneh Torah, Neighbors 9:
Lo yachpor adam bor velo shiach velo meara velo yavi ammat hammayim velo yaase berechat hammayim lishrot bah begadim lechabbes betzad katlo shel chavero ella im ken hirchik mikkotel chavero shelosha tefachim. visayyed besid lechotel bor ze o mikve hammayim ze o kotel haamma mitztzad chavero kede shello yavliu hammayim veyazziku kotel chavero: 
Marchikin et haggefet veet hazzefet veet hammelach veet hassid veet hasselaim mikkatlo shel chavero shelosha tefachim o sad besid. umarchikin et hazzeraim veet hacharisha veet hagguma shemmitkabbetz bah meme raglayim min hakkotel shelosha tefachim: 
Marchikin et harechayim [min hakkotel] shelosha tefachim min harechayim hattachtona shehen arbaa min haelyona kede shello yanid oto o kede shello yevahalennu bekol harechayim: 
Marchikin et hattannur min hakkotel shelosha tefachim mikkarkaito shehen arbaa missefato kede shello yecham hakkotel: 
Even shehakkoves makke begadim aleha ad sheyyitlabbenu tzarich leharechik otah arba ammot mikkotel shel chavero shebbeet shehakkoves makke aleha hammayim nittazin umazzikin lakkotel: 
Lo yashtin adam mayim betzad katlo shel chavero ella im ken hirchik mimmennu shelosha tefachim. bamme devarim amurim bechotel levenim. aval bechotel avanim yarchik tefach. veim hayu haavanim tzechiach sela mashtin betziddo belo harechaka: 
Marchikin et hassullam mehashshovach arba ammot kede shello tikpotz hannemiyya beet shemmeniach hassullam vetaale lashshovach vetochal haggozalot: 
Umarchikin et hakkotel min hammazchela shel chavero arba ammot kede sheyyihye makom levaal hammazchela lizkof sullam uletakken mazchela shello hoil vehechezik bah: 
Reuven shehaya katlo samuch lechotel shimon kemin gam uva reuven laasot kotel sheni keneged kotel shimon ad sheyyaase hashshelosha ketalin kemin bet hare shimon meakkev alav ad sheyyarchik mikkenegdo arba ammot kede sheyyihye hammakom ben shene hakketalim rachav kede sheyyadushu bo rabbim vetitchazzek haaretz. bamme devarim amurim bechotel ginna o bechotel chatzer beir chadasha. aval beir yeshana kevar nitchazzeka uvone kenegdo belo harechaka. vechen im lo haya beorech kotel shimon shebbone kenegdo arba ammot eno marchik af al pi shemmonea haregel millehallech sham. shehakkotel shehu pachot mearba ammot eno tzarich chizzuk haaretz: 
Mi shebba lachpor bor besof sadehu lismoch lemetzar chavero im sede chavero eno asuy levorot somech veeno yachol limchot beyado. veim yimmalech chavero lachpor bor betziddo tzarich leharechik min kotel habbor shelosha tefachim ad sheyyehe ben chalal shete habborot shishsha tefachim. veim hayta sede chavero asuya levorot eno somech ad sheyyarchik min hammetzar shelosha tefachim veyachpor. uchesheyyavo chavero lachpor yarchik gam hu shelosha tefachim betoch sadehu veyachpor: 
Habbayit vehaaliyya shel shenayim lo yaase baal habbayit tannur betoch beto ella im ken yesh lo al gabbav gova arba ammot. vechen lo yaamid baal haaliyya tannur ad sheyyihyu tachtav maaziva shelosha tefachim uvechira tefach. veim tannur shel nachtomim hu tzarich sheyyehe tachtav arbaa tefachim uvechira shel nachtomin shelosha tefachim. veaf al pi shehirchik hashshiur im yatzat haesh vehizzika meshallem ma shehizzik kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo: 
Mi shehayta lo chanut tachat otzar chavero lo yaase bah lo nachtom velo tzabba velo refet bakar velo yachnis sham aspasta vechayyotze bahen middevarim sheole mehem hevel cham harebe mippene shehachom mafsid perot haotzar. lefichach im haya otzar yayin beeretz yisrael sheen hachom mafsido hare ze ose bachanuto kol melechet esh sheyyirtze. aval lo yaase refet bakar mippene shemmafsid reach hayyayin. veim huchzeka hachanut battechilla lerefet o lenachtom vechayyotze bo veachar kach ratza baal haaliyya laasot aliyyato otzar eno yachol limchot beyado: 
Kibbed baal habbayit veribbetz aliyyato o sheribba bah challonot kede laasot bo otzar vekadam ze veasa tannur kodem sheyyachnis perot laotzar. o shehitchil leetzor shumshemin o rimmonim o temarim vechayyotze bahen vekadam ze veasa hattannur kodem sheatzar hachittin. o sheasa baal hachanut mechila al gabbah lehavedil ben hachanut uven haotzar. bechol ellu baal haotzar meakkev alav. veim avar veasa tannur vechayyotze bo en baal haotzar yachol lehasir hattannur bechol ellu:
Mishneh Torah, Neighbors 10:
Marchikin et hailan min hair esrim vechamesh amma. uvecharuv uvashshikma chamishshim amma. mippene noye hair. vechol ilan hannimtza karov lair pachot mizze kotztzin oto. veim hailan kadam notnin lo bene hair damav. veim haya haddavar safek velo noda e ze mehem kadam en levaal hailan damim ella notel etzav veholech: 
Marchikin goren kavua min hair chamishshim amma kede shello yolich haruach hatteven beet shezzore veyazzik livne hair. vechen lo yaase adam goren kavua betoch shello ella im ken haya lo chamishshim amma lechol ruach kede shello yazzik hatteven lintiat chavero o leniro: 
Marchikin et hannevelot veet hakkevarot veet habbureski min hair chamishshim amma: 
Veen osin bureski ella lemizrach hair mippene sheruach mizrachit chamma umemaetet hezzek reach ibbud haorot: 
Mi shebba laasot mishra shel pishtan betzad yarak shel chavero shehare me hammishra nivlain baaretz veholchin umafsidin et hayyarak. o shennata kereshin karov min habbetzalim shel chavero shehen mefigin taman. o shennata chardal betzad kavveret devorim shehare haddevorim ochlin healin umafsidin et haddevash vechol ellu vechayyotze bahen. en tzarich leharechik bichde shello yazzik veal hannizzak leharechik et atzmo im yirtze ad shello yaggia lo hannezek. shezze betoch shello hu ose vehannezek ba lachavero meelav. bamme devarim amurim sheeno marchik keshehaya hannezek ba meelav achar sheyyippasku maasav shel mazzik. aval im hayu maasav shel ze sheose birshuto mazzikin et chavero bishat asiyyato hare ze kemi shemmazzik beyado. ha lema ze dome lemi sheomed birshuto veyore chitztzim lachatzar chavero veamar birshuti ani ose shemmonin oto. vechen kol harechakot haamurot lemala beinyan ze im lo hirchiko hare ze kemi shehizzik bechitztzav. lefichach tzarich sheyyarchik mishra min hayyarak uchereshin min habbetzalim vechardal min haddevorim shelosha tefachim o yeter meat kede shello yihye hezzek bayyadayim. aval leharechik ad shello yavo hannezek meelav en tzarich: 
Baal haaliyya shehaya shofech mayim vehen yordin al cheder lematta. im hayta sham maaziva shehammayim kalim bah beet sheficha veachar sheyyafsik elyon millishpoch yitballa hammayim veyerdu veyintefu al hattachton tzarich hattachton letakken uleharchik min atzmo hannezek. veim en sham maaziva ella kesheyyishpoch yerdu hammayim miyyad hare ze kemazzik bechitztzav vehaelyon metakken o yimmana millishpoch. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Mi shehaya lo ilan betoch sadehu karov levor chavero en baal habbor yachol leakkev alav velomar lo hare sharshe hailan nichnasim labbor shelli umafsidin oto shezze nezek habba meelav hu leachar zeman uveet shennata eno mazziko ucheshem shezze chofer betoch shello kach ze notea betoch shello. vechen reuven shechafar bor veyarad umatza sharshe ilan shel shimon betoch sadehu kotzetz vechofer vehaetzim shello. veim haya karov leilan shimon betoch shesh esre amma hashsharashim shel shimon vekotztzan venotnan lo. veim en tzarich lachpor bor veyatzu hashsharashim shel shimon betoch sadehu hare hu maamik shelosha tefachim kede shello yeakkev hammacharesha vechol shoresh shemmatza betoch shelosha tefachim kotztzo veeno choshesh shemma yivash hailan shel chavero shezze betoch shello hu chofer: 
Mi shehayta sede chavero netua gefanim o shear ilanot uva hu lintoa betoch sadehu gefanim betzad gefanim o ilanot betzad ilanot tzarich leharechik arba ammot. bamme devarim amurim beeretz yisrael. aval bechutza laaretz marchik ben gefanim ligfanim shete ammot. uven gefanim lishar ilanot o ben ilanot leilanot arba ammot bechol makom. haya gader bentayim ze somech laggader veze somech laggader bechol makom. mi shehaya ilan chavero note letoch sadehu kotzetz kimlo mardea al gabbe hammacharesha. uvecharuv uveshikma kotzetz kol hannote ad sheyyihye shakul keneged hammetzar. vechen im haya note al bet hashshelachin shel chavero o al bet hailan kotzetz et kol hannote ad sheyyihye shakul keneged hammetzar:
Mishneh Torah, Neighbors 11: Mi sheasa goren betoch shello. o kava bet hakkisse. o melacha sheyyesh bah avak veafar vechayyotze bahen. tzarich leharechik kede shello yaggia heafar o reach bet hakkisse o haavak lachavero kede shello yazziko. afillu hayta haruach hu shemmesayyea oto beet sheose melachto umolicha et heafar o neoret happishtan vehammotz vechayyotze bahen umaggiatan lachavero hare ze chayyav leharechik kede shello yaggiu velo yazziku. vaafillu al yede haruach metzuya shekkol ellu kemi shehizziku bechitztzav hen:
Af al pi shehu chayyav leharechik kol kach im holicha haruach hametzuya hammotz veet heafar vehizzika bahen patur milleshallem sheharuach hu shessiyyea oto veen nezek ze ba mikkoach mazzik atzmo:

Hakkotesh et harifot vechayyotze bahen betoch shello uveet shemmakke menadned lachatzar chavero ad shennidneda kissuy hechavit al pi hechavit hare ze mazzik bechitztzav vechayyav leharechik kede shello yindod o yevattel melachto shemmazzeket. veim hizzik beet hannidnud chayyav leshallem shehare mikkocho ba hannezek:

Kol haharchakot haamurot bapperakim shel mala im lo hirchik veraa chavero veshatak hare ze machal veeno yachol lachzor ulehatzricho uleharchiko. vehu sheyyerae mimmennu shemmachal kegon shessiyyea immo miyyad o sheamar lo laasot o sheraahu sheasa betziddo belo harechaka veshatak velo hikpid al ze zacha. shekkol hammachazik benezek zacha bo kemo shebbearnu. bamme devarim amurim beshehechzik bishar nezakin chutz mearbaa mine nezakin ellu haamurim beferek ze shehen heashan vereach bet hakkisse veheavak vechayyotze bo venidnud hakkarka. shekkol echad meellu en lo chazaka. vaafillu shatak hannizzak kamma shanim hare ze chozer vechofehu leharechik. vechen hezzek reiyya bemakom shetztzarich mechitztza kofehu laasot mechitztza bechol et sheyyirtze kemo shebbearnu. velamma shinnu nezakim ellu mishshear nezakin lefi sheen dato shel adam sovelet nezek meellu vechezkato sheeno mochel shehezzeko hezzek kavua. veim kanu miyyado shemmachal binzakim ellu eno yachol lachzor bo:

Mi shehechzik laasot melechet dam o nevelot vechayyotze bahen bimkoman veyavou haorvim vechayyotze bahen biglal haddam veyochlu vahare hen metzerin lachavero bekolam vetziftzufam o baddam shebberaglehem shehen yoshvin al hailanot umelachlechin perotehem. im haya chavero kappedan o chole shetztziftzuf hazze mazziko o shepperot shello nifsadin lo baddam chayyav levattel otah hammelacha o yarchik ad shello yavo lo hezzek mechamato. shehezzek ze dome lereach bet hakkisse vechayyotze bo sheen lo chazaka. vechen bene mavoy o bene chatzer shennaasa echad mehen umman velo michu bo shehare huchzak vehayu haam nichnasin veyotzin liknot veshatku lo hechezik bedavar ze veyesh lahem bechol et leakkev velomar en anu yecholin lishon mikkol hannichnasin vehayyotzin shezze hezzek kavua hu kemo heashan veheavak. vechaze horu haggeonim:

Mi shehechzik benezek sheyyesh lo chazaka kegon sheppatach challon o heevir ammat hammayim o shello hirchik ma sherauy leharechik vahare hammachazik toen atta amarta li laasot o machalta li achar sheraita o hukkar hannezek veshatakta velo machita bi. vehannizzak omer achshav hu sheraiti velo yadati mikkodem. o sheamar kesheraiti machiti becha veatta amarta atta archik o estom veatta madche oti miyyom el yom kede shettikba hezzekcha. bechol ellu vechayyotze bahen al hannizzak lehavi reaya. veim lo hevi yishshava hammazzik hesset veyippater:

Hechezik benezek sheen lo chazaka kegon ashan uvet hakkisse vechayyotze bahen vetaan hammazzik shekkana miyyado shel nizzak al hammazzik lehavi reaya shekkanu miyyado. veim lo hevi yishshava hannizzak hesset shello kanu miyyado al kach visallek ze hezzeko:
Mishneh Torah, Neighbors 12:
Haachin o hashshuttafin shebbau lachalok et hassade velittol kol echad chelko. im hayta kullah shava veen sham makom tov umakom ra ella hakkol echad cholkin lefi hammidda bilvad. veim amar echad mehem tenu li chelki mitztzad ze kede sheyyehe samuch lesade acher shelli veyihye hakkol sade achat shomin lo vechofe oto al ze sheikkuv bedavar ze middat sedom hi. aval im haya chelek echad mimmenna tov o karov lannahar yoter o karov ladderech veshamu otah hayyafe keneged hara veamar tenu li beshuma shelli mitztzad ze en shomin lo ella notel begoral. amar lahem tenu li (beshuma shelli mitztzad ze) chatzi middatah min hatztzad hara belo shuma vetol atta min hatztzad hattov kede sheyyihye chelki samuch lassade shelli. horu miktzat haggeonim sheshshomin lo. velaze dati nota vechen rauy ladun: 
Habbechor shechalak notel shene chalakim shello keechad. aval hayyavam shechalak im echav benichse haav notel chelko vechelek echav begoral. im alu bemakom echad alu veim alu bishte mekomot alu: 
Eretz merubbaat shehaya hannahar makkif lah mizrach vetzafon vehadderech darom umaarav cholkin otah baalachson kede sheyyaggia laze nahar vederech velaze nahar vederech. veim amar tenu li hachetzi shemmitztzad ze shehu betzad sadi shomin lo. kelalo shel davar kol davar shehu tov laze veen al chavero hefsed kelal kofin oto laasot: 
Echad min haachin o min hashshuttafin shemmachar chelko leacher mesallekin et hallokeach venotnin lo shear haachin o shear hashshuttafin damim shennatan veholech kede shello yikkanes zar benehen: 
Velo od ella hammocher karka shello leacher yesh lachavero shehu betzad hammetzar shello litten damim lallokeach ulesallek oto veze hallokeach harachok keillu hu shaliach shel ben hammetzar. ben shemmachar hu ben shemmachar shelucho ben shemmachru bet din yesh bo din ben hammetzar. afillu haya hallokeach talmid chacham veshachen vekarov lammocher uven hammetzar am haaretz rachok ben hammetzar kodem umesallek et hallokeach. vedavar ze mishshum shenneemar <small>(Devarim 6 18)</small> "veasita hayyashar vehattov" amru chachamim hoil vehammecher echad hu tov veyashar hu sheyyikne makom ze ben hammetzar yoter min harachok. hayu bene hammetzar rabbim kullam zochim bezo hassade hannimkeret vehi benehem lefi minyanam venotnin min haddamim lallokeach. vehu shebbau kullam befaam achat. aval im kadam echad mehen vesillek et hallokeach zacha bah levaddo hoil vehu ben hammetzar. vechen im bau miktzatan umiktzatan bimdina acheret mesallekin oto ellu haomdim kan bilvad vehi lahen. vechen hammocher leechad mibbene hammetzar o leechad min hashshuttafin shello bemassa umattan af al pi sheeno shuttafo bakkarka zacha bah. veen shear hashshuttafin o shear bene hammetzar notlin immo: 
Hammocher kol nechasav leechad en baal hammetzar shel sade achat mesallek et hallokeach meotah hassade shehare hi vehaacheret kana keechad. vechen hammocher labbealim harishonim o hallokeach min haakkum en bo din ben hammetzar: 
Hammocher laakkum meshammetin oto ad sheyyekabbel alav kol ones sheyyavo min haakkum ad sheyyinhog haakkum im ben hammetzar shello bedine yisrael bakkol. veim anaso shello kedin yisrael meshallem hammocher: 
Hassechirut en bah mishshum din ben hammetzar: 
Hamemashken makom veachar kach mecharo laze shehu memushkan beyado en bo mishshum din ben hammetzar. vechen hammocher makom rachok kede ligl makom karov. o shemmachar ra kede ligl yafe bedamav. o shemmachar kede litten menat hammelech. o shemmachar likvura o limzon haishsha o habbanot en beechad meellu din ben hammetzar ella zacha hallokeach. 
(10) Velamma en bahen din ben hammetzar. shekkol ellu terudin hen limkor umishshum tzorech gadol mochrin veim tomar yesh bahen din ben hammetzar lo yimtzeu lokeach shehare omer lamma etrach veekkach kede sheyyavo ze visallek oti veen habbealim yecholin lehametin ad sheyyavi baal hammetzar maot veyikne: 
Hare shettaan hallokeach veamar mippene hammas vechayyotze bo machar lo hammocher uvaal hammetzar omer sheker atta toen levattel zechuti. al baal hammetzar lehavi reaya veachar kach yotzi miyyad hallokeach. veim lo hevi reaya yishshava hallokeach hesset: 
Afillu haya sham baddavar safek en hallokeach mistallek ella biraya berura shehevi baal hammetzar. lefichach im taan hallokeach veamar gazlan atta lesade zo aris atta lesade zo o socher o memashken tzarich baal hammetzar lehavi reaya shehu baal hammetzar veshehakkarka zo bechezkato. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hammocher litomim ketannim en bo din baal hammetzar. hattov vehayyashar sheosin chesed im ellu yater mibbaal hammetzar: 
Vechen hammocher leishsha en bo din baal hammetzar mippene sheen darkah litroach tamid veliknot hoil velakcha chesed hu shettaamod hakkarka beyadah: 
Machar letumtum veanderoginus baal hammetzar yachol lesallekan mippene shehen safek ishsha: 
Hayta hakkarka shel echad mehen vehabbinyan o hailanot shel echad im yesh levaal habbinyan o levaal hailanot zechut bakkarka kol echad mehen ben hammetzar shel chavero. lefichach im machar echad mehen chelko chavero mesallek hallokeach. aval im en levaal hailanot o levaal habbinyan zechut bakkarka ella kol zeman sheyyirtze omer lo akor ilancha o haros binyancha umachar baal hassade zacha hallokeach veen baal hailanot o baal habbinyan mesallek oto. veim machar baal habbinyan o baal hailan hare baal hakkarka mesallek oto: 
Haya mafsik beno uven metzar shel chavero rechav dekalim o binyan gavoah vechazak o guma vechayyotze bahen roin im yachol lehachenis afillu telem echad betoch haddavar hammafsik ad sheyyitarvu shete hassadot hare ze ben metzar shello umesallek hallokeach. veim lav eno mesallek hallokeach:
Mishneh Torah, Neighbors 13:
Hannoten mattana en bah din ben hammetzar. haya katuv bishtar mottana sheacharayut mattana zo al hannoten yesh bah din ben hammetzar hoil veyesh bah acharayut mechira hi velo katav mattana ella levattel zechut ben hammetzar. vechamma noten lo. ma shehi shava: 
Amar hallokeach ken hu vehaarama asinu umechira hi bechach vechach kenitiha nishba binkitat chefetz venotel kedin hashsheluchin. veyerae li shetztzarich liton damim shehen reuyin o yeter meat. aval im amar al sheve mea bematayim kaniti eno neeman: 
Haya katuv bishtar mattana vekibbalti alay acharayut mattana zo sheim tetze miyyado etten lo matayim noten lo ben hammetzar matayim veachar kach mesalleko veaf al pi sheeno shave ella mane: 
Hechlif chatzer bechatzer en bah din baal hammetzar. hechlif chatzer bivhema o bemittaltelin roin deme otah habbehema o deme otam hammittaltelin venoten lo ben hammetzar umesalleko. veeno yachol lomar lo ten li kamma shellakachti bo shezze haarama hi veenah moelet kelum: 
Machar lo karka meat beemtza sadehu veachar kach machar lo karka betzad otah sade shebbaemtza. roin im oto hammeat shemmachar lo techilla hi idit o zibburit legabbe zot hakkarka shemmachar lo baacharona zacha hallokeach veen ben hammetzar yachol lesalleko shehare hu atzmo ben metzar hu mippene oto meat shekkana baemtza. veim oto meat shekkana baemtza kemo zot shemmachar lo bassof mitztziddo hare ze maarim uven hammetzar mesallek oto min hassade shekkana bassof: 
Hammocher al tenay ben shehitna mocher ben shehitna lokeach en baal hammetzar yachol lesalleko ad sheyyitkayyemu hattenain veyizke hallokeach bakkarka velo tishshaer bah illa immo kelal veachar kach yesallek oto: 
Hallokeach shebbana vehishbiach o satar vehifsid ben hammetzar mesalleko venoten lo damim haruyin lo vahare hu bechol maasav kemo hashshaliach. vechen im lava hallokeach kodem sheyyesallek oto ben hammetzar vesilleko ben hammetzar en baal chov shello toref miyyad ben hammetzar. zehu haikkar bechol ellu haddinin shekkol hallokeach betzad metzar chavero hu kemo shaliach lachavero uletakken shelacho velo leavvet. lefichach im hishbiach notel hotzaa. veim hifsid vechafar veharas o achal happerot menakkin oto min haddamim. bamme devarim amurim shemmechashshevin lo happerot besheachalan achar shebba ben hammetzar vehevi maot lesalleko. aval kol happerot sheachal mikkodem shello hu ochel veen mechashshevin otan: 
Echad shellakach sade achat mishshenayim uva baal hammetzar lesalleko machatzit bilvad shellakach min haechad eno yachol lesalleko. o mesalleko mikkullah o manniach kullah. aval hammocher karka lishnayim yesh levaal hammetzar lesallek shenehem o lesallek echad ulehanniach echad: 
Ben hammetzar shebba lesallek et hallokeach vekodem sheyyesalleko machar lo et hassade sheyyesh lo al hammetzar ibbed et zechuto: 
Shaliach shemmachar vahare hu baal hammetzar eno mesallek et hallokeach shehare hu machar lo veen lecha mechila gedola mizzo: 
Baal chov shel mocher shettaraf hassade miyyad baal hammetzar hare baal hammetzar chozer vetoref min hallokeach shessilleko vehallokeach chozer venotel min hammocher: 
Kol baal chov shettaraf bechovo yesh levaal hammetzar lesalleko. lo yehe koach hattoref gadol mikkoach hallokeach. veim yirtze hannitraf litten haddamim shehayu alav bechovo tachzor lo sadehu leolam kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo: 
Katan shehaya ben hammetzar veraa bet din shezzechut hu lo mesallekin lo et hallokeach o yittol lo chelko im shear baale hammetzar kemo sheyyiru: 
Baal shehayta ishto ben hammetzar hare ze mesallek et hallokeach shekkol nichse ishto birshuto vechol zechut shettavo leyadah zechut hu lo. afillu kanu miyyad ishto shemmachala bizchut zo lallokeach eno moil ella habbaal mesalleko. amda haishsha middatah vesilleka et hallokeach vechen haeved shehaya nose venoten benichse adonav shessillek et hallokeach im ratza habbaal o haadon mekayyem al yedehen veim ratza lo yekayyem vetachzor lallokeach veyachzir haddamim:
Mishneh Torah, Neighbors 14: Harotze limkor sadehu vehevi ben hammetzor shello veze sherotze likkach mimmennu levet din veamar leven hammetzar im tirtze liknot bechach vechach ase veim lav sallek et atzmecha vahare ze lokeach. hare ze lo nishara lo taana ella o mevi maot miyyad veyikne o batla zechuto. amar etrach veavi en shomin lo. elech vaavi im hu amud sheyyesh lo mamtinin lo ad sheyyelech veyavi. veim eno amud en shomin lo sheeno rotze ella lehishshamet. lefichach omrim lo o totzi atta zuzim o betela zechutecha. sheen kovin zeman levaal hammetzar. hotzi ben hammetzar hammaot vehotzi hallokeach maot im hayu shel lokeach tovim mizzuzav o memaharim latzet yoter mizzuzav batla zechuto veen lo din ben hammetzar. haya rotze hallokeach liknotah livnot bah battim uven hammetzar rotze lezarah hallokeach zoche mishshum yishshuv haaretz veen bah din ben hammetzar:

Ba lokeach venimlach beven hammetzar veamar lo hare peloni ben hammetzar shellecha rotze limkor li sade zo elech veekkach mimmennu veamar lo lech vekach lo bittel zechuto veyesh lesallek oto achar sheyyikne ella im ken kanu miyyado. bamme devarim amurim shetztzarich kinyan keshemmachal lo kodem sheyyikne. aval im machal lo zechuto achar shellakach kegon shebba ben hammetzar vesiyyea immo o sachar mimmennu o sheraa oto bone vesoter kol shehu umishtammesh velo micha bo velo irer hare ze machal veshuv eno yachol lesalleko:

Haya ben hammetzar bimdina acheret o chole o katan veachar zeman hivri hachole vehigdil hakkatan uva haholech eno yachol lesalleko. sheim atta omer ken en adam yachol limkor karkaito shehare hallokeach omer leachar kamma shanim tetze miyyadi vechaze horu haggeonim:

Hammocher sheve matayim bemane im lechol haam mozil umocher noten lo ben hammetzar mea umesalleko veim eno mozil lechol haam noten lo matayim shehu shave shehammocher natan laze mattana. lakach sheve mane bematayim eno yachol lesalleko ad sheyyitten hammatayim. taan ben hammetzar sheasu kenuneya benehem nishba hallokeach binkitat chefetz venotel matayim zuz. veim haya sham edim shennatan matayim uven hammetzar toen sheamana hayta beno uven hammocher veeno yodea [bevadday] shello lakach mimmennu ella mea hare ze noten damim kemo sheheidu haedim veachar kach mesalleko umashbio hesset shellakach bematayim veniftar:

Kol harotze limkor karka uvau shenayim kol echad mehen omer ani ekkach bedamim ellu veen echad mehen baal hammetzar. im haya haechad miyyoshve hair vehaechad mishshechene hassade shachen hair kodem. shachen vetalmid chacham talmid chacham kodem. karov vetalmid chacham talmid chacham kodem. shachen vekarov hashshachen kodem sheggam ze bichlal hattov vehayyashar hu. kadam echad vekana zacha veen chavero sherauy likdom lo yachol lesalleko hoil veen echad mehen baal hammetzar shello tziuu chachamim baddavar hazze ella derech chasidut venefesh tova hi sheosa kach: seliku lehu hilchot shechenim
Mishneh Torah, Agents and Partners 1: Haomer lishlucho tze umechor li karka o mittaltelin o kene li hare ze mocher velokeach veose shelichuto vechol maasav kayyamin. veen haose shaliach tzarich kinyan velo edim ella baamira bilvad beno leven chavero. veen tzerichin edim ella legallot haddavar im kafar echad mehem kishar kol hatteanot:

Shaliach sheavar al divre meshallecho lo asa kelum. vechen im taa bechol shehu ben bekarka ben bemittaltelin chozer shehare hu omer letakken shelichuti shedarticha velo leavvet. velo amru shehahonaya bemittaltelin shetut vehaavadim vehashshetarot vehakkarkaot en bahen honaya ella bemocher shello o kone leatzmo aval shaliach shettaa bechullam bechol shehu chozer:

Natan maot lishlucho liknot lo karka vekana lo shello beacharayut hare ze ivvet vehashshaliach lokeach otah leatzmo shello beacharayut kemo sheasa vechozer umochrah lamshalleach beacharayut hoil vekana otah bimotav vehaacharayut al hashshaliach. vechen kol kayyotze baze. lefichach im hitna alav sheasahu shaliach ben letakken ben leavvet afillu machar lo sheve mea bedinar o lakach sheve dinar bemea eno yachol lachzor bo vechayyav hameshalleach litten lo kefi hattenay:

Haomer lishlucho mechor li missade shelli bet sea umachar lo bet satayim hare ze mosif al devarav vekana hallokeach bet sea bilvad. amar lo mechor li bet satayim umachar lo bet sea hare ze maavir al devarav velo kana hallokeach. amar lo mechor li sade leadam echad vehalach hashshaliach umecharah lishnayim mimkaro batel shehare avar al devarav. amar lo mechor li sade velo peresh afillu machar lemea mimkaro kayyam:

Hannoten maot lishlucho likkach bahem chittim o min mimmine sechora velo lakach en lo alav ella taromet. natan lo maot likkach bahen chittim ben laachila ben lischora vehalach velakach bahen seorim im pachatu deme ze shellakach pachatu lashshaliach mippene shehu meshanne. veim hosifu demehen hosifu levaal hammaot. haya hashshaar katzuv veyadua vehosifu lashshaliach bamminyan o bammishkal o bammidda kol shehosifu lo hammochrim hare hu shel shenehem vecholek hattosefet hashshaliach im baal hammaot. veim haya haddavar sheen lo kitzva hakkol levaal hammaot:

Mi shehaya chayyav lachavero mamon ben mishshum milve ben mishshum pikkadon o sechirut venatan hammaot beyad hashshaliach veamar lo holech mamon ze levaal chovi en hashshaliach tzarich lehittafel lo velitten lo bifne edim. veim amar lashshaliach al tifra chov ze ella beedim uferao shello beedim chayyav leshallem. vechen im haya hachov bishtar ben sheamar lo kach hashshetar veten lo hammaot ben sheamar lo ten hammaot vekach hashshetar venatan belo edim velo lakach hashshetar chayyav leshallem shehare letakken shelacho velo leavvet:

Hashsholeach maot shebbeyado beyad shelucho veamar lo holech mamon ze lifloni sheani chayyav lo vehalach venatan lo shello beedim. hashshaliach omer natatti uvaal chov o happoel omer lo lakachti. vahare shelashtan omdin. hashshaliach nishba hesset shennatan uvaal chov o happoel nishba [shevuat hattora] shello lakach vishallem halla levaal chov o levaal happikkadon. vaafillu hayu hashsheluchin shenayim en edutan moila mippene shehen nogin beedutan shehare chayyavin lehishshava hesset. bamme devarim amurim beshehaya hashshaliach machchish et baal chov vahare shelashtan omdin. aval im ba hashshaliach veamar natatti kema sheamarta li eno yachol lehashebio hesset sheasa shelichuto shehare en sham toen alav taanat vadday shello naasa shelichuto. vechen im metu hashsheluchin o halchu lahen limdinat hayyam uva baal chov litboa hallo eno yachol lehashebio hesset shello perao hashshaliach shehare en kan mi shettoen alav taanat vadday shellakach ella macharim hallo cherem setam umeshallem hachov shealav. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Reuven sheshshalach ketav leshimon veamar lo mane sheyyesh li beyadcha shelachehu li beyad levi im ratza leshallecho eno chayyav beacharayutan ben shehaya milve ben shehaya pikkadon. vehu sheyyakkir shehu ketav yado. veim taan hammalve veamar lo katavti velo shalachti lecha yishshava hallo hesset shekketav yado ba elav ulefichach shalach veyippater. vechaze horu rabbotay. aval im lo haya hakketav ketav yado o sheen hallo yodea shehu ketav yado o afillu hayu ketuvin bo simanin veotiyyot shebbenehen beyichud im taan reuven veamar lo shalachti ketav vaacherim rimmu bo shimon chayyav beacharayuto umeshallem liruven achar sheyyacharim al mi sheshshalach ketav ze middato velo yode. veyesh mi shehora sheyyishshava reuven veachar kach yittol kedin kol hannishbain venotlin:

Levi shebba bishlichut reuven velakach chamishshim mishshimon. uva reuven veamar lo shelachtiv likkach ella esrim veesrim bilvad hevi. hare reuven nishba shello shelacho lehavi ella esrim veesrim bilvad hevi lo kedin kol mode miktzat. velevi nishba hesset shehachamishshim shennatatta li natatti liruven vishallem shimon mibbeto im haya chayyav liruven. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Agents and Partners 2: En haakkum naase shaliach ledavar min haddevarim shebbaolam. vechen en yisrael naase shaliach leakkum ledavar min haddevarim. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 28)</small> "ken tarimu gam attem" ma attem bene berit af sheluchachem bene berit. vehu haddin lechol hattora kullah. uma meshallachachem ben berit af bechol hattora kullah hameshalleach ben berit:

Ose adam shaliach ish o ishsha vaafillu eshet ish vaafillu eved veshifcha hoil vehen bene daat veyeshnan bemiktzat mitzvot naasin sheluchin lemassa umattan. aval mi sheenan bene daat vehen cheresh shote vekatan enan naasin sheluchin velo osin shaliach. echad hakkatan veechad hakketanna. lefichach hashsholeach beno katan etzel hachenvani umadad lo beisar shemen venatan lo et haisar veibbed et hashshemen veet haisar hachenvani chayyav leshallem shello shelacho ella lehodio velo haya lo leshalleach ella im ben daat. vechen kol kayyotze baze. veim peresh veamar shelach li im hakkatan hare ze patur:

Haomer lachavero mane sheyyesh li beyadcha ben milve ben pikkadon shelachehu li beyad peloni afillu haya katan im ratza leshallecho beyado niftar veeno chayyav beacharayuto. vechen shenayim shehitnu benehem shekkol mi sheyyirtze lishloach lachavero meshalleach beyad mi sheyyirtze hameshalleach hare ze meshalleach beyad mi sheyyerae lo shehu rauy leholich davar ze. veim nignav o avad badderech o shekkafar bo hashshaliach hare hameshalleach patur. shekkol tenay shebbammamon kayyam:

Hashshaliach shekkana o shemmachar vehodia shehu shaliach bedavar ze lifloni af al pi shemmashach o shehimshich venimtza sheavar al daat hameshalleach batel hammikkach umachazir. veim lo hodia shehu shaliach nikna hammikkach veyihye haddin beno uven ze sheshshelacho:

Reuven shekkana sade mishshimon veamar lo lelevi kaniti otah vechatav shetar mecher beshem levi vechazar reuven veamar leshimon leatzmi kenitiha chazor uchetov shetar mecher bishmi. en kofin et hammocher lichtov lo shetar acher beshem reuven. veim hitna immo battechilla veamar lo leatzmi ekne veze sheechtov shetar beshem levi kede shello yedu bi sheani hu hakkone hare ze kofehu lachzor velichtov shetar acher bishmo:

Hassarsur shaliach hu ella shehu notel sechar shelichuto lefichach im shinna daat habbealim meshallem ma shehifsid. ketzad. reuven shennatan chefetz leshimon hassarsur veamar lo mechor li ze veal timkor befachot mimmea vehalach umecharo bachamishshim meshallem hachamishshim mibbeto. machar bematayim hakkol liruven. vechen kol kayyotze baze. reuven omer bemea amarti lecha vehassarsur omer bachamishshim amarta li vechen bachamishshim macharti nishba hassarsur shevuat hattora shehare hoda bemiktzat. veim kevar natan lo hachamishshim nishba shevuat hesset sheasa shelichuto vezoche hallokeach. veim yada hallokeach shechefetz ze shel reuven hu veze hammocher lo sarsur hu yachzir hachefetz labbealim veyacharim al mi shennatan lo reshut limkor bachamishshim o sheratza bachamishshim vechazar bo achar shekkaniti:

Kol sarsur shehodia lallokeach shechefetz ze o karka ze shel reuven veachar shekkana hallokeach amar reuven eni rotze limkor bedamim ellu machzir hallokeach shehare lo pasak lo damim veamar lo machur lecha bechach vechach. [kol] sarsur sheavad hachefetz miyyado o nignav o nishbar chayyav leshallem mippene shehu nose sachar:

Hallokeach kelim mibbet haumman leshaggeran levet chamiv veamar lo im mekabbelin otan mimmenni ani etten lecha et demehem veim lav etten sachar muat veneensu bahalicha hare ze chayyav leshallem. veim neensu bachazara patur. netalan al menat lemachran laacherim veamar lo im yimmachru bemakom peloni o ad zeman peloni etten lecha damim kach vechach veim lo yimmachru achzirem lecha veneensu ben bahalicha ben bachazara chayyav leshallem:

Kol shaliach shettaan sheero ones peloni vehifsid kach vechach hare ze nishba shevuat hashshomrin al taanato veyippater. veim haya haones bemakom sheefshar lehavi alav edim o davar shehu galuy veyadua shehare yimtza edim hare ze tzarich lehavi reaya al taanato veim lo hevi edim eno neeman umeshallem. maase beechad sheamar lishlucho kene li arba meot garbe yayin mimmaot shehayu li beyado vekana lo venimtzeu chometz amru chachamim minyan gadol kaze shehechmitz kol yesh lo hoil veefshar lehavi reaya yavi reaya shello haya hayyayin chometz beshaa shellakach veyippater veim lo yavi reaya yeshallem. vechen kol kayyotze baze middevarim sheharaya metzuya bahen aval davar hanneelam sheen reayato metzuya yishshava alav. vechen haddin bechol taana sheyyiton hashshuttaf vechayyotze bo. vechen haddin betaanat hashshomrin im haraya yechola lihyot o yavi reaya al taanato o yeshallem kemo sheyyitbaer:
Mishneh Torah, Agents and Partners 3: Mi shehayta lo karka tachat yad echad o shehayu lo mittaltelin pikkadon veratza laasot shaliach ladun im ze ulehotzi hakkarka o happikkadon mittachat yado hare ze kotev lo hareshaa vetzarich liknot miyyado shehirshahu veomer lo dun uzeche vehotze leatzmecha vechayyotze beinyanim ellu. veim lo katav lo eno yachol ladun immo mippene shehu omer lo en atta baal dini. veaf al pi shekkatav lo chen eno ella shaliach vechol ma sheyyizke bo hare hu shel meshallecho. vechol hahotzaot sheyyotzi hashshaliach al din ze shehursha hare hameshalleach chayyav bahen. shekkach kotvin bahareshaa kol shettotzi bedin ze alay leshallemo:
Hikna laze shehirsha shelish o revia ma sheyyesh lo beyad chavero hare ze ose din al hakkol hoil vedan al chelko vahare hu baal dino bechelko dan al hakkol:

Echad min haachim shello chalku o min hashshuttafin shebba litboa tovea al hakkol. hoil veyesh lo chelek beze hammamon en tzarich hareshaa mishshear shuttafin. veen hashuttaf haacher yachol lomar leshuttafo sheddan illu hayiti ani sham hayiti tovea teanot acherot umechayyev baal dini. shehare omer lo lamma lo bata litboa gam atta. lefichach im haya bimdina acheret yesh lo lachzor al baal haddin veladun immo velomar lo ani eni mode bechol ma shettaan shuttaf shelli. lefichach yesh lannitba leakkev velomar laze o dun immi bechelkecha o have hareshaa shehare mamon shenechem beyadi ushenechem baale dini ulemachar yavo achicha o shuttafcha veyitba gam hu:
Habbaal benichse ishto tzarich hareshaa. veim yesh perot bakkarka mittoch sheyyesh ladun al happerot shehare hen shello dan al haikkar veen tzarich hareshaa meishto sheim en lo karka en lo perot:

Mi shehaya lo beyad chavero pikkadon o milve ben bemittaltelin ben maot veasa shaliach beedim lahavian lo harshut beyad ze shehem etzlo im ratza litten niftar veeno chayyav beacharayutan shehare natan lishlucho. veim lo ratza litten eno noten sheen ze baal dino ad sheyyavo behareshaa al happikkadon. vechol habba behareshaa hare hu bichlal hanneemar bahen <small>(Yechezkel 18 18)</small> "vaasher lo tov asa betoch ammav":

Hattovea chavero bedin bemittaltelin o bemaot shehifkid etzlo vechafar bo eno yachol lichtov hareshaa alav shennimtza ze kimshakker shehu omer lo hirshetich littol ma sheyyesh li beyad peloni uchevar amar peloni sheen lo etzlo kelum. vechen mi shennitchayyev lo chavero shevua eno yachol lehareshot acher alav lehashebio sheen sham davar sheyyakne lo veen adam marshe al teviat devarim sheen haddevarim niknin ella al teviat hammamon:

Mi shehayu lo meot pikkadon beyad acher veratza lehareshot shaliach lahavian en hakkinyan miyyado moil baze sheen hammatbea nikne bachalifin. ella ketzad ose. noten lo karka kol shehu umakne lo hammaot al gabbah kede lehotzian behareshaa zo veholech vedan immo umotzian. hayta lo milve beyad acher eno yachol lichtov hareshaa aleha vaafillu haya hachov bishtar mippene shehammilve lehotzaa nittena veen adam makne lachavero davar sheeno baolam. veen lo derech sheyyakne adam chov bah ella bemaamad shelashtan vehu davar sheen lo taam kemo shebbearnu. o behakenayat shetar hachov atzmo bichtiva umesira mippene shehu makne hashshibud shebbo. zehu haddin sheyyerae li min haggemara. aval haggeonim tikkenu shekkotvin hareshaa af al hammilve kede shello yittol kol echad mamon chavero veyelech lo limdina acheret. veod tikkenu sheim hirshahu littol maot sheyyesh lo beyad chavero o litboa mimmennu halevaa velo hayta lammakne karka maknehu arba ammot mechelko shebbeeretz yisrael umakne lo hammaot al gabban. udevarim ellu devarim kallim hen ad meod ureuim shezze mi yomar sheyyesh lo chelek beeretz yisrael vaafillu hu rauy eno birshuto. vehaggeonim atzman shettikkenu takkana zo amru sheen omrin yikkov haddin et hahar veenah ella kede leayyem al hannitba. im ratza ladun velitten behareshaa zo niftar. velamma yippater sheen ze habba behareshaa zo harua pachot mishshaliach sheasahu beedim. aval im lo yirtze hannitba ladun immo en kofin litten lo velo lehashebia ad sheyyavo baal dino. vechen horu sheim hayta lo milve etzel chavero ben bishtar ben beede kinyan af al pi shekkafar bah bevet din kotvin alav hareshaa mippene shehu kefirat shibud karka. aval im milve al pe hi shekkafar bah lo tikkenu sheyyichtevu aleha hareshaa:

Mi shehirsha leechad veratza levattel hashshelichut uleharshot leacher hare ze mevattel. veen lammurshe lichtov hareshaa leacher shezze omer en retzoni sheyyihye pikdoni beyad acher. lefichach im hitna alav sheyyarshe hu leacher veacher leacher hare hashshaliach kotev hareshaa lashsheni vesheni lashshelishi hakkol lefi tenao:

Habba behareshaa shemmachal leze hannitba o shemmachar lo o shemmachal lo al hashshevua o sheasa immo peshara lo asa kelum shehare omer lo letakken shelachticha velo leavvet. lefichach im hitna immo ben letakken ben leavvet afillu machal lo al hakkol hare ze machul:

Reuven shebba behareshaa vetava shimon en shimon yachol lidchoto velomar lo shemma hameshalleach otcha hirsha acher uvittel shelichutecha shehare reuven omer lo ten li happikkadon sheyyesh li beyadcha vezo hareshaati tehi etzlecha. veim hammafkid hirsha acher hu hifsid al atzmo veshimon patur shehare behareshaato natan:

Reuven shebba behareshaat shimon vetava levi veamar levi lo hayu devarim meolam aval yishshava shimon veyittol motziin hammamon miyyad levi veyihye munnach bevet din ad sheyyavo shimon veyishshava veyittol. vechen kol haddevarim shettole levi beshimon yadun reuven veyihye hammamon munnach bevet din ad sheyyavo shimon veyishshael. veyesh liruven lehacharim al mi shettoen taanat sheker kede leakkev hammamon uleacharo. nitchayyev levi shevua eno yachol leakkev velomar lo eni nishba ad sheacharim bifne shimon al mi shettoen alay sheker sheen ze hacherem ella takkana kalla shettikkenu haggeonim haacharonim kede sheyyechavvenu baale dinin taanotehen veen meakkevin shevuato shel ze mippene takkana zo hakkalla:
Mishneh Torah, Agents and Partners 4:
Kesheyyirtzu hashshuttafin lehishtattef bema yikne kol echad mehen mamon chavero lehishtattef bo. im bemaot nishtattefu yavi ze meotav veyavi ze meotav veyattilu otan lechis echad veyagbihu et hakkis shenehem. aval im katvu shetar veheidu edim af al pi shekkanu miyyad shenehem sheyyavi ze mea veze mea veyishtattefu bahen lo kanu vaadayin lo naasu shuttafin. sheen hammatbea nikne bachalifin. lefichach im nishtattefu bishar hammittaltelin kevan shekkanu miyyadam sheyyavi ze chavito shel yayin veze kaddo shel devash vahare nishtattefu bahen naasu shuttafin bahen. vechen im ervu perotehen o shessachru makom beshuttafut vehinniach ze kaddo veze chavito shennishtattefu bahen hare ellu shuttafin. kelalo shel davar bechol hadderachim shekkone hallokeach beotan hadderachim atzman konin hashshuttafin ze mizze hammamon hammuttal benehem lehishtattef bo: 
Haummanin shennishtattefu beummanut af al pi shekkanu miyyadam enan shuttafin. ketzad shene chayyatim o shene orgim shehitnu benehem shekkol sheyyikkach ze veze bimlachto yihye benehen beshave en kan shuttafut kelal sheen adam makne lachavero davar shello ba laolam. aval im hayu lokchin habbegadim bemamon atzman vetofrin otan umochrin velokchin hashsheti vehaerev mimmeotehen veorgim umochrin venishtattefu bammaot shellokchin bo hare ellu shuttafin vechol ma sheyyarvichu bischar melachtan uvemassaan uvemattanan hare ellu laemtza: 
Hashshuttafin shehittilu lechis ze mane veze matayim veze shelosh meot venitasseku kullan bammamon ufachatu o hotiru hassachar o happechat benehem beshave lefi minyanam velo lefi hammaot. vaafillu lakchu shor litvicha sheillu tevachuhu haya notel kol echad mibbesaro kefi meotav im mecharuhu chay ufachatu o hotiru hassachar o happechat laemtza. bamme devarim amurim keshennasu venatnu bammaot shennishtattefu bahen aval im hammaot kayyamin vaadayin lo hotziu otan ufachatu o hotiru mechamat hammatbea sheshshinna hammelech o anshe hammedina cholkin hassachar o hahefsed lefi hammaot. bamme devarim amurim bistam aval im hitnu sheyyittol baal hammea shelosha revaim min hassachar veyittol baal hammatayim revia veim nifchatu lo yifchot ze sheyyittol shelosha revie hassachar ella revia hahefsed veyafsid ze shennotel revia hassachar shelosha revaim min happechat hare ellu cholkin kefi ma shehitnu. shekkol tenay shebbemamon kayyam:
