Hashshuttafin shehitnu benehem sheyyaamdu beshuttafut zeman katzuv kol echad veechad mehen meakkev al chavero veeno yachol lachlok ad sheyyaggia hazzeman o ad sheyyichle mamon hashshuttafut veen echad mehen yachol littol chelko min hakkeren velo bassachar ad sof hazzeman. nishtattefu setam velo kavu lahem zeman hare ellu cholkin kol zeman sheyyirtze echad mehen veze notel chelko min hassechora veze notel chelko. veim lo hayta beotah sechora din chaluka o shehayta bachalukatah hefsed hare ellu mochrin otah vecholkin et haddamim. haya zeman yadua limchirat otah sechora yesh lechol echad mehen leakkev shello yachaloku ad shettimmacher hassechora bazzeman hayyadua limchiratah. veen echad notel min hakkeren velo min harevach ad zeman hachaluka ella im hitnu benehem. haya lahem chov etzel acherim eno yachol lomar lachavero lo nachlok ad shennigbe kol chov sheyyesh lanu ella cholkin uchesheyyifreu hachovot yittol kol echad chelko. haya alehen chov leacher im enan achrain ze laze cholkin velichsheyyaggia zeman hachov lefaro yitten kol echad chelko. veim hen achraim kol echad mehen meakkev lachlok ad sheyyaggia zeman hashshetar veyifreu hachov. velamma meakkev shehare chavero omer lo hoil vechol echad mimmennu chayyav leshallem kol hashshetar nissa venitten bedamim ellu ad sheyyaggia hazzeman. amar lo chavero nachlok vetol atta damim keneged kol hashshetar vaase mehen sechora leatzmecha uteshallem kol hashshetar bizmanno yesh lo leakkev adayin velomar lo shemma nafsid vehashshenayim yoter marvichin min haechad: 
Hannoten maot lachavero lelech limdina pelonit lischora o liknot lo perot lischora o leshev bo bachanut eno yachol lachzor bo ulehachzir hammamon miyyad hashuttaf ad sheyyelech lammakom shehitnu veyachzor o ad sheyyiknu otan happerot veyimkor o ad sheyyeshev bachanut shezze kemi shekkava zeman hu:
Mishneh Torah, Agents and Partners 5:
Hammishtattef im chavero bistam lo yeshanne mimminhag hammedina beotah hassechora. velo yelech lemakom acher velo yishtattef bah im acherim velo yitassek bischora acheret velo yimkor behakkafa ella davar sheddarko lehimmacher tamid behakkafa velo yafkid beyad acherim ella im ken hitnu battechilla o sheasa middaat chavero. avar veasa shello middaat chavero veachar kach hodio veamar lo asiti kach vechach vehiskim lemaasav hare ze patur. veen kol haddevarim haellu tzerichin kinyan ella bidvarim bilvad: 
Echad min hashshuttafin sheavar umachar behakkafa o perash bayyam o halach lemakom acher o shennasa venatan bischora acheret. vechen kol kayyotze beellu haddevarim kol pechat sheyyavo mechamat sheavar chayyav leshallem levaddo veim haya sham sachar hassachar laemtza kemo shehitnu benehem bassachar. lefichach hannoten maot lachavero betorat shuttafut likkach bahen chittim lischora vehalach vekana seorim o shennatan lo maot liknot seorim vekana chittim. im pachatu pachatu leze sheavar veim hotiru hotiru laemtza. vechen im halach venishtattef im acher bemamon hashshuttafut im hifsid hifsid leatzmo veim nistakker hassachar laemtza. aval im nishtattef im acher bammamon atzmo im pichet pichet leatzmo veim hirviach hirviach leatzmo. veim hitnu benehen hakkol lefi hattenay: 
Hannoten maot lachavero likkach bahen perot lemachatzit sachar rashshay likkach leatzmo meoto hammin. ucheshehu mocher lo yimkor shenehem keechad ella mocher ellu bifne atzman [veellu bifne atzman]. velo yikkach leatzmo chittim velachavero seorim ella bechullan chittim o bechullan seorim kede sheyyihyu meot shenehem shavin bachabbala: 
Echad min hashshuttafin sheamar nolich hassechora lemakom peloni shehi beyoker venimkor sham af al pi shekkibbel alav kol ones o kol pechat sheyyavo hare chavero meakkev alav shehare omer lo en retzoni sheetten maot shebbeyadi veehye rodef acharecha laddin lehotzi mimmecha. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Echad min hashshuttafin shebba leyashshen et happerot ad zeman hayyadua en chavero meakkev alav. veim en zeman leotan perot chavero meakkev alav: 
Shuttafin sheshshamu perotehen venishtattefu bahen yesh lahen honaya ze al ze. ervu perot belo shuma umecharum venasu venatnu bidmehen hare ellu mechashshevin et happerot kamma hayu shavin beet shennishtattefu umechashshevin et hassachar o hahefsed: 
Shuttafin shemmachalu lahem mochsin machalu laemtza. veim amru mishshum peloni machalnu ma shemmachalu machalu lo. hayu bain badderech veamdu alehen listim vegazlu et hashshayyara vehitztzil echad min hashshuttafin hitztzil laemtza (afillu en yecholim chaverav lehatztzil dela pelag kevan dela amar kelum). veim amar leatzmi ani matztzil (im yecholim lehatztzil hitztzil ad kede chelko leatzmo vehayyoter shellahem veim en yecholin lehatztzil) hitztzil leatzmo: 
Davar hayyadua lishne shuttafin af al pi shehu birshut echad mehen eno yotze mechezkato shel sheni kol yeme hashshuttafut veeno yachol liton shellekacho mimmennu o shennetano lo bemattana venomar laacher shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya ella hare hu bechezkat shenehem ad sheyyavi haacher reaya: 
Echad min hashshuttafin shebba lachalok shello middaat chavero cholek bifne shelosha vaafillu hen hedyotot uvilvad sheyyehu neemanin veyodin beshuma. veim chalak lah befachot mishshelosha lo asa kelum. bamme devarim amurim beshechalku perot. aval im hayu maot hammaot kachalukim hem veyesh lo lechallek shello bifne bet din umanniach chelek chavero bevet din. bamme devarim amurim keshehayu hammaot kullan matbea echad veshavin. aval im hayu miktzatan chadashim umiktzatan yeshanim veen tzarich lomar im hayu miktzatan yafot umiktzatan raot hare hen keferot veen cholkin otam ella bevet din: 
Asur lehishtattef im akkum shemma yitchayyev lo chavero shevua veyashbio beyirato. uchevar bearnu bimkomo sheasur laasot sechora beferot sheviit [velo bivchorot] velo bitrefot velo binvelot velo bitrumot velo bishkatzim uremasim. veim avar veasa hassachar laemtza. venire li sheim hifsid hifsid leatzmo mippene sheavar: 
Echad min hashshuttafin o min hammitassekin shemmet batla hashshuttafut o haesek af al pi shehitnu lizman kavua shekkevar yatza hammamon lirshut hayyorshim. vechaze horu haggeonim:
Mishneh Torah, Agents and Partners 6:
Shennayim shehen nosin venotnin bemamon hashshuttafut af al pi shehammamon shel echad mehen hare zo nikret shuttafut veim pachatu o hotiru hare hu laemtza. veyesh lahem lehatenot bassachar uvahefsed kol ma sheyyirtzu kemo shebbearnu. aval im haya haechad bilvad hu shennose venoten bemamon hashshittuf af al pi shehammamon mishshel shenehem hare zo hashshuttafut nikret esek veze hannose venoten nikra mitassek shehare hu levaddo mitassek bemassa umattan veshuttafo sheeno nose venoten nikra baal hammaot: 
Tikkenu chachamim shekkol hannoten maot lachavero lehitassek bahen yihye chatzi hammamon betorat halevaa vahare hammitassek chayyav beacharayuto af al pi sheavad beones vehachetzi haacher betorat pikkadon vahare hu beacharayut baal hammaot. veim nignav o avad hachetzi shel pikkadon en hammitassek chayyav leshallem ulefichach yihye sechar zo hachetzi im hirviach shel baal hammaot. ulefi takkana zo i efshar sheyyihye hassachar o hahefsed shel kol hammamon laemtza beshave sheim atta omer ken nimtza baal hammamon notel sechar chatzi meotav shehen pikkadon veeno ose kelum ella ze hammitassek toreach lo bachatzi shel pikkadon mippene meotav shehilvahu venimtza bain lide avak ribbit. veheach yaasu im rotze lihyot hassachar o hahefsed laemtza beshave yitten lammitassek secharo shebbechol yom veyom mime hashshuttafut kefoel batel shel otah melacha shebbatel mimmenna. veim haya lo esek acher kol shehu lehitassek bo im meotav shel ze eno tzarich lehaalot lo sachar shel kol yom veyom ella afillu heela lo dinar bechol yeme hashshuttafut dayyo veim pachatu o hotiru yihye laemtza beshave. vechen im amar lo kol harevach yihye lecha shelisho o asirito bischarcha hoil veyesh lo esek acher hare ze muttar. veim hifsidu yafsid mechetza. veim haya ze hammitassek ariso vehaya lo esek acher eno tzarich lehaalot lo sachar acher kelal shehaaris meshubad hu levaal hassade: 
Veod tikkenu chachamim shekkol hannoten maot lachavero lehitassek bahen ufachatu o hotiru velo ratza litten lo sechar amalo bechol yom velo hitnu benehen shum tenay sheyyihye sechar hammitassek beoto chatzi shel pikkadon shelish revach happikkadon shehu shetut revach kol hammamon. lefichach im hirvichu yittol hammitassek shene shelishe harevach chatzi harevach shel chatzi hammaot shehen milve ushetut harevach besachar shennitassek bappikkadon. nimtza hakkol shene shelishe harevach. veyittol baal hammaot shelish harevach. veim pachatu yafsid hammitassek shelish happechat shehare hu chayyav bachatzi happechat mippene shechatzi hammaot milve veyesh lo shetut bischaro beoto hachetzi shel pikkadon venimtza shennishar alav min happechat shelisho uvaal hammaot yafsid shene shelishe happechat: 
Yesh mi shettoe veomer shehannoten esek setam im yihye sham sachar yittol hammitassek chetzyo veim haya sham hefsed yafsid shelish. veen haddavar ken ella im ken hitnu al davar ze beferush. vechen im hitnu sheyyafsid hammitassek mechetza veim yihye sham sachar yittol shene shelishe harevach hare ze muttar. vechen im hitnu sheim yihye sham sachar yittol hammitassek teshiito veim yihye sham hefsed yafsid asirito hoil vehitnu sheyyihye revach hammitassek yoter al hefsedo tenao kayyam vetosefet zo keneged amalo. verabbotay horu sheen hattenay ze moil ella im ken haya lammitassek esek acher. aval im en lo esek acher tzarich sheyyehe sechar hammitassek yeter al hefsedo bishtut kemo shebbearnu shezze davar asur hu veen hattenay moil bo. velo yerae li ze: 
Horu rabbotay sheim hitnu sheyyittol hammitassek shelosha chalakim mehassachar uvaal hammaot revia hassachar nimtza revia hammaot bilvad betorat pikkadon ushelosha reviim betorat halevaa. lefichach im haya sham hefsed yafsid hammitassek shelosha revie hefsed pachot shelish harvia veyafsid baal hammaot revia ushelish revia shehu shelish kol hahefsed. ketzad. natan lo mea dinarim al tenay ze vechasru arbaa veesrim baal hammaot mafsid shemona vehammitassek meshallem shishsha asar. veal derech zo leolam kol chelek sheyyesh levaal hammaot bassachar im yihye sham revach notel kemo shehitnu veim yihye sham hefsed yafsid oto hachelek vetosefet shelisho. nimtzeta lamed lefi midda zo sheim hitnu sheyyittol hammitassek revia hassachar im pachat lo yeshallem hammitassek kelum shehare revia hahefsed shehu chayyav leshallem mippene hammilve yesh lo kenegdo shelish ma sheyyittol baal hammaot shehu revia venimtza ze keneged ze. vechen im hitnu al happechat velo hizkiru harevach im pachatu pichet hammitassek kefi ma shehitnu veim hosifu notel hammitassek kemo oto hachelek shehaya mafsid vetosefet shelish ma shennatal baal hammaot. ketzad. hitnu sheim haya sham hefsed yifchot hammitassek revia vehifchitu meshallem revia happechat veim hotiru notel mechetza. veaf al pi sheddevarim ellu shehoru divre taam hem im telech al derech zo shemma hammitassek efshar sheyyifchot veyittol sachar. ketzad. kegon shehitna immo sheyyittol hammitassek echad mishshiva bassachar ufachatu nimtza notel hammitassek echad mishshiva yater al ze hahefsed. ketzad. kegon sheppachatu shiva dinarim hare hammitassek omer lo ani chayyav lecha dinar echad kefi hattenay veatta chayyav leshallem li shenayim shehen shelish chelek happikkadon nimtza baal hammaot chayyav litten lo dinar bischar shehifsid shiva veillu hifsid arbaa asar haya chayyav baal hammaot litten lo shene dinarin veze tema gadol vedavar sheen haddaat sovelet oto veen ze etzli ella kemo divre hachalom. aval hadderech vehaddin haemet sheyyerae li shekkol sheyyarviach hammitassek im yihye sham hefsed yafsid shene shelishe hachelek shehaya marviach vechen im hitnu al hahefsed vehirvichu yittol kemo oto hachelek shehaya mafsid vetosefet shelish chelek chavero. nimtzeta atta omer lefi midda zo sheim hitnu sheyyittol hammitassek revia hassachar vehifsid hare ze meshallem shetut veim hitnu sheyyafsid revia vehirviach notel mechetza. veal derech ze lo timtza tema veyetze haddin bekav hatztzedek:
Mishneh Torah, Agents and Partners 7: Hannoten maot lachavero setam lehitassek bahen o shehitnu beferush sheyyihye hassachar vehahefsed benehem beshave veneevad hammamon yesh mi shehora sheyyeshallem hammitassek shelish kemo shebbearnu im avad miktzat hammamon. veyerae li shehu meshallem mechetza shehu betorat milve veze sheamru chachamim meshallem shelish bahefsed beshello higgia hahefsed littol baal hammaot pachot mechatzi mamono. ketzad. reuven shennatan leshimon mea veesrim dinar venasa venatan ufachat tishim hare shimon meshallem sheloshim venimtza reuven notel shishshim. aval pachat shimon mea vachamishsha en omrim yafsid shimon chamishsha usheloshim sheim atta omer ken nimtza reuven notel chamishshim uleolam lo yittol reuven pachot mishshishshim. lefichach shetar esek hayyotze al hayetomim shehaya avihen mitassek bo nishba baal hashshetar vegove mechetza shehu betorat milve af al pi shelleolam toanin layyoresh. hinne lamadta sheeno notel leolam pachot mimmechetza. velamma ani omer sheen pochatin lo kan keneged secharo shennitassek befikkadon. shehare avad kol hachetzi shel pikkadon velo nishar kan pikkadon kelal shennomar im lo yittol secharo yerae keribbit shehare chatzi hammilve bilvad notel. vechen im hitnu sheyyittol hammitassek revia hassachar veavad hammamon kullo meshallem harvia kullo shehu betorat milve aval im nishar min hammamon meat kede sheim tosif al oto hameat shetut hahefsed sheppechato yavo hakkol revia hammamon o yeter hare ze meshallem shetut bilvad min hattaam shekkevar bearnu:

Hammitassek shehifsid vechazar vetarach ad shehirviach eno yachol lomar levaal hammaot bo venachshov hahefsed shehifsadnu techilla vetafsid shene shelishim venachshov harevach shehirvachnu baacharona vetittol shelish ella mechashshev baacharona bilvad al harevach o al hahefsed veen lo ella barevach shehosif al hakkeren:

Natan lo matayim yeriot bematayim dinarim beesek uchetavan shene shetarot mea bechol shetar mechashshev lo al kol shetar bifne atzmo uvaal hammaot hu shehifsid al atzmo. natan lo mea yeriot bemea dinarim vechazar venatan lo baesek acher mea chaviyyot shel yayin bemea dinarin vechatav lo shetar esek bematayim dinarin eno mechashshev lo ella bishtar echad, hu shehifsid al atzmo. ketzad. sheim machar hammea yeriot bemea usheloshim vehammea hechaviyyot beshivim baal hammaot notel hakkol mippene sheasa shetar echad hare hakkol matayim velo hirviach kelum. aval illu hinnicham shene asakim keshehayu haya marviach hammitassek bechelko babbegadim esrim umafsid bechelko bachaviyyot asara vehaya notel asara. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

En hammitassek yachol lachalok hammaot shel esek o sechora velomar ettol et hachetzi shebbetorat milve leatzmi veessa veetten bo veanniach hachetzi shebbetorat pikkadon bevet din. shello natan lo mamon ze ella lehitassek bechullo. veim chalak veasa ze afillu bevet din haggadol lo asa kelum ella hassachar o hahefsed benehen al otan hadderachim shebbearnu:

Hammitassek shennatan mattana laacherim min hammittaltelin shel esek o mimmeot haesek vehevi baal hammaot reaya berura sheellu hammetaltelin o hammaot mishshel esek hen motziin otan miyyado. vaafillu shinna hamekabbel otam umecharam unetanam mattana laacherim o hifsid chayyav leshallem. vehakkol biraya berura. kevar bearnu shehammitassek shemmet nishba baal hammaot vegove mechetza. veim yesh sham edim shehammittaltelin ellu min hammaot shel esek hem notel otam baal hammaot belo shevua. veen baal chov velo ishsha notlim mehem kelum ella im ken haya bahem revach hare chelek harevach shel met shel yorshav veyittol beoto chelek baal chov vehaishsha:
Hannoten maot lachavero likkach bahem perot lemachatzit sachar velo lakach en lo alav ella taromet. veim noda biraya berura shellakach umachar hare ze motzi mimmennu hassachar beal karcho:

Natan lo maot likkach bahen perot lemachatzit sachar lokeach bahen mikkol min sheyyirtze. velo yikkach lo kesut velo etzim. vechen kol kayyotze baze. hammoshiv et chavero bachanut lemachatzit sachar im haya umman lo yaasok beummanuto lefi sheen enav al hachanut beshaa sheosek beummanuto. veim haya shuttaf immo bechatzer muttar. velo yihye lokeach umocher devarim acherim veim lakach umachar hassachar laemtza:
Mishneh Torah, Agents and Partners 8:
Hannoten betzim levaal hattarnegolim lehoshiv hattarnegolim alehen ad sheyyetzu haefrochim vigaddel otan baal hattarnegolim veyihye harevach benehem tzarich lehaalot lo sechar amalo umezono. vechen hashsham agalim useyachim al haroe lihyot mitassek bahen sheyyagdilu vehassachar laemtza chayyav lehaalot lo sechar amalo umezono bechol yom kefoel batel. umegaddel otan ad sheyyihyu haagalim bene shalosh shanim vehachamor ad shettehe toenet. veeno yachol limkor shello middaat chavero betoch zeman ze. vechen hashsham behema al hamefattem lihyot mefattem otah vehassachar laemtza tzarich litten amalo kefoel batel. veim amar lo hare harosh vehaalya shellecha baamalcha yeter al machatzit hassachar muttar. hayu lamfattem behemot acherot shemmefattem otam im zo hashshuma etzlo. vechen im hayu lo agalim useyachin acherim o betzim acherot shello. hoil vehu mitassek beshello uveshel chavero afillu lo heela lo ella davar muat bechol yeme hashshuttafut hazzot dayyo vecholek besachar beshave. veim haya ariso hoil vehu metappel beshello uveshel baal hassadot en tzarich lehaalot lo kelum: 
Hashsham agalim o seyachin o hoshiv tarnegolim o sham behema al happattam lemachatzit sachar velo heela lo sachar hare dino kedin haesek shel maot. roin bechamma shamin habbehemot o habbetzim vechamma hirvichu venotel hammitassek shene shelishe hassachar. veim hifsidu meshallem shelish hahefsed: 
Shamin para vachamor vechol davar sheddarko laasot veleechol veyihye hassachar laemtza af al pi shezze mitassek hare yesh lo revach acher leatzmo baavodat habbehemot shehare socher otah o oved bah venehene bischarah uvaavodatah. veen shamin egel im immo velo seyach im immo shehaegel vehasseyach eno ose kelum veyesh bo esek: 
Hashsham behema lachavero ad matay chayyav letappel bah. baatonot shemona asar chodesh. uvegodrot vehen hatztzon vehabbakar arbaa veesrim chodesh. veim ba lachalok betoch zeman ze chavero meakkev alav mippene shennishtattefu setam lefi sheeno dome tefila shel shana rishona shehi merubba veharevach muat sheenah mishtammenet battechilla ella bekoshi litfila shel shana haacheret shehi muetet veharevach merubbe shehare hi mishtammenet harebe umosefet bechol yom. lefichach meakkev alav ad sof shana sheniyya. yalda habbehema hashshuma etzlo hare havvalad mikkelal harevach laemtza. makom shennahagu legaddel valdotam yegaddelu veachar kach yimmachru. makom shennahagu shello legaddel chayyav hammitassek lehittappel bavveladot bedakka sheloshim yom uvegassa chamishshim yom vecholkin. ratza lehittappel bahen yeter al zeman ze sham otan bifne shelosha beyom sheloshim uveyom hachamishshim vechol sheyyarvichu achar kach yittol hammitassek shelosha chalakim vachavero revia harevach shehare yesh lo chatzi havvalad. umippene shennitassek bechetzi shel chavero notel chatzi oto hachetzi. hare shelosha revaim. veim lo hitna ken bifne shelosha hare machal vehavveladot benehen beshave kemot shehen. makom shennahagu lehaalot sechar kattaf limot haesek maalin veyihye kol hassachar shennotel hammitassek bassachar shennose al ketefo bichlal sechar hammaot. vechen im darkan lehaalot sechar behema maalin lo. makom shennahagu lehaalot sechar veladot bischar amalo maalin. vechol hammitassek o hammishtattef setam lo yeshanne mimminhag hammedina: 
Reuven shehayta lo sade vehorid shimon letochah lezarah o lenatah ulehotzi aleha hotzaot velimkor happerot vechol hayyater al hahotzaa yihye benehem ben shehitnu sheyyachleku beshave ben shehitnu sheyyittol reuven yeter ben shehayta hahotzaa kullah mishshel reuven ben shehayta mishshel shimon. bechol ze muttar veen kan avak ribbit. veshimon hammittappel baavodat haaretz uvahotzaa uvimchirat happerot hu hannikra aris. aris omer lemechetza yaradti uvaal hassade omer lishlish horadtiv holchin acher minhag hammedina veze shettaan shello kamminhag alav lehavi reaya: 
Baal shehorid arisin benichse ishto vegershah im haya habbaal aris hoil venistallek baal nistalleku hem veen lahem min hahotzaa ella shiur hashshevach uvishvua. veim en habbaal aris al daat [minhag] haaretz yerdu veshamin lahem kearis: 
Haachin o shear hayyorshin shello chalku yerushshat morishan ella kullan mishtammeshin bah beyachad hare hen keshuttafin lechol davar. echad min haachin o min hashshuttafin shennafal leummenut hammelech harevach laemtza. chala echad mehen venitrappe nitrappe min haemtza. veim chala bifshia kegon shehalach bashsheleg o bachamma bime hachom ad shechala vechayyotze baze hare ze mitrappe mishshel atzmo:
Mishneh Torah, Agents and Partners 9:
Hashuttafin kullan vehaarisin vehaappotroppin shemminnu otam bet din al hayetomim vehaishsha shehi noset venotenet betoch habbayit o shehoshivah balah chenvanit uven habbayit. kol echad meellu nishba middivrehem betaanat safek shemma gazal chavero bemassa umattan o shemma lo dikdek bacheshbon shebbenehem. velamma tikkenu chachamim shevua zo mippene sheellu morin leatzman shekkol ma sheyyikkechu minnichse baal hammaot rauy hu lahem mippene shennosin venotnin vetorchin. lefichach tikkenu lahem chachamim shechayyavin shevua betaanat safek kede sheyyaasu kol maasehen betzedek veemuna: 
Veen kol echad meellu nishba betaanat safek ad sheyyachshod hammashbia otan bishte kesef shehen shete main shel kesef kemo sheyyitbaer. aval im choshdan befachot mizze enam nishbain: 
Mikkan horu rabbotay sheim met hashuttaf haechad en hayyoresh yachol lehashebia shuttafo shel aviv betaanat shemma shehare eno yodea haddavar shechashado bo aviv bevadday kede sheyyachshod oto ze hayyoresh bishte kesef. veyesh mi shehora shemmashbia oto hayyoresh betaanat shemma vechaze rauy ladun shehare hayyorshin mashbiin et haishsha shennaaset appotroppa bechayye balah: 
Af al pi sheen sham edim shezze ariso o shuttafo ella hu mode mippi atzmo veamar shuttafo o ariso o ben beto ani aval lo gazalti kelum hare ze nishba binkitat chefetz sheen omrim miggo lefatro shevua ella lefatro mamon. ezehu ben habbayit sheyyesh lo lehashebia betaanat safek. ze shemmachnis poalim umotzi poalim umachnis lo perot umotzi lo perot. aval ben habbayit sheeno nose venoten ella nichnas beraglo veyotze bilvad eno yachol lehashebia missafek. vechen appotroppos shemminnahu avi yetomim en hayetomim mashbiin oto betaanat safek. vechen haishsha shello naaset appotroppa bechayye balah velo nasa velo natna leachar kevurat balah en mashbiin otah missafek. vechen im nasa venatna ben mita ukevura en mashbiin al ze shennishtammesh ben mita likvura. sheim atta omer shettishshava al ze lo timkor likvura venimtza hammet mitnavvel: 
Hameshalleach beyad chavero chefetz lemachro o sheshshalach maot beyado liknot lo perot o sechora af al pi shello natan lo sachar al ze veen lo chelek velo hanaa bishlichut zo hoil venasa venatan bemamon chavero hare ze keven bayit. veyesh lo lehashebia missafek shello gazal lo kelum beet shehevi lo hassechora shekkana o mikketzatah o hammaot shemmachar lo mehen: 
Hashshuttafin shennosin venotnin beyachad o shehaya haechad nose venoten umafkid hassechora o mikketzatah o hammaot im hashsheni belo mishkal velo midda velo minyan hare shenehem nichnasin lesafek veyesh lechol echad mehen lehashebia et chavero shevuat hashshuttafin. aval im haya haechad hu shennose venoten vehashsheni lo nitassek immo kelal en nishba ella ze shennasa venatan: 
Chalku hashshuttafin vehaarisin venitgarsha haishsha venifrad mealav ben habbayit vehevi lo hashshaliach sechora shekkana lo o maot shemmachar lo bahen veshatak vehalchu lahem velo tevaam miyyad eno yachol lachzor ulehashbio betaanat safek. aval im hayta lo taanat vadday mashbio aleha umegalgel bah kol ma sheyyirtze. vechen im nitchayyev lo shevua achar zeman ben shel tora ben shel divrehem kegon shennaasa lo shuttaf o ben bayit paam acheret hare ze yachol legalgel alav shello gezaltani beshuttafut zo shebbenenu velo keshehayita shuttafi o arisi o ben beti o appotroppi barishona. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hashshuttafin shechalku venishar lahem chovot etzel acherim enan yecholin lehashebia ze et ze missafek shehare chalku vehachov shennishar davar yadua hu bechol ma sheyyifreu yikkach ze chelko min hachov veze chelko min hachov. vechen im nishar lahem maot bakkis uchevar yadu otan vaadayin lo natlu kol echad chelko en mashbiin ze et ze shehammaot kachalukin hem. vechen im asu cheshbon kol hashshuttafin venishar leechad mehen etzel chavero davar katzuv veyadua af al pi sheadayin lo natlu hare chalku. aval im nishar benehem kol shehu min happerot vaadayin lo chalku otan velo yadu mishkalam o shennishar benehem tzad min hashshuttafut shello asu bo cheshbon velo yada kol echad mehen kamma chelko hammaggio hare hashshuttafut kayyemet adayin umashbiin ze et ze: 
Mi shettava et chavero achar chaluka eno yachol lehashebio ella al yede gilgul kemo shebbearnu aval yesh lo lehacharim setam al mi sheggezalo kelum keshehaya shuttafo o ariso o ben beto velo yode bema sheggazal:
